We're a profitable, fast-growing Series A company with a 10+ person engineering team.

The Role

We're expanding our web platform and this is a chance to join our frontend team and own meaningful work from day one: new features, new surfaces, and all the things that go into making an app people genuinely love to use. You'll collaborate closely with product, design, and backend engineers, working directly with people who want to invest in your growth. The codebase is modern, well-structured, and designed to make doing the right thing the easy thing.

What you'll work on

  • Build new features end-to-end, from early design conversations through to shipping

  • Pair closely with teammates on hard problems, talk through strategy up front, and do real-time review when it counts

  • Work cross-functionally with product, design, and backend engineers on a daily basis

  • Develop and act on opinions about architecture, code quality, component design, and tooling

  • Contribute to and improve our component library, ensuring consistency across our platform

  • Taking ownership of your work end-to-end, with an eye toward the long-term health of the product and codebase, not just the next PR

You'd be a great fit if you

  • Have a strong foundation in React and TypeScript, enough that you can hit the ground running even if you're still growing

  • Are comfortable working with a modern component library ecosystem (Storybook, shadcn, Radix, Tailwind)

  • Takes feedback gracefully yet is confident enough to vocalize when they think they're right

  • Ask thoughtful questions and are unafraid to make and learn from mistakes

  • Take genuine pride in what you ship, because the details matter to you

  • Embrace hard problems and dig in rather than looking for the easy path out

  • Thrive when working closely with others: you like thinking out loud, pairing, and building shared understanding

  • Want to grow fast in an environment that will challenge and support you

We use AI tools throughout our workflow, including Claude Code for development, AI-assisted code review, and various integrations across the company. We want all of our engineers to become comfortable with these tools and develop real opinions on how to use them most effectively.
What we care about is judgment. AI can accelerate great engineers significantly, but it can also produce convincing-looking code that's subtly wrong. We want someone who knows the difference: who uses these tools to go faster, not to think less.

  • React with Next.js for modern, performant web applications

  • TypeScript for type safety and developer experience

  • Storybook as our component development environment

  • Home-grown component library built with shadcn/ui and Radix primitives

  • Tailwind CSS for styling

  • Modern build tooling and testing practices

Our interview process

A hiring manager intro call, a live frontend coding session, a virtual onsite with the team, and a final conversation with leadership. We aim to make the process straightforward and respectful of your time.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary

  • 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision

  • Flexible PTO

  • Remote-first with offices in Austin and New York

  • 3 team offsites per year

We’re looking for a hands-on performance marketer to scale paid acquisition and improve the journey from first click to signed customer.

Your defining strength is a scientific approach to growth: form a hypothesis, design a test, measure the result, and use the evidence to decide what comes next. You establish baselines, make changes you can learn from, and connect insights across experiments. You care as much about understanding why something worked as you do about the result itself.

You pair that rigor with creativity and initiative. You can follow the numbers to an opportunity, develop a compelling idea, and bring it to life without waiting for a detailed brief. AI and automation are already part of how you work, not something you’re planning to explore.

This is an opportunity to build the systems, insights, and acquisition strategies that support Daisy’s national expansion.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own paid acquisition. Manage Meta/Facebook Ads and Google Ads end to end, including strategy, execution, budget allocation, pacing, and optimization. Scale investment based on customer acquisition results, not just platform-reported performance.
  • Build a disciplined experimentation program. Prioritize tests across creative, messaging, audiences, offers, and landing pages. Define hypotheses, baselines, success metrics, and guardrails before launch. Document what you learn, including failed or inconclusive tests, and use it to guide the next iteration.
  • Turn insights into creative solutions. Develop new campaign concepts and acquisition ideas grounded in customer understanding and performance data. Identify patterns across campaigns and markets, then test whether those insights translate before rolling changes out broadly.
  • Connect marketing to business outcomes. Work with sales to understand lead quality, qualified pipeline, and which campaigns produce customers. Use acquisition cost, conversion rates, and payback to guide decisions, not clicks or lead volume alone.
  • Make HubSpot a reliable foundation for growth. Build and optimize segmentation, workflows, lead scoring, routing, lifecycle reporting, and attribution. Maintain reliable conversion tracking and identify opportunities to improve follow-up and funnel performance.
  • Use AI and automation to increase speed and scale. Build repeatable workflows to analyze large datasets, surface opportunities, automate reporting, and reduce manual work. Validate outputs and put appropriate checks around automated changes to campaigns and budgets.

What You Bring:

  • 7+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience managing large paid media budgets, with a track record of scaling acquisition and improving measurable business results.
  • Deep expertise in Meta/Facebook Ads and Google Ads, plus high proficiency in HubSpot. You’re comfortable doing the work yourself, not just overseeing an agency or reviewing reports.
  • Strong experimental and statistical judgment. You have substantial creative A/B testing experience and understand sample size, uncertainty, conversion lag, and the difference between correlation and causation. You know when evidence supports a change and when a result needs more investigation.
  • Demonstrated, practical AI fluency. You already use agents and AI-assisted tools such as Claude, Codex, or comparable systems to analyze data, automate work, or build useful workflows. You’ve moved beyond occasional prompting to making AI a meaningful part of how you execute, with sound judgment about validating its outputs.
  • Technical resourcefulness. You’re comfortable working with complex datasets, troubleshooting workflows, and learning unfamiliar tools quickly. You don’t need to be a software engineer or an expert coder, but you should be comfortable using technical tools to solve marketing problems.
  • Ownership, ambition, and intellectual curiosity. You identify opportunities rather than wait for assignments, turn analysis into action, and take responsibility for outcomes. You’re motivated by ambitious goals and willing to challenge your own assumptions when the evidence points elsewhere.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with SEO, Reddit Ads, or other acquisition channels beyond Meta and Google.
  • Deeper experience with automation, APIs, SQL, scripting, or AI-enabled data analysis.
  • A strong eye for creative, copy, or design, including familiarity with design tools.

We are seeking an execution-focused Senior Cloud Platform Engineer to build and maintain the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and backend API integration layers supporting 6,000+ real estate agents and enterprise operations nationwide.

You will be the primary hands-on builder turning enterprise blueprints into hardened, production-ready code. You will write infrastructure as code (Terraform), engineer resilient API bridges between enterprise systems (Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP, CRM and transaction systems, payment gateways), deploy serverless microservices on Google Cloud Run, and establish modern GitOps practices.

You will work closely with the Principal Engineer, corporate IT/security teams, and strategic partners to ensure rapid deployment, zero operational downtime, and strict data governance.

2. Key Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure as Code & DevOps (Platform Engineering)

  • Serverless Cloud Infrastructure: Architect, provision, and maintain production-grade GCP infrastructure using Terraform (Cloud Run, Cloud CDN, Cloud Storage, Firestore, Cloud SQL, Secret Manager, Cloud Armor).
  • Automated CI/CD Pipelines: Build and standardize build/test/deploy pipelines using GitHub Actions / Cloud Build, enabling safe zero-downtime canary and blue-green deployments.
  • Observability & Reliability: Implement centralized logging, tracing, and metric alerts via Google Cloud Operations Suite to support 99.9% platform uptime and sub-second API latencies.
  • Security & FinOps Compliance: Enforce least-privilege IAM, manage KMS keys and secrets, implement Cloud Armor DDoS/WAF policies, and continuously monitor cloud resource utilization.

Backend Engineering & Enterprise API Integrations

  • System Integration Engine: Design, develop, and maintain high-throughput, fault-tolerant REST and webhook-driven microservices connecting legacy and modern enterprise platforms.
  • Core Business Connections:Build bi-directional API synchronizations across:
    • Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365): Ingest and synchronize commission split calculations, accounting ledgers, and accounts receivable data.
    • CRM & Transaction Systems: Deep integration with core brokerage CRM and transaction management systems.
    • Enterprise Identity: Integrate with Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID (SSO / OAuth2 / SAML) for authentication across 7,000+ users.
  • Data Flow & Caching: Architect caching and event streaming patterns using Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, and Memorystore (Redis) to decouple background jobs from agent-facing web interactions.

Co-Engineering & Modernization Delivery

  • Partner Collaboration: Work alongside partner engineering squads, reviewing partner PRs, aligning on shared codebases, and absorbing operational handoffs.
  • Legacy Platform Decommissioning: Extract logic, schemas, and data structures from legacy applications (Apptrium, RavenDB/SQL instances) and migrate workflows into our native GCP serverless environment.
  • Multi-Project Scalability: Build reusable microservice components, data connectors, and SDKs for upcoming initiatives, including the AMP (Agent Marketing Platform) replacement and the elliman.com web platform modernization.

Shared Platform Core & Cross-Coverage

  • Shared platform core: GCP, Terraform, CI/CD, IAM, Cloud Run, and observability are shared responsibilities between this role and the Principal Engineer.
  • Primary backup to the Principal Engineer for GCP infrastructure, CI/CD, and partner code review.
  • Shared runbooks: Maintain runbooks and documentation so either role can operate, deploy, and respond to incidents on any production system.
  • Shared on-call rotation with the Principal Engineer.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience in cloud infrastructure, backend API development, and distributed systems.
  • Proven track record building and running production workloads on Google Cloud Platform.
  • Production backend services in Node.js/TypeScript or Python.
  • Modular Terraform for multi-environment enterprise cloud estates, plus automated testing, Docker, and GitOps workflows in modern CI/CD tools.
  • Experience building integrations with enterprise systems (ERPs such as Dynamics 365 or NetSuite, enterprise CRMs, transaction and document workflow systems, payment gateways).
  • Working knowledge of API authentication and identity standards (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT).

Soft Skills & Mindset

  • High ownership and pragmatism: Comfortable moving fast while keeping architectural discipline.
  • Collaborative partner: Works transparently with internal stakeholders (CISO, compliance, product) and external technical consultants.
  • Clear documentation: Maintains architectural documentation, API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger), and deployment runbooks.

4. Preferred Qualifications

  • Entra ID / Google Workspace federation at enterprise scale.

  • Experience migrating workloads from Microsoft Azure (or AWS) to GCP.

jobs.excerpt: Du kennst DATEV aus dem Arbeitsalltag und erklärst gerne Dinge, bis sie wirklich sitzen?
jobs.description:
Du kennst DATEV aus dem Arbeitsalltag und erklärst gerne Dinge, bis sie wirklich sitzen? Dann suchen wir dich - deutschlandweit, komplett im Homeoffice, in Voll- oder Teilzeit.

Wir sind die Digitalagentur1 und begleiten Steuerkanzleien in ganz Deutschland bei der Digitalisierung. Unsere Kunden sind ausschließlich Steuerberater. Deren Mandanten betreuen wir nicht selbst, aber wir machen die Kanzlei fit darin, ihre Mandanten sicher zu begleiten.

Zu wem passt diese Position?

Du musst kein Steuerfachangestellter sein. Vielleicht kommst du aus einer Steuerkanzlei - oder du hast in einem Unternehmen gearbeitet, das mit DATEV arbeitet. Beides passt. Zu uns passen zum Beispiel Steuerfachangestellte, Finanzbuchhalter, Lohnbuchhalter, Bilanzbuchhalter oder Mitarbeiter aus der Kanzlei-Eigenorganisation.

Unsere Themen

  • DATEV Rechnungswesen

  • DATEV Personalwirtschaft (LODAS und Lohn und Gehalt)

  • Kanzlei-Eigenorganisation

  • DATEV Cloud – zum Beispiel DATEV Unternehmen online, DATEV Personal oder DATEV Meine Steuern

Genau dort tauchen im Kanzleialltag Fragen auf: Wie stellen wir einen Mandanten auf DATEV Unternehmen online um? Warum zieht die Buchung nicht sauber durch? Wie richten wir einen neuen Mandanten in der Personalwirtschaft ein? Du bist die Person, die diese Fragen beantwortet.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Support: Du beantwortest DATEV-Rückfragen aus den Kanzleien - per Telefon, Videocall und per Fernwartung direkt am Bildschirm.

  • Schulung: Du zeigst Kanzleiteams in Online-Schulungen, wie sie mit DATEV effizienter arbeiten.

  • Beratung: Du begleitest Kanzleien bei Umstellungen, zum Beispiel auf digitale Belege, DATEV Unternehmen online oder neue Abläufe im Rechnungswesen und in der Personalwirtschaft.

  • Prozesse und Checklisten: Du hilfst uns, unsere internen Abläufe und Checklisten weiterzuentwickeln, damit jeder Vorgang nach demselben klaren Standard läuft.

  • Schulungsakademie: Du baust unsere interne Schulungsakademie mit aus - Unterlagen, Leitfäden und Lerninhalte, von denen das ganze Team profitiert.

Keine Sorge: Wir schulen dich komplett ein.

Du bekommst eine vollständige Einarbeitung in alle Themen, mit denen du zu tun hast. Wir gehen alles gemeinsam durch, üben es mit dir und lassen dich erst dann eigenständig arbeiten, wenn du dich sicher fühlst. Du musst also nicht alles schon können.

So arbeitest du bei uns

  • 100 % Homeoffice, deutschlandweit: Du brauchst nicht umzuziehen und nicht zu pendeln.

  • Feste Kernzeiten: Montag bis Donnerstag ab 8:30 Uhr, mindestens 5,5 Stunden am Tag - so sind wir für die Kanzleien verlässlich erreichbar.

  • Voll- oder Teilzeit: Der Mindestumfang liegt bei 22 Stunden pro Woche, Vollzeit sind 40 Stunden.

  • Alles digital: Termine, Schulungen und Support laufen online, keine Reisetätigkeit.

  • Klare Abläufe: Feste Prozesse statt Improvisation - du weißt jeden Tag, woran du bist.

Wir bieten

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen.

  • Tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang und motivieren uns gegenseitig, Bestleistungen zu erzielen und persönlich zu wachsen.

  • Volle Einarbeitung: Wir schulen dich in allen Themen ein und üben alles mit dir.

  • Moderne Technik und laufende Weiterbildung, damit du fachlich am Ball bleibst.

  • Gute Vergütung & Karrierechancen: Unsere Mitarbeiter erhalten Weihnachtsgeld sowie vermögenswirksame Leistungen. Über die nächsten Jahre werden wir weiter wachsen und expandieren. Dazu benötigen wir weitere Experten und/oder Führungskräfte.

Zwei wichtige Hinweise

Die Tätigkeit ist ausschließlich aus Deutschland oder dem europäischen Ausland möglich. Und weil bei uns alles online läuft, brauchst du zu Hause eine stabile Internetleitung.

Noch mehr über uns

Wenn du weitere Informationen zu unserem Unternehmen und deiner Karriere bei Digitalagentur1 haben möchtest, findest du diese auf .

Auf unserem YouTube-Kanal erhältst du persönliche Einblicke in den Arbeitsalltag bei Digitalagentur1 - authentisch, direkt und auf Augenhöhe: .

Requirements

Das ist bei uns Voraussetzung

Du hast bereits mit mindestens einem dieser DATEV-Programme gearbeitet:

  • DATEV Rechnungswesen oder

  • DATEV Personalwirtschaft - also LODAS oder Lohn und Gehalt

Eines von beiden solltest du aus der Praxis kennen. Alles Weitere bringen wir dir bei.

Das solltest du außerdem mitbringen

  • Du erklärst gerne und hast Geduld, auch wenn du dieselbe Frage zum dritten Mal beantwortest.

  • Du arbeitest sorgfältig, verbindlich und hältst dich an vereinbarte Abläufe.

  • Du bist sicher am Rechner und findest dich in neuer Software schnell zurecht.

  • Du kommunizierst freundlich und klar - am Telefon genauso wie schriftlich.

  • Du arbeitest im Homeoffice selbstständig und zuverlässig und hast eine stabile Internetleitung.

Du hast bisher nur in einem Bereich gearbeitet?

Kein Problem. Ob Rechnungswesen oder Personalwirtschaft - den Rest bringen wir dir bei. Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung in einem bestimmten Beruf ist keine Voraussetzung, deine Erfahrung zählt mehr als dein Abschluss.

Du möchtest dein DATEV-Wissen weitergeben, statt es jeden Monat für dieselben Mandanten anzuwenden? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Highlights

100 % Homeoffice – deutschlandweit, ohne Reisetätigkeit

Attraktive Vergütung – faires Festgehalt nach Erfahrung

Volle Einarbeitung – ein Bereich reicht zum Start

About Us

We are dedicated to helping uninsured and self-pay patients by negotiating medical bills on their behalf. Through a structured process of investigation, fair price determination, and negotiation, we advocate for patients by leveraging billing expertise, price transparency data, and legal advocacy pathways. Our mission is to ensure patients are treated fairly, free from unjust or inflated medical debt.

Position Overview

The General Manager reports to the Chief Operating Officer and is responsible for the strategy, performance, and evolution of our bill negotiation services, where we help patients resolve unreasonable medical bills.

We already have a Patient Advocate Manager responsible for the team, processes, and day-to-day negotiation operations. The General Manager will operate above that layer, owning where bill negotiation is going, how we improve our effectiveness, and what capabilities we need to build next.

We need someone who wakes up every day thinking about how we can become a stronger advocate for patients.

What You'll Own

Strategy & GrowthSet our strategic direction and determine how our capabilities should evolve as CrowdHealth grows. Identify opportunities to increase our effectiveness, leverage, and impact.

Negotiation StrategyDevelop stronger approaches to difficult negotiations, particularly large balances, non-responsive providers, and cases that have reached an impasse. Use results and data to determine what's working, what's not, and what we should try next.

Legal & External StrategyPartner with attorneys and other experts to develop strategies around medical billing, collections, consumer protections, and patient rights. Build external relationships and partnerships that give us additional tools and leverage.

Business PerformanceOwn bill negotiations overall performance, budget, and resource strategy. Translate operational results into strategic decisions about where we should invest, change course, or build new capabilities.

CrowdHealth IntegrationTurn what bill negotiation learns from difficult medical bills into insights that improve CrowdHealth's broader cost-control strategy. Identify recurring provider, pricing, and billing patterns that we can address upstream.

What Success Looks Like

  • Bill Negotiations has a clear strategy and roadmap for its next stage of growth.
  • Difficult and stalled negotiations have stronger escalation strategies.
  • You develops new legal, data, and external capabilities that increase its effectiveness.
  • Your insights actively influence CrowdHealth's broader cost-control strategy.
  • Bill Negotiation scales without requiring resources to grow proportionally with membership.
  • Executive leadership has clear visibility into Bill Negotiations performance, opportunities, and risks without needing to manage the business day to day.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for a strategic operator who is comfortable building where there isn't already a playbook.

You may come from healthcare strategy, medical billing, revenue cycle, cost containment, patient advocacy, legal operations, consulting, or another complex negotiation environment.

You should be able to think several moves ahead, use data to make decisions, build relationships with attorneys and industry experts, understand business economics, and operate with significant autonomy.

Most importantly, you should be energized by the challenge at the center of Bill Negotiations:

How do we give patients more leverage when they're facing an unreasonable medical bill?

Compensation & Benefits

  • Full time annual salary of $140,000 - $150,000 depending on experience
  • Equity
  • Fully Remote
  • 12 weeks paid maternity/paternity leave
  • 401(k)
  • Unlimited PTO

Join Us

If you’re excited by the idea of joining a company that’s rewriting the rules of healthcare, we’d love to talk.

  • This role is open to US residents of all states other than New York, New Jersey, California, and Rhode Island.

Expression of Interest · Inquire First

We are meeting senior leaders for this planned function as we fundraise. This is an exploratory conversation, not an immediately funded salaried vacancy or a guaranteed start date. No cash salary is available today; any equity arrangement must be agreed separately. You are not being asked to begin work by expressing interest.

Use the Apply form below to introduce yourself and indicate your interest. We can discuss mutual fit, scope, funding, compensation, and timing before either side makes a commitment.

Remote · United States · Full time · Functional leadership

Make large experimental workloads dependable and economically understandable. Build the infrastructure function that lets scientists and product engineers run, inspect, and reproduce work without hiding failures or costs.

Why Subconscious

Subconscious is building the intelligence to run the economy. We start with a simulator for business decisions, using causal experiments on simulated markets to test products, pricing, messaging, and go-to-market choices before capital is committed. The long-term ambition is to help businesses discover unmet demand and build around what people actually need.

The function you will build

Own infrastructure architecture, operational reliability, observability, capacity planning, and infrastructure hiring priorities. Set engineering standards for workload isolation, recovery, and cost attribution. Coordinate security requirements with the company owners and appropriate specialists.

This is a hands-on leadership role. Set the functional roadmap and propose staffing and spending priorities with the founding team. Hiring and budget commitments depend on approved resources; an established team or funded budget is not assumed.

Proposed first 90 days after joining

Use these as an initial agenda, refined with the founders against the product, customer needs, and resources at your start.

  • Map the execution path and establish baselines for workload success, queue time, latency, recoverability, and unit cost.

  • Identify the highest-consequence failure modes and implement clear retry, checkpoint, rollback, and incident procedures.

  • Make spend attributable to workloads and customers, with actionable limits and capacity forecasts.

  • Document the operational contract and propose a staffing and infrastructure budget tied to measured demand.

How we will judge progress

Experiments complete predictably, failures are diagnosable, and teams can explain the cost of serving a workload. Set service objectives from customer needs and current measurements, then show improvements in reliability, recovery time, and cost per completed experiment.

What you bring

  • You have owned production infrastructure and led meaningful reliability or platform work through growth, incidents, and difficult cost tradeoffs.

  • You can design distributed job execution and reason about idempotency, concurrency, isolation, observability, and failure recovery.

  • You can lead engineers while still debugging a production issue and reviewing the implementation yourself.

We are looking for evidence of judgment, execution, and leadership. A particular company pedigree or previous executive title is not a substitute for that evidence.

Compensation and funding

We are actively fundraising. Only equity-based compensation is currently available; no cash salary is available today. The equity grant and its terms have not been set for this role and must be agreed before joining. Any future salary, incentive plan, benefits, hiring budget, or paid start date depends on financing and written agreement. Funding and its timing are not guaranteed.

Before deciding to join, discuss the grant structure, fully diluted ownership basis, vesting, dilution, applicable exercise terms, company funding position, and working arrangement. A company valuation is not the cash value of an equity grant.

How we work

Remote · United States. The planned role is full time; timing is to be agreed. Expect direct collaboration with the founders, work across scientific and commercial boundaries, and responsibility for doing the early work yourself. The current role does not include visa sponsorship. Confirm practical collaboration hours and any travel expectations during the initial conversation.

Start with work you already own

Describe a production failure or scaling constraint you owned. What evidence identified the cause, what tradeoff did you make, and how did you verify the fix?

Please do not share confidential employer or customer materials. Bring your questions about our product, evidence, team, finances, and the authority attached to the role. Mutual diligence matters for a decision of this size.

Order.co is the System of Action for the Office of the CFO, transforming the way businesses purchase and pay into an intuitive, B2C-like shopping experience. Order.co leverages embedded AI agents and embedded financial products to reinvent the way businesses connect with their vendors.

End users enjoy a seamless, zero-training buying experience, while finance and procurement leaders gain a single platform to orchestrate how the business “should operate”. The result is an all-in-one solution that serves as a gravitational pull for spend and data, automating and eliminating procurement and finance workflows from requisition to reconciliation along the way.

Order.co is on the cutting edge of B2B Agentic Commerce, poised to be the market leader in creating a more predictive, prescriptive, and personalized experience for users.

Founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York City, Order.co oversees nearly half a billion in annualized spend across hundreds of customers like WeWork, SoulCycle, Lume, and [solidcore]. Order.co has raised $75M in funding from industry-leading investors like MIT, Stage 2 Capital, Rally Ventures, 645 Ventures, and more. Order.co has been proudly named a 50 to Watch by Spend Matters and a Best Place to Work by BuiltIn and Inc. Magazine.

The Role

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer on the Platform team, you will ensure that software systems are reliable, scalable, performant, and operationally efficient. You blend software engineering skills with infrastructure and operations expertise to keep critical systems running smoothly while enabling rapid product development.

Responsibilities

Reliability Engineering & Infrastructure Ownership

  • Design, build, and operate highly available, scalable, and fault-tolerant infrastructure and platform services
  • Own reliability, availability, latency, and operational excellence for critical production systems and services
  • Define and maintain service level objectives (SLOs), service level indicators (SLIs), and error budgets across platform systems
  • Lead incident response efforts for complex production outages; drive root-cause analysis and long-term remediation actions
  • Build resilient systems that gracefully handle failures, traffic spikes, dependency degradation, and regional outages
  • Continuously improve system reliability through automation, observability, performance tuning, and capacity planning

Automation & Platform Engineering

  • Develop infrastructure automation and self-service tooling to reduce operational toil and improve engineering velocity
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and release engineering workflows
  • Implement infrastructure as code (IaC) practices using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, and container orchestration
  • Improve developer experience by building reliable internal platforms, operational tooling, and standardized deployment patterns
  • Drive adoption of GitOps, immutable infrastructure, and automated remediation patterns

Observability & Operational Excellence

  • Design and maintain comprehensive monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting systems for distributed services
  • Establish actionable alerting standards that reduce noise while improving incident detection and response times
  • Analyze production trends, system bottlenecks, and failure patterns to proactively prevent incidents
  • Lead operational readiness reviews, disaster recovery planning, and game-day exercises
  • Improve mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to recovery (MTTR) through tooling, automation, and process refinement

Systems Architecture & Scalability

  • Participate actively in architecture and infrastructure design reviews
  • Propose scalable and reliable platform designs that account for multi-region deployment, redundancy, failover, and security considerations
  • Evaluate trade-offs between reliability, scalability, operational complexity, and engineering velocity
  • Identify systemic risks and operational gaps before they become production incidents
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure services are designed with operability, observability, and resilience in mind from day one

Security & Compliance

  • Approach infrastructure and operational practices with a strong security mindset
  • Implement and maintain secure cloud networking, secrets management, IAM policies, and infrastructure hardening standards
  • Partner with Security and Compliance teams to ensure systems meet organizational and regulatory requirements
  • Drive operational best practices around vulnerability management, patching, and production access controls

End-to-End Ownership & Collaboration

  • Scope and estimate infrastructure and reliability initiatives accurately
  • Coordinate production rollouts, maintenance events, and reliability improvements across teams
  • Communicate operational risks, dependencies, and incident impacts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Collaborate closely with Software Engineering, Security, Product, and Operations teams to improve platform reliability and scalability
  • Serve as a trusted escalation point during critical production incidents

Mentorship & Technical Leadership

  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on reliability engineering principles, operational excellence, and infrastructure best practices
  • Raise the operational maturity of the engineering organization through documentation, reviews, and technical guidance
  • Drive improvements in team standards around observability, incident management, automation, and infrastructure design
  • Influence technical decisions through credibility, operational expertise, and strong engineering judgment

Qualifications

  • You are motivated by accountability — you own outcomes, not just tasks
  • You are results-oriented and measure success by shipped, working software
  • You are motivated by correctness in code that touches money — the consequences of a bug land on real customer balances, and you take that seriously
  • You love helping people on your team grow and improve
  • Writing tests is an integral part of your development process, not an afterthought
  • You know how to design and build software incrementally — you don't need a complete spec to make progress
  • Collaborating with the people around you to achieve a goal motivates you
  • You are collaborative, open-minded, and actively developing your craft
  • You are curious and pragmatic about AI-driven solutions — you apply them where they add real value and stay skeptical where they don't
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools — you understand how they work, where they help, and where they fail. Prior hands-on use is a plus; intellectual curiosity and the instinct to evaluate AI output critically are what matter

Technical Skills

  • Strong foundation in computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and system design
  • Familiarity with building production-grade applications and services using Ruby and Ruby on Rails
  • Deep expertise with Linux systems administration and production troubleshooting
  • Strong experience operating cloud infrastructure at scale, particularly within AWS environments
  • Experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud-native infrastructure patterns
  • Proficiency with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation
  • Expertise designing and operating CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation systems
  • Deep understanding of observability tooling including Datadog, OpenTelemetry, or similar platforms
  • Strong knowledge of distributed systems reliability patterns including redundancy, failover, autoscaling, rate limiting, and graceful degradation
  • Experience building automation and operational tooling using languages such as Python, Go, Bash, or Ruby
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals including DNS, load balancing, TLS, VPNs, firewalls, and service discovery
  • Hands-on experience with incident response, root-cause analysis, and production operations in high-availability environments
  • Familiarity with SRE methodologies including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, capacity planning, and operational maturity modeling
  • Experience implementing secure infrastructure and cloud security best practices including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation
  • Proven ability to design scalable, resilient, and maintainable platform systems and APIs
  • Experience supporting distributed microservices architectures and event-driven systems
  • Strong understanding of operational excellence principles including automation-first engineering and toil reduction
  • Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) as force multipliers while applying sound operational and engineering judgment
  • Excellent debugging and systems thinking skills across infrastructure, networking, application, and platform layers

What Great Looks Like

A Senior Software Engineer on the Platform team who is thriving at this level demonstrates:

  • Reliable delivery of complex work — consistently ships multi-part solutions on time with low defect rates
  • Low defects in owned areas — proactively monitors and improves the quality of the systems they own; that means incident-free quarters in code paths that move funds and clean reconciliation against vendor reports
  • Measurable mentorship impact — engineers around you write better code because of your reviews and guidance

"Someone we can depend on for the work that matters — especially the work that touches money."

Failure Modes We Screen Against

We actively evaluate candidates for the following anti-patterns during the interview process:

Failure Mode

What It Looks Like

Strong coder, weak owner

Ships code but doesn't manage to the task — owns the merge, not the outcome; hands off and moves on without monitoring or fixing post-release issues

Solo expert

Hoards knowledge instead of sharing — becomes a single point of failure and blocks team growth

Overconfident designer

Proposes solutions without considering trade-offs — jumps to conclusions, resists alternative approaches

Rubber-stamper

Produces AI-generated output without verifying it against the codebase, tests, or business context

Interview Process

Our 5-round process is designed to evaluate you across all competency areas. AI tools are permitted in technical rounds.

Round

Format

What We Evaluate

1 — Hiring Manager Screen

60 min, conversational

Career trajectory, mentorship philosophy, technical influence examples, communication style

2 — Take-Home + PR Discussion

72h take-home + 60 min live

Navigating unfamiliar code, ownership and decomposition discipline visible in your PR, root-cause judgment, AI tool usage

3 — System Design + Artifact Critique

60 min, Miro board

Requirements gathering, schema/API design, trade-off articulation, calibrated code-review judgment on a teammate's PR

4 — Team Interview (conditional)

30 min, behavioral

Collaboration patterns, mentorship behavior, negotiation behavior with cross-functional partners

5 — Culture Add

30 min, People Team

Organizational values alignment

Round 4 is conditional: it runs when the team needs additional behavioral signal after Rounds 2 and 3, and is otherwise skipped. Your recruiter will tell you whether it's scheduled before your loop is finalized.

The Round 2 (Take-Home + PR Discussion) and Round 3 (System Design) exercises are drawn from real problems so the technical evaluation is grounded in the work you'd actually be doing.

What You’ll Receive

  • Competitive compensation
  • Employer-sponsored 401(k) with match
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible time off and hybrid work environment

The anticipated annual salary range for this role is $175,000 - $200,000. Actual compensation and title will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, knowledge, and skills.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Peraton Labs is seeking a Senior Cyber Security Engineerto help establish, maintain, and mature the written compliance posture of our Agentic AI platform environment. This individual will play a critical role in ensuring our documented security and compliance artifacts accurately reflect the infrastructure, controls, and operational realities of the platform.

This role will own the development and maintenance of core compliance documentation, including System Security Plans (SSPs), supporting policies and standard operating procedures, POA&M management, and audit evidence coordination. This role will ensure proper security control implementation and be responsible for end-to-end Risk Management Framework (RMF) and Authority to Operate (ATO) compliance. The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, strong in policy and control documentation, and comfortable working closely with platform and security engineers to translate technical implementation into clear, auditor-ready language.

This is a high-trust role at the intersection of compliance, policy, and platform execution. The right candidate will serve as the connective tissue between what is written, what is required, and what is actually built and operated.

Key responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

  • Own and maintain the written compliance posture of the Agentic AI platform
  • Author, update, and evolve System Security Plans (SSPs) and related compliance artifacts in support of ATO and broader assessment efforts
  • Develop additional SSPs and associated documentation required to support expanding authorization needs
  • Build, organize, and maintain a comprehensive security policy and SOP library aligned to relevant control frameworks
  • Manage POA&Ms, including documenting gaps, tracking remediation progress, and maintaining visibility into open items
  • Coordinate and run evidence collection cycles in support of internal reviews, external assessments, and audit activities
  • Serve as the primary compliance point of contact for internal auditors, external assessors, and compliance stakeholders

jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a skilled Photoshop Specialist to execute high-precision, single-task manual image editing and pixel-perfect masking.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a skilled Photoshop Specialist to execute high-precision, single-task manual image editing and pixel-perfect masking. In this role, you will work on targeted image modifications while ensuring complete preservation of surrounding elements and strict compliance with visual quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Targeted Image Edits: Perform precise manual modifications such as adding, removing, or replacing objects; changing colors, textures, and materials; swapping backgrounds; editing text; or applying overall style adjustments based on given instructions.

  • Content Preservation: Keep all non-target elements intact, including background details, surrounding objects, layout, perspective, scale, lighting, grain, and scene structure.

  • Masking & Placement Guides: Create and apply 8-bit grayscale PNG edit masks (white = edit area, black = preserved area) and precise placement guides. Ensure local edit regions cover at least 0.88% of the total image area (e.g., minimum 48x48 px on a 512x512 canvas).

  • Deliverables & Metadata: Provide clean, full-resolution files (PNG/TIFF) matching source dimensions. Fill in required metadata fields (Task ID, source/output IDs, editor ID, licensing status, provenance, timestamp).

  • Escalation Handling: Identify and report ambiguous instructions, missing assets, policy issues, or infeasible requirements immediately.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Strict No-AI Rule: Zero use of AI tools, Generative Fill, AI inpainting, neural filters, auto-segmentation, or AI-generated metadata. All edits must be 100% manual.

  • Software Expertise: Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Nuke, or equivalent professional image-editing software. Strong grasp of layer management, non-destructive editing, perspective matching, and color grading.

  • Attention to Detail: Ability to integrate edits seamlessly without introducing seams, halos, distorted geometry, repeated patterns, or lighting mismatches.

Package & Deliverables

  • Final Images: Full-resolution PNG or TIFF files matching original dimensions.

  • Mask Assets: 8-bit grayscale PNG edit masks and placement guides (when required).

  • Source Files: Layered PSD or Nuke scripts (upon audit request).

Hiring process:

  • Recruiter Intro Call : A quick, friendly chat to get to know the candidate, check their English skills (B2+ level requirement), discuss shift availability (8/23), walk through the project scope, and confirm our strict No-AI policy.

  • Technical Assessment: A short practical test where candidates showcase their hands-on skills in manual editing, 8-bit PNG mask creation, and clean PSD/Nuke layer structure.

  • Onboarding & Project Launch: Signing the independent contractor agreement, sharing project guides and documentation, and getting the candidate ready to take on their first tasks under initial QA support.

jobs.description:
THE CHISHOLM LEGACY PROJECT SUMMARY:

The mission of the Chisholm Legacy Project is rooted in the Just Transition Framework. The project serves as a vehicle to connect Black communities on the frontlines of climate justice with resources to traverse the path from vision to strategy to action plan to implementation to transformation. In support of frontline leadership, the project seeks to link movements and mainstream entities with the tools necessary to advance systems change centered in equity and justice. With Black women on the frontlines of advancing systems change, this project ensures that these leaders have the support they need as they transform society from extractivism to a living economy that cares for sacred relationships between people and with Mother Earth, through regenerative, cooperative, democratic systems.

SUMMARY OF THEPOSITION:

The organization seeks a Senior Managing Director of Organizing with a commitment to supporting Black Liberation and a willingness to be on a learning journey, joining an institution that is grounded in Black Liberation, Climate Justice, and Just Transition. This position serves as a key member of the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), providing strategic oversight and leadership to ensure alignment between programs, organizing, and strategy within The Chisholm Legacy Project (TCLP). The role is responsible for supervising senior programmatic leaders, fostering a culture centered on Black Liberation and Just Transition, and ensuring that TCLP’s work is mission-driven and community-centered.

Additionally, the Senior Managing Director of Organizing acts as a connector and facilitator, ensuring effective collaboration across departments, guiding organizing, and maintaining accountability for outcomes and impact. The SMDO also plays a critical role in assessing partnerships, representing TCLP in national spaces, and advancing key strategic initiatives to support just transition, including climate justice, gender justice, and Black liberation.

This position will be responsible for ensuring strategic alignment and consistent communication with the programs team in partnership with the Senior Managing Director of Programs.

Roles & Responsibilities

    Senior Leadership & Organizational Strategy

  • Serve on the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) contributing to mission, vision, strategy, and work plan development.
  • Collaborate with ELT to nurture an organizational culture centering Black Liberation and Just Transition.
  • Ensure organizational practices reflect connection, fulfillment, care, support, and purpose-driven accountability.
  • Provide co-leadership in fostering a culture that aligns with TCLP’s values.

    • Organizing Strategy, Infrastructure, and Movement Alignment

    • Provide executive leadership for the organization’s organizing function, ensuring that organizing strategy and structure advance TCLP’s broader mission, strategy, and movement-building goals.
    • Set the strategic direction for organizing approaches across regions, ensuring alignment with a community-centered theory of change and consistency in how outreach, engagement, and strategies are designed and deployed.
    • Ensure the development of a cohesive, organization-wide organizing framework that integrates tools and methodologies such as power mapping, narrative strategy, digital engagement, and community visioning.
    • Drive the evolution of innovative organizing strategies, and engagement models that strengthen grassroots leadership, deepen community relationships, and contribute to sustained environmental justice outcomes.
    • Cultivate and steward a robust ecosystem of partnerships across local, regional, and national stakeholders; including cross-movement, faith-based, and environmental justice organizations to expand collective impact and resource alignment for frontline communities.
    • Ensure alignment and integration between organizing and other core functions, including programs, communications, policy, research, and resource development, to support cohesive, constituency-driven strategies.
    • Provide strategic oversight of the structures, systems, and resource flows that enable effective organizing, ensuring alignment between priorities, investments, and long-term sustainability.

      • Team Leadership & Supervision

    • Provide supportive supervision to the Managing Director of Just Transition Municipalities Institute, Senior Director of Organizing and Senior Director of Narrative Strategy.
    • Ensure all direct reports and their teams have clear work plans and adhere to TCLP’s performance management system.
    • Maintain full accountability for departmental impact, balancing trust in team members with active verification.

      • Just Transition Municipal Strategy and Movement Integration

      • Provide executive oversight and strategic direction for TCLP’s Just Transition municipal strategy, ensuring alignment with TCLP’s broader organizing vision, and long-term goals.
      • Ensure the design and evolution of a scalable, multi-tiered engagement model that supports municipalities at varying levels of readiness, expanding access to Just Transition frameworks, tools, and pathways for implementation across diverse communities.
      • Steward the advancement of a national municipal ecosystem that enables local governments; particularly those serving historically disenfranchised communities; to adopt and implement community-driven Just Transition approaches.
      • Ensure the integration of leadership development and wellbeing-centered frameworks within municipal strategies, with a particular emphasis on advancing and sustaining Black femme leadership in local governance.
      • Drive the alignment of municipal organizing efforts with broader state, national, and global advocacy strategies, positioning Just Transition municipalities as a catalyst for systems-level policy change and widespread model adoption.

Ensure the team’s partnerships, and capacity-building efforts, including convenings, are aligned with organizational strategy and effectively connect movement organizations to TCLP’s programs, resources, and strategic opportunities.
        • Alignment Initiatives: Guide the strategic development of the Alignment Initiatives to advance inclusion, agency, and leadership for historically disenfranchised Black communities within the movements for climate justice and Black Liberation.

        • Oversee the development and execution of key narrative initiatives and platforms, including the Black Climate Justice Toastmasters Initiative, Our Stories, Our Narratives Digital Media and Film Initiative, story library development, and narrative analysis to inform TCLP’s Just Transition communications strategy and messaging platform.

          • Partnerships & External Representation

Qualifications

jobs.description:
Du bist Steuerfachangestellte/r und kennst DATEV aus dem Arbeitsalltag? Dann setz dein Wissen dort ein, wo es gebraucht wird: ohne Abgabefristen, komplett im Homeoffice und auf Wunsch in Teilzeit.

Wir sind die Digitalagentur1 und begleiten Steuerkanzleien in ganz Deutschland bei DATEV und der Digitalisierung. Unsere Kunden sind ausschließlich Steuerberater. Deren Mandanten betreust du nicht, und Belege buchst du auch nicht. Du schulst und berätst die Kanzleiteams, damit dort alles sauber läuft.

Warum ohne Fristendruck?

In der Kanzlei bestimmen Abgabetermine, Lohnläufe zum Monatsende und die Abschlusssaison deinen Kalender. Bei uns nicht: Du erstellst keine Steuererklärungen, keine Abschlüsse und keine Lohnabrechnungen. Deine Arbeit sind geplante Schulungen und Beratungstermine mit Kanzleien.

Pia war 7 Jahre in der Steuerkanzlei. Warum sie gewechselt hat:

Deine Aufgaben

  • Beratung: Du begleitest Kanzleien bei Umstellungen, zum Beispiel auf digitale Belege, DATEV Unternehmen online, DATEV Arbeitnehmer online oder die digitale Personalakte.

  • Support: Du beantwortest DATEV-Rückfragen aus den Kanzleien, per Telefon, Videocall und Fernwartung direkt am Bildschirm.

  • Prozesse und Checklisten: Du entwickelst unsere Abläufe mit weiter, damit jeder Vorgang nach demselben klaren Standard läuft.

  • Kein Fristendruck: Keine Abgabetermine, keine Abschlusssaison, kein Stress beim Lohn zum Monatsende.

  • Teilzeit möglich: Ab 22 Stunden pro Woche, Vollzeit sind 40 Stunden.

  • Klare Abläufe: Feste Prozesse und Checklisten statt Improvisation. Du weißt jeden Tag, woran du bist.

  • Ein Team hinter dir: Auch im Homeoffice bist du nicht allein. Bei Fragen hilft dir das Team jederzeit weiter.

Was wir bieten

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen.

  • Vollständige Einarbeitung: Wir gehen alle Themen gemeinsam durch, üben sie mit dir und lassen dich erst eigenständig arbeiten, wenn du dich sicher fühlst.

  • Laufende Weiterbildung, damit du fachlich immer auf dem aktuellen Stand bist.

  • Kollegiale Atmosphäre: Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang und unterstützen uns gegenseitig.

„Nur noch die schönen Seiten vom Beruf“: Eine Kollegin erzählt von Bewerbung, Einarbeitung und Alltag:

Zwei wichtige Hinweise

Die Tätigkeit ist ausschließlich aus Deutschland oder dem europäischen Ausland möglich. Und weil bei uns alles online läuft, brauchst du zu Hause eine stabile Internetleitung.

jobs.title: AI Engineer (Computer Vision and Applied GenAI)
jobs.excerpt: Location: Amman, Jordan.  Fully remote.  Type: Full-time, permanent.
jobs.description:
Location: Amman, Jordan. Fully remote.

Type: Full-time, permanent.

Level: Mid-level, roughly 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience.

Languages: English required. German is a strong plus.

About the role

We are looking for an AI Engineer based in Amman who will work remotely with a distributed engineering team. This is a builder role, not a research role. You will take AI capabilities from prototype to something that runs reliably in production, and you will own your work end to end: the model, the data around it, the service that serves it, and the evidence that it actually works.

The work spans two areas. On one side, computer vision and perception: camera pipelines, object detection and recognition, and inference that has to run fast and stay stable. On the other, applied generative AI: LLM-based features, retrieval, agents, and the evaluation harnesses that keep them honest. You will not be handed a narrow slice of either. You will be expected to move between them and to build the plumbing that connects them to a real product.

Tasks

  • Design, train, fine-tune and evaluate models for vision tasks (detection, classification, segmentation, tracking) and integrate them into production pipelines.
  • Build LLM-powered features: retrieval-augmented generation, tool-using agents, structured extraction, and the prompt and evaluation infrastructure behind them.
  • Write the services around the models: APIs, data pipelines, batch and streaming jobs, storage.
  • Optimise for the target hardware, including quantisation, batching, and inference on edge devices where cloud inference is not an option.
  • Define and track quality metrics. Establish a baseline before claiming an improvement, and be able to show where a number came from.
  • Instrument, monitor and debug models in production: drift, latency, failure modes, and the unglamorous work of finding out why a pipeline broke at 3am.
  • Work directly with product and business stakeholders to turn a vague need into a scoped, measurable deliverable.
  • Document what you build so that the next engineer does not have to reverse-engineer it.

Requirements

  • 3 to 5 years building and shipping machine learning or AI systems in production. Personal projects and Kaggle notebooks alone will not cover this.
  • Strong Python. Clean, tested, reviewable code, not notebook-only output.
  • Practical depth in at least one of the two areas below, and working familiarity with the other:
  • Computer vision: PyTorch or TensorFlow, OpenCV, modern detection and segmentation architectures, dataset creation and annotation workflows.
  • Applied GenAI: LLM APIs and open-weight models, RAG, embeddings and vector stores, agent frameworks, prompt design, and systematic evaluation.
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: Git, code review, testing, CI, Docker, and comfort on the Linux command line.
  • Experience deploying a model as a service and keeping it running, including cloud deployment (AWS, Azure or GCP) and basic observability.
  • SQL and general data handling: you can find, clean and reason about the data before modelling it.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, and the self-direction that remote work requires. You are comfortable writing things down, flagging blockers early, and working without someone checking in on you hourly.

Strong plus

  • German language skills. Part of the team and a meaningful share of the documentation, meetings and stakeholder communication are in German. Any level from solid B1 upward is a real advantage, and it will widen the scope of what you can own. It is not a hard requirement, and we will support you in improving it.
  • Edge and embedded inference: NVIDIA Jetson, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO.
  • Video streaming and industrial camera work: RTSP, GStreamer, GenICam, machine vision cameras.
  • MLOps tooling: MLflow, Weights and Biases, DVC, Kubernetes, model registries.
  • Experience in an industrial, robotics, IoT or B2B product environment.
  • A public track record: open source contributions, technical writing, or published work.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the Amman market for this level.
  • Fully remote setup.
  • Real ownership of features that reach customers, rather than proof-of-concept work that is quietly shelved.
  • Direct exposure to the European market and to senior technical decision making.

How we work

  • Remote-first, with asynchronous written communication as the default and a reasonable overlap window with the European working day.
  • Small teams, short decision paths, and direct access to the people who set priorities.
  • We prefer a working pilot with a clear owner and a measurable outcome over a long specification.
  • Human oversight, data protection and security are part of the definition of done, not an afterthought bolted on before launch.

jobs.title: Reputation & AI Visibility Specialist
jobs.excerpt: About Eleanor Health At Eleanor Health we are helping people affected by addiction live amazing lives.
jobs.description:
About Eleanor Health

At Eleanor Health we are helping people affected by addiction live amazing lives. We work to fulfill this goal by building and growing the first addiction and mental health services provider designed to deliver a longitudinal, whole-person, value-based model of care for each community member. Our team is ambitious and committed to this unique opportunity, and understands the importance of attracting strong and experienced talent to make our vision for Eleanor Health a reality every day, and for every recovery journey we are entrusted to be a part of.

About the Role

When someone searches for a suboxone doctor near them, asks an AI assistant where to get help with drinking, or reads a community thread about virtual addiction treatment, we want Eleanor Health to show up — accurately, warmly, and in a way that helps them take the next step.

Today, these responsibilities are distributed across several people without dedicated operational ownership. You would become the hands-on owner responsible for turning that strategy into consistent execution.

As the Reputation & AI Visibility Specialist, you will own how Eleanor Health appears across the places people actually look for treatment: business listings and healthcare directories in every market we serve, reviews, recovery communities, earned media, and the AI assistants and AI-generated search results that an increasing share of people now ask first.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of local search, reputation management, community engagement, and the emerging discipline of getting recommended by AI. It is not a brand awareness position with soft metrics — it is an acquisition role with a number attached, and it carries a capability our growth plan depends on.

We will also be honest with you about what you would be walking into. Today we manage our directory presence off the side of several desks, and we do it poorly. Reviews are unmanaged. Nobody is watching what community members say about us. You would inherit a real mess and a real opportunity, in roughly equal measure.

This role reports to the Sr. Manager, Organic & AI Visibility.

What You'll Do

Local Presence & Directory Integrity

  • Own Eleanor Health's business listings across every market we serve, including Google Business Profile, Apple Business Connect, and Bing Places
  • Manage healthcare directory and health plan provider directory listings, and the data aggregators that feed them
  • Audit and remediate name, address, and phone consistency across all platforms and markets
  • Establish and maintain category strategy, service listings, hours, attributes, and profile completeness
  • Build and maintain a system of record for listings so accuracy does not depend on any one person's memory
  • Identify and resolve listing suppressions, duplicates, and unverified profiles
  • Partner with content and web owners to ensure location data, service information, and other entity information remain consistent between EleanorHealth.com and external listings/directories

Reviews & Reputation Management

  • Design and operate an ethical review generation program in partnership with clinical and access teams, with patient privacy protected absolutely and no incentivization or gating
  • Respond to reviews across platforms with warmth, care, and without defensiveness
  • Monitor review volume, rating, and sentiment by market and surface patterns to clinical and operations leadership
  • Partner with Compliance and Legal to ensure all review practices meet HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2 requirements
  • Maintain an escalation process for reviews or reputation issues requiring clinical, compliance, legal, or operational response

AI Visibility & Discoverability

  • Establish a baseline for how often and how accurately AI assistants and AI-generated search results recommend Eleanor Health, then improve it
  • Monitor for material misinformation about Eleanor Health, and about addiction treatment generally, in AI-generated responses
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen Eleanor Health's entity signals, citations, authoritative third-party mentions, and other external signals that influence AI discoverability and recommendation
  • Partner with the content, web, and technical SEO functions to translate AI visibility findings into prioritized website improvements, including structured content, metadata, internal linking, location content, structured data, and other discoverability enhancements
  • Track and report AI citation and recommendation share on a regular cadence
  • Stay current in a discipline that is being invented in real time, and help invent it here
  • Implement approved discoverability updates in Sanity and other marketing platforms where appropriate

Community Engagement

  • Monitor how Eleanor Health and virtual addiction treatment are discussed in recovery communities, forums, and social platforms
  • Participate transparently and helpfully as an identified representative of Eleanor Health, never anonymously
  • Surface community sentiment, recurring concerns, and misinformation to marketing and clinical leadership
  • Support and manage organic social activity where it directly advances discoverability, community engagement, or reputation goals

Earned Media & Editorial Distribution

  • Manage the day-to-day public relations agency relationship in alignment with established priorities, including setting priorities, triaging inbound opportunities, and holding the agency accountable to outcomes
  • Brief Eleanor Health spokespeople ahead of media opportunities
  • Own hands-on editorial distribution and syndication efforts to strengthen Eleanor Health’s authority, earn relevant backlinks and citations, and grow referring domains in priority markets
  • Evaluate earned media and distribution opportunities based on their potential contribution to authority, discoverability, reputation, and enrollment impact

Measurement & Reporting

  • Build and maintain your own reporting on listings accuracy, review performance, AI citation share, and earned coverage
  • Partner with our analytics consultant to attribute non-paid new member volume accurately
  • Report performance on a monthly cadence and be able to defend an attribution claim

You'll Be a Good Fit If You:

  • Are a genuine hands-on operator who does the work rather than directing it — multi-market listing management is tedious and unglamorous, and you have to find that acceptable
  • Find the constraints of a regulated healthcare environment energizing rather than frustrating, and raise your hand before crossing a line rather than after
  • Write well, and understand that tone matters enormously when the audience is someone on the hardest day of their life
  • Are self-directed and able to identify and resolve gaps without being prompted
  • Are comfortable being measured, and would rather own a number than a set of activities
  • Approach your work with compassion, knowing that a correct directory listing is sometimes the difference between someone finding care and giving up

Skills and Competencies:

  • Experience — roughly 3+ years in digital marketing with real depth in local SEO, reputation management, or digital PR, including hands-on multi-location listing management
  • Reputation management — experience building or running a review generation and response program
  • Tooling — fluency with SEO and local tooling. Our stack includes Ahrefs, BrightLocal, Local Falcon, Otterly.ai, and Screaming Frog. You should be comfortable in tools like these and able to tell us which ones we are using wrong
  • Writing — strong written communication across review responses, community posts, and media briefs
  • Analytical — comfort building your own reporting and defending your numbers
  • Judgment — sound decision-making in a space with hard compliance constraints around patient privacy
  • Adaptability — comfortable learning new systems and working in a discipline that is still taking shape

Helpful but not required:

  • Behavioral health, addiction treatment, or healthcare marketing experience
  • Early hands-on work in generative engine optimization or AI search visibility
  • Working knowledge of structured data and schema markup
  • Real, disclosed participation in online communities
  • Multi-market or multi-location experience at any scale

What This Role Is Not:

We would rather be clear now than waste your time.

  • Not primarily a media relations seat. We retain a PR agency for pitching and placement; you would direct them. If hands-on media relations is the work you love most, you would find this role only partly satisfying.
  • Not a paid media role. Paid search and paid media sit elsewhere on the team.
  • Not a content writing role. We have a content strategist and a copywriter. You will write a great deal, but not long-form content.
  • Not a growth-hacking role. No incentivized or gated reviews, no undisclosed community participation, and no shortcuts that trade a person's trust for a metric. We will turn down tactics that work if they are not honest, and we would want you to be the person raising your hand first.

Compensation & Benefits

The total target compensation range for this position is $70,000-80,000. The actual compensation offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include, as applicable, the applicant’s qualifications for the position; years of relevant experience; specific and unique skills; level of education attained; certifications or other professional licenses held; other legitimate, non-discriminatory business factors specific to the position; and the geographic location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will perform the job.

Eleanor Health offers a generous benefits package to full-time employees, which includes:

  • Generous Paid Time Off (prorated for new employees) - unplug, relax, and recharge!
    • 12 Vacation days
    • 12 Wellness (Sick) days
    • 3 Floating holidays
    • 9 Company-observed holidays
    • Jury Duty, Voting Leave, and other forms of paid time off may be available
  • Eleanor-paid medical and dental insurance plans, with affordable vision coverage -We are a health first company, and we strive to make our plans affordable and accessible.
  • 401(k) plan with 3% match - We are excited to be able to support the long-term financial well-being of our team in a way that reinforces Eleanor’s commitment to equity.
  • Short-term disability - We understand that things happen, we want you to feel comfortable to take time to get better.
  • Long Term Disability - Picks up where Short Term Disability leaves off (employee paid).

  • Langfristige Karriereentwicklung inklusive Fortbildungsbudget, internem Bildungsurlaub und der eigenen torq.academy
  • Einheitliche und transparente Gehaltsstruktur mit einem Fixgehalt von 62.000-70.000€ und einem auslastungsabhängigen Bonus

  • Optimierung & Digitalisierung: Identifikation und Implementierung effizienter Finance-Prozesse, Automatisierungen und passender Tools

  • Stakeholder-Management: Zusammenarbeit mit Steuerberatern, CFOs, Finanzbehörden und weiteren relevanten Schnittstellen

  • Gute Excel / Google Sheets Kenntnisse sowie eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit einem Auge für Optimierungspotenziale

  • Erfahrung in der Automatisierung und Optimierung von Prozessen sowie der Implementierung von Tools

  • Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Deutsch (ca. C1) und Englisch (ca. B2)

WOFÜR WIR STEHEN:Wir existieren, um unternehmerische Handlungsfähigkeit verantwortungsvoll und wirksam zu stärken. In einer Organisation, die auf kontinuierliches Lernen und schnelle Anpassungsfähigkeit setzt und die auch auf gesellschaftlicher Ebene einen wesentlichen Beitrag leisten will: integrativ, fair und mit gutem Beispiel vorangehend.

Throughout the internship, you’ll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and develop as a future professional while making a meaningful impact. The Cybersecurity Engineering Intern should be a strong communicator and collaborator, capable of presenting ideas in both technical and user-friendly terms while helping shape the future of Southwest’s Technology Team.If hired, Interns may be selected to support one of the following Teams:

Identity and Access Management

The Identity and Access Management (IAM) Team develops and supports the solutions that manage digital identities and secure access to applications, systems, and data across Southwest. As a Cybersecurity Engineer Intern, you will gain hands-on experience supporting modern identity governance and administration initiatives while working with enterprise identity platforms, automation, and access management technologies. You'll collaborate with Cybersecurity Engineers and Technology Teams to help improve identity lifecycle management, streamline legacy processes, and enhance security through automation and AI-driven capabilities. This internship provides valuable exposure to identity and access management practices and demonstrates how secure, efficient access enables and protects enterprise technology operations.

Cloud Cyber Security

The Cloud Cyber Security Team engineers and secures the cloud platforms and services that support Southwest's technology ecosystem. As a Cybersecurity Engineer Intern, you will gain hands-on experience helping design, implement, and support cloud security solutions that enable secure and scalable technology delivery. You'll collaborate with Cybersecurity Engineers and Technology Teams while gaining exposure to cloud security controls, infrastructure security, automation, secure development practices, threat detection, and security monitoring. This internship provides valuable exposure to modern cloud security engineering and demonstrates how technology enables the secure delivery of critical business and operational capabilities across Southwest.

  • Receive free, unlimited space available travel privileges for yourself (taxes and fees may apply on international travel).
  • Interns will be provided any required equipment, such as a laptop, for the internship.

This role is offered as a remote workplace position, which may require travel for trainings, meetings, conferences, etc. Outside of those required visits, the majority of your working time may be spent in an approved remote location, away from our Corporate Campus. Please note, while this is a remote position, there is limited group of states or localities ineligible for Employees to regularly perform their work off-site. Those ineligible locations are: Alaska, California, Colorado, Delaware, Illinois, Iowa, Massachusetts, Maryland, Montana, New Jersey, New Hampshire New York, North Dakota, South Dakota, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Vermont, Washington, West Virginia, and Wyoming, and Puerto Rico.

We are committed to fair hiring practices and to making employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other legally protected characteristics.

Duties and Responsibilities

The duties and responsibilities of the Cybersecurity Engineering Intern may include but are not limited to:

  • Under supervision, may be responsible for vendor management, partner governance, and system oversight to deploy, monitor, and maintain secure solutions throughout their lifecycle.
  • Work with a Team to research issues, plan and recommend solutions, and support the coordination of system and software developments. This includes monitoring performance, identifying bottlenecks, and collaborating with partners to implement fixes.
  • Help ensure high system and infrastructure availability levels by addressing and resolving low-to-medium complexity escalations.
  • Support the implementation and ongoing updates of platform strategies and roadmaps to strengthen security posture.
  • Stay informed of emerging technology trends and best practices relevant to cybersecurity and system operations.
  • Contribute to team projects by meeting deadlines, fulfilling commitments, and delivering quality results.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Coursework or experience with AWS Cloud services and infrastructure, including S3, Lambdas, Dynamo, Event Bridge, ECS, and Kinesis
  • Coursework or experience with IAM framework
  • Coursework or experience with SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC)
  • Coursework or experience with Agile or Scaled Agile (SAFe) methodologies
  • Ability to stay organized and manage multiple and concurrent assignments under tight deadlines preferred
  • Previous internship or work experience as a Cybersecurity Engineer Intern within the past 12 months preferred
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-based, Customer service-oriented environment with a high regard for hospitality
  • Demonstrate programming aptitude and ability for logical and abstract thinking
  • Problem solving ability and strong written/verbal communications skills preferred
  • Works well in a culture that is open, direct, respectful, courteous, and compassionate preferred

Time Commitment and Pay

  • Join Southwest as a Summer 2027 Intern, with a 12-week internship lasting from May 18 – August 8, 2027.

Education

  • Minimum 2.5 cumulative GPA at the time of application is required.

Basic Qualifications

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Business Unit Head to build and lead a business from end to end.

You will own the P&L, product, team and execution. You will identify opportunities, decide what to build, hire the team, launch and improve products, and drive growth and profitability.

This is a hands-on operating role with direct accountability for business results.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own P&L, business strategy, targets and overall performance

  • Identify customer needs and commercial opportunities, and decide what products and features to build

  • Work directly with product, engineering and design teams to build and launch products

  • Build the team - hire strong people, set clear goals and manage performance

  • Drive user growth, engagement, revenue and profitability

  • Build partnerships and operations required to launch and scale the business

  • Make decisions quickly, solve problems directly and own execution from idea to results

What We're Looking For

  • Strong track record building, launching or scaling a product, business or business unit

  • Experience owning P&L, revenue, growth or other measurable business outcomes

  • Strong product and commercial judgement

  • Ability to work across product, engineering, operations and commercial functions

  • Experience building and leading strong teams

  • Hands-on approach - comfortable moving between strategy and detailed execution

  • Strong ownership, speed and ability to operate with limited structure

  • Experience in fintech, consumer technology or AI is an advantage
