jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
jobs.excerpt: The roleYou will own our most senior internal searches end to end, from first conversation with the candidate through to offer.
jobs.description:
The role

You will own our most senior internal searches end to end, from first conversation with the candidate through to offer. The people you'll be hiring are directors and C-level, so you are the first impression this company makes on them. You'll run intake directly with our founders and department heads, which includes telling them when the brief they've given you will not produce the hire they want.

This is not a coordination role. It is not suited to someone who needs the search strategy decided before they start.

Who we are

AI Acquisition is a multi-8-figure business helping founders and operators scale with AI. Thousands of clients, hundreds of mastermind participants, with the US as our primary market. We're bootstrapped with no outside capital, so we set our own timelines and hire people who can operate without a script.

Our Talent function was built from zero in the last fifteen months: ATS, AI screening gates, tiered assessment frameworks, and a hiring bar the founders now use. A delivery team handles high-volume pipeline operations. You'll take whatever needs judgement, at any level, and you'll pick up the rest when the load demands it.

Requirements

Engagement and hours

This is an independent contractor engagement, not employment. You invoice monthly and handle your own tax and statutory obligations in your country of residence.

Expect a 50 to 60 hour week. Our team spans the UAE, the UK and the US, and this role holds the middle of that span. Your day starts on UAE business hours and runs into the US East Coast morning, with senior candidate calls landing outside conventional hours.

We say this plainly because the people who do well here choose it. If you need fixed hours, this is not the right role and we would rather you know before you apply.

What you'll own

  • The full range of searches, end to end, several at once. A C-level hire and a junior specialist role in the same week, and both get done properly
  • Pipeline building ahead of the requisition. Talent mapped, warmed and ready before the role opens, not scrambled when it does
  • Candidate engagement over months, not days. Keeping strong people warm when there is nothing live for them, and giving them a reason to take your call the next time
  • Employer brand in practice. Being able to answer "why would I leave what I have for AIA" with something specific and true, and building the narrative that makes senior people want the conversation
  • Strategic advisory to hiring managers. Market reality, realistic timelines, what the role needs to pay, and when the brief they've written will not produce the hire they want
  • Intake and calibration with founders and department heads, including the disagreement
  • First contact with director and C-level candidates, and being the reason they stay in process instead of going quiet
  • Direct sourcing where no pipeline exists and inbound is useless
  • Written candidate evaluations a founder can decide on without a follow-up call
  • Quality oversight on shortlists coming through the delivery team
    Testing what works. Running A/B on titles, post copy and channels, and making the call on what to keep based on quality of applicant rather than volume
  • Assessment design and execution. Building and running structured evaluations, scorecards and one-way assessments against a defined hiring bar, not judging on gut

What you need

  • 6+ years in talent acquisition, at least 3 of them in-house, embedded or RPO. Agency-only will not clear the bar
  • Senior or leadership search experience. Volume-only backgrounds are not a fit for this seat
  • Demonstrable hiring into the US or UK market, representing an employer to candidates in that market
  • Near-native spoken and written English. You will improvise on camera with senior people, not read from notes
  • Evidence of managing senior stakeholders, including disagreeing with them productively
  • Direct sourcing that works, with response rates you can point to
  • Comfortable operating as an independent contractor, invoicing monthly and managing your own tax position
  • Real schedule flexibility across UAE, UK and US East Coast hours. Calls outside standard business hours are routine, not occasional
  • Evidence of building talent pipelines ahead of demand, not only filling open roles reactively
  • You have kept candidates engaged over months and converted them later. You can name one
  • You can articulate an employer value proposition and adapt it by audience, rather than repeating the careers page
  • Experience designing or running structured candidate assessments. Scorecards, structured interviews, work samples, psychometric or cognitive tools
  • You have tested and iterated on your own job posts and can tell us what changed and what it produced
  • An active, credible LinkedIn presence. You post, you engage, and people in your market know who you are. Passive profiles will not clear this bar

What stands out

  • Multi-country or multi-entity hiring
  • You've built process, not only run someone else's
  • You've been the only recruiter in the room and it was fine
  • You've overseen or coached junior recruiters
  • You've run A/B tests on titles, posts or channels and have the data to show for it
  • AI-assisted sourcing and outreach stack. Clay, HeyReach, n8n, Exa, or equivalent. Name what you've built with it, not what you've heard of
  • You've built a talent pipeline that produced a hire months after the first conversation
  • You've worked somewhere with no employer brand and had to create the reason people said yes

Benefits

What you get

Up to $80K/Annually, as an independent contractor, based on experience

Direct access to founders. You will sit in calibration with the people who make the decisions. No layers between you and the call

A real AI stack, used daily. Clay, HeyReach, n8n, Exa, LLM screening built into the workflow. You will use agents as part of the job, not as a side experiment, and you will have room to build your own

A seat that rewards building. The function was built from zero in fifteen months. What you build here stays and gets used. If you want to inherit a finished process and maintain it, this is the wrong seat. If you want to put your own frameworks into a company that will actually run them, this is a rare one

How we hire

Application, one-way video, short written exercise, structured interview with our Global Head of People & Talent, working session with a founder. You'll know where you stand at every stage.

CRM, Direct Mail & Owned Channels

  • Develop and scale direct mail as a lifecycle channel, including audience strategy, testing, incrementality, and ROI measurement.

Loyalty, Reviews & Customer Advocacy

Cross-Functional & Team Leadership

  • Partner closely with Acquisition to understand downstream customer quality and LTV by channel, audience, offer, and cohort and bring those insights into broader growth decisions.

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Retention & Loyalty team, including a Sr. Retention & Loyalty Manager, Sr. Retention & CRM Specialist, and Retention Creative Designer.
  • Establish clear ownership, goals, operating rhythms, and accountability while empowering the team to own day-to-day execution.
  • Own lifecycle budgets, agencies, technology partners, contracts, forecasting, and investment decisions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities, risks, and recommendations within the lifecycle ecosystem.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience leading Lifecycle, CRM, Retention, or Loyalty for a high-growth consumer or digitally native business.
  • Proven experience building lifecycle strategies that measurably improve LTV, repeat purchase behavior, and customer economics, beyond attributed email and SMS revenue.
  • Deep expertise in customer segmentation, cohort analysis, CRM automation, experimentation, personalization, and lifecycle measurement.
  • Strong analytical and commercial instincts with the ability to move from data → insight → recommendation → action.
  • Experience building sophisticated customer journeys across onboarding, post-purchase, loyalty, cross-sell, winback, and reactivation.
  • Experience owning loyalty programs, CRM platforms, technology partners, agencies, budgets, and contracts.

How Success Will Be Measured

Why Join Comfrt?

Our client understands the intricacies of substation engineering and offers tailored expertise to address these challenges head-on. Leveraging cutting-edge technology and advanced methodologies, we provide comprehensive solutions to enhance substation performance and reliability.

jobs.excerpt: About Journal LabJournal Lab is a Netherlands-based startup dedicated to revolutionizing the way people and organizations capture and share their stories.
jobs.description:
About Journal Lab

Journal Lab is a Netherlands-based startup dedicated to revolutionizing the way people and organizations capture and share their stories.

🌟 Our flagship product: Travel Diaries

Travel Diaries enables users to create beautiful digital diaries that can be:

  • 📝 Shared online as blogs

  • 📄 Downloaded as PDFs

  • 📚 Ordered as exquisitely printed books

Our impact so far:

  • 🌍 Over 200,000 users worldwide.

  • 📦 More than 15,000 books delivered globally.

  • ✍️ 3000 premium members.

💼 Our B2B solutions

But we don't stop at individual travelers! We also offer innovative B2B solutions designed to help DMOs, travel agencies, tour operators, and other travel-related companies enhance their marketing efforts and deepen client relationships. By providing tools for content marketing, UGC integration, branding opportunities, and technological solutions, we empower our partners to engage their customers in new and meaningful ways.

🚀 Ready to make an impact?

Check out 🌐 our website to learn more of if you’re interested in contributing to the mission! Join us at Journal Lab and be part of a team that's shaping the future of digital journaling for individuals and businesses alike.

Our missionis to enable people and organizations to easily capture, share, and immortalize their adventures, experiences and thoughts in a fun and easy way, so they can relive them whenever they want and pass them on for generations to come.

Our vision includes:

  • Empowering individuals:

    • Expanding into new journaling segments such as personal, health, and professional journaling.

    • Maintaining a strong emphasis on storytelling and personal growth.

  • Enabling businesses:

    • Providing innovative solutions that help our partners enhance customer engagement and deepen client relationships.

    • Offering tools for content marketing, user-generated content integration, and branding opportunities to elevate their marketing efforts.

    • Help travel agencies turn their clients into ambassadors.

By uniting our commitment to personal storytelling with empowering organizations to connect meaningfully with their customers, we strive to create lasting emotional connections that resonate globally. ✨

🙆 Join our team

We’re a small (<15), young, dynamic and innovative remote-first company dedicated to driving growth and creating impactful solutions.

  • 🎉 Passionate and diverse team: Committed to excellence and continuous improvement.

  • 💻 Tech-savvy and data-driven: We leverage cutting-edge technology and use data analytics to drive innovation and make informed decisions.

  • 🌐 Fully remote company: All of our positions are fully remote. You don’t have to relocate to join us!

  • 💡 Innovative environment: We’re always adapting to meet our users’ and partners’ needs.

  • ⏰ Flexible work environment: Enjoy the freedom and flexibility of remote work, allowing you to balance your professional and personal life effectively.

  • 📈 Growth opportunities: Be part of a venture-funded startup in its exciting growth stage, offering ample opportunities for career advancement and professional development.

  • 🚀 Exciting product development: Engage with an exciting product in its early growth stages, with lots of opportunities to be part of designing and shaping our platform to reach our mission.

🧑‍💻 About the role

As our New Business Developer, you'll be the driving force behind expanding and optimizing our B2B efforts. Your primary focus will be on validating and driving our expansion into a new segment: travel agencies, both in the Dutch and international markets with a strong emphasis in the English speaking markets. You'll work on increasing our business activities with travel agencies and travel-related companies, helping us identify and penetrate new markets.

You'll set hypotheses and run experiments to discover the best approaches for our B2B products targeted at travel agencies. This involves shaping our existing products to make them appealing to this new segment or developing new solutions to serve these customer segments effectively.

Your number one challenge in the first 3 months will be identifying high-potential opportunities within the travel agency sector, testing hypotheses, and laying the groundwork for scalable, repeatable sales processes.

You'll report directly to the CEO and collaborate closely with the Growth Sales and Customer Success teams to shape our B2B strategy, define key problems to solve, and drive revenue growth in this new segment.

💼 What this job can offer you

  • Opportunity to drive growth: Play a pivotal role in expanding our B2B presence into new international markets, directly impacting the company's growth trajectory.

  • Strategic influence: Collaborate closely with the CEO and Head of Growth and other stakeholders to shape our B2B strategy, product offerings, and market approach.

  • Professional development: Work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment that encourages innovation, experimentation, and continuous learning.

  • Autonomy and flexibility: Enjoy the freedom to organize your work, set your strategies, and take ownership of your projects in a remote setting.

  • International exposure: Engage with clients and partners across various countries, broadening your professional network and cultural understanding.

  • Supportive team environment: Join a talented and passionate team where your ideas are expected, heard, and appreciated.

📝 Practicals

  • You’ll report to: CEO, Veerle

  • Team: B2B Sales

  • Location: Remote (Europe, Africa, or East Coast Americas)

  • Start date: As soon as possible

  • Type of contract: Contractor

  • Annual compensation: €42,635 - €46,635

📊 KPIs

As the New Business Developer, you will be expected to influence and drive the key performance indicators (KPIs) listed below.

  • Segment validation and entry

  • Qualified lead generation

  • Number of new clients acquired

  • B2B revenue growth from travel agencies

  • Sales process development

  • Client satisfaction

🧐 Responsibilities in detail

  • Market research and validation

    • Identify opportunities within the travel agency sector in Dutch and international markets.

    • Test hypotheses and validate market needs.

    • Develop hypotheses about new market opportunities and design experiments to test them.

  • Strategic business development

    • Develop and execute strategies to penetrate the travel agency market.

    • Adapt and shape our B2B products to meet the needs of new clients, potentially developing new solutions.

    • Identify opportunities to diversify our B2B strategy and implement scalable, repeatable sales processes.

  • Lead generation and sales

    • Generate and qualify leads through outreach and networking.

    • Build relationships with key stakeholders.

    • Present proposals and close deals with travel agencies.

    • Maintain a pipeline of high-quality leads and opportunities.

    • Meet and exceed revenue targets by driving sales growth in new segment.

  • Process optimization

    • Design scalable sales processes tailored to travel agencies.

    • Collaborate with teams to align efforts.

    • Maintain accurate records of business development activities, opportunities, and pipeline status in our CRM system.

    • Generate regular reports on performance, including key metrics and progress towards goals.

    • Analyze data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

🧰 What you bring

Experience and skills:

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in business development, sales, or a similar role within the travel industry or related sectors.

  • Proven track record of successfully entering new markets and driving revenue growth.

  • Experience in setting hypotheses and running experiments to validate market opportunities.

  • Strong understanding of B2B sales principles, strategies, and scalable sales processes.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

  • Proficiency in CRM software, ideally Pipedrive.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a remote setting.

  • Strong organizational and time management skills.

  • Results-oriented with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

  • An existing network within the travel industry is a plus.

  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

Personal attributes:

  • You're proactive, innovative, and not afraid to take calculated risks to achieve goals.

  • You make decisions based on data and are skilled at analyzing market trends and performance metrics.

  • You’re passionate about understanding and meeting client needs.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, changing environment and able to adjust strategies as needed.

  • Ability to engage with diverse cultures and adapt communication styles accordingly.

🌍 Our Company Culture

We believe in a flexible, results-oriented work culture where productivity is rewarded, and team members have the freedom to shape their work and personal lives. Our ethos is centered around fostering happy, engaged, and motivated team members who feel a strong connection to the company. We prioritize location-independent work, leveraging digital meetings and daily communication through Slack to maintain a content and efficient team.

📜 Journal Lab Tenets

  • 👑 Ownership Mindset: We act as stakeholders, taking responsibility for the company's direction and goals. We don’t say “that’s not my job” – we roll up our sleeves and contribute solutions, not just problems. We avoid working in silos, always considering our impact on the team.

  • 👟 Bias for Action: We take calculated risks and explore new opportunities, moving quickly on reversible decisions while pausing to consider irreversible ones. We reward seizing opportunities and exploring new possibilities without fear of failure.

  • ⚡ Move with Urgency and Focus: We prioritize impactful work, providing prompt and efficient service, and making swift decisions to drive growth and protect our reputation. We cultivate a culture of accountability, innovation, and resilience.

  • 🔍 Think Rigorously: We commit to thorough and analytical thinking in all aspects of our work, ensuring well-informed decisions aligned with our objectives. This fosters a culture of excellence, driven by innovation, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

  • 🤝 Trust and Amplify: We trust and amplify each other’s expertise and strengths, fostering open communication, transparency, and inclusive decision-making. This cultivates mutual respect, empowerment, and innovation, driving meaningful impact and achieving collective goals.

  • 🌟 Optimism: We maintain a positive outlook, viewing challenges as opportunities for growth. We encourage proactive problem-solving, fostering resilience, creativity, and a can-do attitude, enabling us to navigate complexities with confidence and agility.

🪧 Benefits

  • Work remotely: Collaborate with a globally distributed workforce with team members from 🇦🇷 Argentina, 🇧🇪 Belgium, 🇧🇷 Brazil, 🇨🇴 Colombia, 🇩🇪 Germany, 🇮🇩 Indonesia, 🇸🇷 Suriname, 🇳🇱 The Netherlands, 🇹🇷 Turkey ,🇺🇦 Ukraine and more!

  • Flexible work-schedule: Flexibility in your schedule; what we care about is getting the job done. We work mostly async.

  • Generous paid time-off (PTO): Enjoy 26 days of annual vacation plus national holidays.

  • An inclusive and dynamic workplace: We respect and value diversity in all its forms, where people from all walks of life are welcomed and valued for their unique perspectives and experiences.

🗓️ How you’ll organize your day (and life)

At Journal Lab we work mostly async which means you can plan your schedule around your life and not around meetings. You’ll be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt, you’ll default to action instead of waiting. Balancing your life and work-schedule is important and you’ll be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

Lear more about our flexible working policy here: Flexible working at Journal Lab

If you're excited to be part of our story and make a real impact in the travel and journaling world, we'd love to have you on board. Let's create amazing stories together!

Why Tenna?

We take pride that our roots are in the construction industry. With this experience and knowledge, we have built a platform that revolutionizes construction equipment fleet operations. We provide innovative solutions to customers looking for competitive ways to better manage and track their assets, such as heavy and light equipment, large fleets, tools, and materials.

At Tenna, we believe the best is right in front of all of us and that each day holds more potential than the one before. We believe that every new discovery can lead to something better than we thought possible. When we boil it down, the top five qualities that define the Tenna Team are quality-obsessed, gritty, continuous learners, collaborative problem solvers, and just plain awesome. Sound like you? Join us as we empower our customers to control their mixed assets on one comprehensive platform anytime, anywhere.

Position Description

We are looking for a Principal Architect to execute on the long-term technical direction of Tenna’s platform. As a Principal Architect, you’ll operate across teams to design scalable systems, guide architectural decisions, and ensure we’re building for both current needs and future growth. You’ll establish standards, lead design reviews, and ensure a high bar for technical quality across the organization, while providing hands-on guidance to solve complex challenges. Reporting to the CTO, you’ll partner closely with engineering leadership to ensure designs translate cleanly into what gets built and that those designs reflect real world constraints. You’ll play a central role in improving how reliably and efficiently we deliver software. We need a world class doer for this role, someone who can listen to a vision and personally drive the execution to make it a reality.

Responsibilities

    • Own the execution of the Executive Team's technical strategy, turning high-level goals into actionable milestones and scalable system designs.
    • Lead by example by personally building prototypes, core libraries, and foundational projects that set the standard for how the rest of the team builds.
    • Set and enforce technical standards, ensuring every design choice handles failure modes, scalability, and performance in our production environment.
    • Run a rigorous design review process that prioritizes backward compatibility and solid verification for our data-heavy systems.
    • Evolve our microservices (Node.js/EKS/AWS), focused on reducing technical debt and making the system run more efficiently as we scale.
    • Partner with Product and Engineering to make sure requirements are crystal clear and that what actually gets built stays true to the original vision.
    • Master the data lifecycle, from IoT ingestion to storage and processing, building the foundations that our teams will eventually own.
    • Roll up your sleeves to implement observability and monitoring standards, ensuring our platform hits the highest possible bar for uptime.

Qualifications

    • 12+ years of professional software engineering experience.
    • 4+ years of experience in an architectural leadership role (Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, or equivalent) where you owned technical standards and design quality across multiple engineering teams.
    • Experience turning high-level concepts into clear, documented patterns and designs that teams can implement independently—not just designing systems yourself, but enabling others to build them well.
    • Deep expertise in distributed systems and microservices architecture, including operating and evolving a mature microservices environment (not just greenfield design).
    • Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript and Node.js in service-based architectures. Our backend is built on Node.js microservices communicating via RabbitMQ and HTTP, running on AWS (EKS, Aurora PostgreSQL). You should be comfortable and opinionated in this stack, including API design, service boundaries, and asynchronous communication patterns.
    • Strong data architecture experience, including designing systems that handle high-volume, real-time data (e.g., IoT or event-driven systems), and making tradeoffs across storage, processing, and access patterns
    • Experience improving system reliability and performance at scale, including observability, monitoring, and fault tolerance.
    • Demonstrated ability to influence across teams, driving alignment without relying solely on authority.
    • Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.

Benefits, Perks, & Additional Information:

  • Full-time opportunity.
  • Location: Remote - nationwide.
  • Travel is required, 8 - 10%.
  • Opportunities for growth and personal development within a highly dynamic team.
  • Robust, low-cost benefit packages offered.
  • Benefit coverage begins on the first date of employment.
  • Paid Time Off and Volunteer Time Off offered.
  • 401k match.
  • Dependent Care offered.
  • Employee referral bonuses.
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Tenna is committed to building a diverse team. We welcome different perspectives and opinions to foster innovation, authenticity, and excellence across all parts of our company, and are committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment.

At Wavelength we are building a global social media, marketing and creator agency built around the power of talent, content and communities. Founded by the team behind the Extreme Sports Channel, we bring 30+ years of media and entertainment experience together with a global network of leading creators (Super Car Blondie), athletes and social publishing pages. As a Country Licensing Agent, you will effectively become our partner and licensing representative in your territory. You will identify where our talent, brands, content and intellectual property can create commercial value and then find, pitch and develop the partners capable of bringing those opportunities to market.

Here is what you will be doing

Market Strategy & Planning

  • Develop a country specific licensing plan and strategy for Wavelength talent and IP

  • Creator and brand

  • Identify the most commercially attractive industry sectors and licensing categories

  • Map the local licensing ecosystem, including manufacturers, retailers, distributors, brands and potential licensees

  • Build an annual licensing pipeline and commercial plan

Business Development & Sales

  • Identify and qualify potential licensing partners

  • Build relationships with brands, Creators and licensees

  • Conduct targeted outreach and business development.

  • Present Wavelength's talent, properties and licensing opportunities to prospective partners

  • Sports equipment

  • Automotive products and accessories

  • Travel products

  • Fitness and wellness

  • Beauty

  • Technology

  • Gaming

  • Publishing

  • Experiential

  • Collectibles

  • Digital products

  • Destination and tourism partnerships

  • Brand collaborations

  • Co-branded products and experiences

Managing the Licensing Programme

  • Maintaining relationships with licensees and commercial partners

  • Coordinating with Wavelength on negotiations and agreements

  • Supporting partner onboarding

  • Managing the local licensing pipeline

  • Monitoring opportunities and deal progress

  • Supporting product and campaign development where required

  • Identifying additional commercial opportunities within existing partnerships

  • Reporting market intelligence and pipeline development to Wavelength

  • Helping grow successful partnerships over the long term

You will own the market relationship, while Wavelength provides the wider network, talent relationships, commercial infrastructure and central support.

  • Creator and athlete relationships

  • Licensing opportunities and intellectual property

  • Central commercial and management support

  • International market knowledge

  • Pitch materials and commercial assets

  • Support with negotiations and deal structures

  • Global relationships with brands and agencies

  • Cross market opportunities

  • The ability to build international licensing programmes around successful properties

As The Country Licensing Agent, you will bring the local knowledge, relationships, commercial instinct and execution.

  • Sports marketing

  • Brand partnerships

  • Media

  • Entertainment

  • Consumer products

  • Advertising

  • Sponsorship

  • Athlete or creator representation

  • IP development

  • Knowledge of their local market

  • An entrepreneurial mindset

  • Ability to work independently

Applying

Why Wavelength?

The creator economy has created an enormous amount of valuable intellectual property, audiences and cultural influence. Much of that value remains underdeveloped commercially.

Wavelength sits at the intersection of creators, audiences, brands, media and commercial partnerships. Ortus Health provides remote medical coding, pharmacy, and GP triage services to NHS GP practices across the UK. We're looking for a **Remote Care Coordinator & Administrator** to support our remote triage service across the practices we work with.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Hotman Group is a boutique cybersecurity and GRC consulting firm doing meaningful work for clients who need GRC done right ranging from Fortune 1000 companies to high-growth startups. We are looking for a driven, detail-obsessed early-career professional who is ready to apply your professional foundation to real GRC consulting work and contribute to real client work from day one.

This is a full-time, remote, contract-to-hire position. Top performers move into permanent roles within 6 months.

What You Will Do

As an Entry Level GRC Analyst at Hotman Group you will work side by side with senior team members and partners to help our clients strengthen their cybersecurity and compliance programs. You will:

  • Assess and improve client security and IT controls
  • Develop policies, processes, and risk assessments aligned to top frameworks including NIST, ISO 27001, and SOC 2
  • Crosswalk and harmonize controls across multiple compliance frameworks
  • Document security requirements, support control implementation, and help track remediation progress
  • Build risk registers, support assessments, and monitor remediation progress
  • Work hands-on with GRC tools and contribute to solutions for complex client challenges
  • Translate technical and regulatory requirements into clear, actionable steps for our clients
  • Participate in peer review of deliverables before they go to clients — your work will be reviewed and you will review others

You will touch every aspect of cybersecurity and GRC work across multiple industries. Every engagement brings new challenges and new opportunities to grow.

What You Bring

  • A Bachelor's or Graduate degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 1 to 2 years of professional work experience -- this does not need to be in GRC or cybersecurity specifically, but it does need to be in a professional office or corporate environment. We are looking for candidates who have demonstrated reliability, communication, and accountability in a workplace setting
  • Solid understanding of fundamental security and IT concepts including access controls, data retention, and change management
  • Familiarity with major security and privacy frameworks including ISO, NIST, SOC 2, and HIPAA
  • Strong critical thinking, organization, and communication skills
  • Ability to balance multiple projects and deadlines with exceptional follow-through
  • Technical aptitude -- you are curious, you learn fast, and you do not shy away from new tools
  • A genuine interest in cybersecurity and a commitment to helping organizations build stronger, safer programs
  • A solutions-first attitude -- you show up with curiosity and energy and you are not afraid to dive into the work
  • The ability to think critically and execute with precision in a fast-paced, high-trust, low-ego environment
  • A high level of ownership and accountability -- you communicate proactively and follow through without being managed closely
  • A default toward communication — you keep the team informed, you acknowledge quickly, and you do not go dark on a deliverable or a client

Active pursuit of a relevant certification (Security+, CC, SSCP) is strongly preferred. If you are not currently studying for one, be prepared to explain why.

Requirements

  • Located in the USA with permanent work authorization (no sponsorship of any kind now or in the future)
  • Able to pass a background check
  • A private, dedicated workspace with a door — client calls and confidential work require it

Our Hiring Process

Our process is designed to be straightforward but thorough. In addition to a written questionnaire and video responses, finalists will complete a practical skills assessment before advancing to a panel interview with our delivery team. The assessment is designed to reflect real GRC work. If you are serious about building a career in this field, it is your opportunity to show us what you can do.

Why Hotman Group

At Hotman Group we are not just another consulting firm. You will work alongside people who care about the craft and push each other to do better. No politics, no silos, no hierarchy between you and the people making decisions.

You will touch more GRC frameworks, more industries, and more client situations in one year here than most practitioners see in five. You will grow because the work demands it.

The clients you serve will actually notice your work. You are not a number on a headcount. Your name is on the deliverable.

If you want to do real GRC work, get better at it every day, and work with a team that holds itself to a high standard — this is the place.

No phone calls or emails please.

  • Facebook and Instagram video ad scripts (hooks, body, CTA)
  • Static ad copy (headline, body, CTA)
  • UGC-style scripts for on-camera talent
  • Short-form ad variants and angle iterations
  • Landing page and funnel copy support as needed

If you need two weeks to write one ad, this is not your role. If you can read a brief, understand the buyer, and ship five ad scripts by end of day — keep reading.

How We Work

  • Volume + iteration > one "perfect" ad
  • Hooks are the job. Body copy follows. CTA closes. In that order, every time.
  • Direct-response cadence: brief → write → ship → test → iterate
  • Speed matters. We run 100+ ads per week. Slow writers block the machine.
  • Small senior team. Direct line to operators. Zero bureaucracy.


* A Note Before You Apply
This is a senior seat, and we screen hard on real Meta ad experience — specifically, ads you personally wrote that ran against $500K+ in tracked spend, verifiable in the Meta Ads Library. If that's not your background, this likely isn't the right fit right now.

Requirements

Must-have

  • 5+ years writing performance ads for Facebook and Instagram specifically — not emails, blogs, or organic content
  • Personal experience on accounts with $500K+ in tracked Meta ad spend (agency or in-house — must have owned the copy, not just touched it)
  • A portfolio of real ads you personally wrote, verifiable in the Meta Ads Library, with performance data (CTR, CPA, ROAS, or revenue attributed)
  • Deep fluency in hooks, mechanisms, objections, proof, and buyer psychology
  • Experience in info-product, coaching, online education, agency-services, or ecommerce
  • You write fast — multiple complete ad scripts in a single working session
  • Highly fluent in English — native or near-native level
  • You can take an angle brief and execute it without needing the concept explained three times

Strong signals

  • Portfolio shows hooks that would actually stop a scroll — not headlines that open a brochure
  • You have written UGC-style scripts, talking-head scripts, B-roll voiceover scripts, and static ad copy
  • You have worked on high-ticket offers ($1K+) where the ad has to do serious persuasion work
  • You use AI to produce faster, but your final copy has your commercial instinct on it, not GPT's
  • You have swipe files, inspiration sources, and a real research process

* Not right for you if

  • Email copywriters or content writers with no paid ad creative experience
  • Brand copywriters with no direct-response or performance marketing orientation
  • Writers who produce one polished ad per week
  • Anyone who cannot show, with Ads Library links and performance data, ads they personally wrote that ran in a paid account

What You'll Actually Do

  • Write complete Facebook and Instagram ad scripts from creative briefs — hook, body, CTA
  • Produce multiple angle variations per brief for testing
  • Write UGC scripts for on-camera talent, formatted for easy delivery
  • Write static ad copy (headlines, primary text, CTAs) across formats
  • Iterate quickly on underperforming copy based on performance data
  • Collaborate with the creative strategy team so your copy executes the intended angle cleanly
  • Review your own output against the funnel it feeds so the copy is consistent

Benefits

Comp & Benefits

  • $120,000–$180,000 total comp (base + performance bonus, geography-adjusted). Top of band goes to writers who bring proven ownership of $1M+ in tracked spend.
  • 100% remote
  • High-volume testing environment with real spend behind your work
  • Direct access to operators, offers, performance feedback, and customer data



How to Apply — Portfolio Required, No Exceptions
Before we move to a call, please share the following: Step 1 — 3 FB ads you personally wrote that actually ran For each one tell us:

  • The brand and offer type
  • What the hook was trying to do
  • Any performance data you have (CTR, CPA, ROAS, revenue — whatever you have access to) Links to live ads, screenshots, or a Google Doc are all fine. Email-only portfolios will not be considered. That's it for now. If your portfolio is strong, we'll move to a call with our Head of Marketing. The writing assessment comes after that conversation — not before.

jobs.excerpt: Red Canyon Technologies is seeking a PMO Technical Program Manager to support integrated program planning, governance, reporting, and execution control.
jobs.description:
Red Canyon Technologies is seeking a PMO Technical Program Manager to support integrated program planning, governance, reporting, and execution control.

This position is responsible for maintaining a reliable, evidence-based view of program schedules, deliverables, dependencies, costs, staffing needs, risks, issues, and decisions across assigned workstreams and task orders. The PMO Technical Program Manager will help program leadership and delivery teams convert complex or ambiguous status into clear ownership, documented decisions, actionable due dates, and objective evidence of progress.

This is a program-level management and integration role. The successful candidate must be technically fluent enough to understand modernization activities, recognize delivery and technical dependencies, ask informed questions, and communicate their implications. The position is not, however, the program’s independent architecture or technical approval authority. Technical findings, architecture decisions, and modernization recommendations remain the responsibility of the designated technical leads and appropriate Government decision authorities.

The PMO Technical Program Manager will work closely with program leadership, task-order project managers, technical leads, subcontractors, and Government stakeholders to improve delivery predictability, reporting consistency, phase-gate readiness, and timely escalation of material risks and decisions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Clearance Requirements: Secret
  • Maintain an integrated view of program schedules, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, staffing needs, and cost or effort status across assigned activities.
  • Maintain the program deliverable register and coordinate the timely preparation, review, revision, submission, and status reporting of required deliverables.
  • Prepare and coordinate weekly status reports, monthly program reporting, leadership briefings, customer communications, and other recurring program-management materials.
  • Reconcile status information across schedules, work plans, deliverable records, cost or effort information, and team updates. Identify inconsistencies, unsupported completion claims, and missing evidence before information is reported.
  • Translate ambiguous status into a clearly documented owner, required action or decision, target date, dependency, and supporting evidence.
  • Maintain program-level risk, issue, action, and decision records. Ensure that material concerns are documented, assigned, tracked, and escalated through the appropriate governance path.
  • Coordinate phase-gate readiness across task orders and workstreams, including review schedules, required artifacts, outstanding decisions, dependencies, and supporting evidence.
  • Establish and maintain disciplined program-management records using approved program management systems.
  • Support task-order project managers and technical leads in maintaining consistent planning, status reporting, risk management, decision tracking, and deliverable-control practices.
  • Identify dependencies and resource conflicts that cross task-order or organizational boundaries and facilitate their resolution or escalation.
  • Coordinate cost and effort status with authorized program, financial, contracts, and delivery personnel. Surface material variances, unresolved assumptions, or inconsistencies for review.
  • Facilitate recurring program-management meetings, reviews, and working sessions. Document decisions, actions, owners, and due dates, and follow through to closure.
  • Prepare concise, accurate, and audience-appropriate communications for Government stakeholders, company leadership, delivery teams, and subcontractor partners.
  • Maintain an explicit distinction between contractor recommendations, internal management decisions, and decisions reserved for the Government.
  • Support dependable and consistent customer messaging across task orders, phases, reviews, and reporting cycles.
  • Support program staffing coordination, onboarding, and resource planning as assigned and within the authority delegated to the position.
  • Support lessons learned, after-action reviews, and process improvement activities to strengthen program controls and delivery consistency.
  • Support proposal, capture, task-order response, or labor-category activities as needed.


Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in IT program or project management, with at least 3 years managing Federal Government contracts.
  • Demonstrated technical fluency sufficient to engage with architects, engineers, and modernization SMEs; identify dependencies and risks; challenge unsupported conclusions; and translate technical issues into program, schedule, cost, and customer impacts.
  • Demonstrated experience managing integrated plans across multiple technical workstreams, projects, or task orders.
  • Demonstrated capability in schedule integration, deliverable control, dependency management, and phase or gate readiness.
  • Experience maintaining and using risk, issue, action, and decision records to support delivery and management decisions.
  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear Government/customer status reports, executive summaries, decision materials, and escalation notices.
  • Experience reconciling schedule, deliverable, cost, effort, staffing, and status information from multiple sources.
  • Ability to distinguish verified progress from assumptions, estimates, planned activity, and unsupported completion claims.
  • Demonstrated judgment in facilitation, escalation, stakeholder coordination, and the handling of sensitive or protected information.
  • Ability to translate technical constraints, dependencies, and uncertainty into clear program-management impacts without overstating technical conclusions.
  • Experience working with technical leads, project managers, operational teams, contracts personnel, financial personnel, subcontractors, and customer stakeholders.
  • Experience establishing or maintaining disciplined program records in collaborative environments such as Microsoft Planner, SharePoint, and Teams.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a technically complex delivery environment where schedules, deliverables, dependencies, costs, and customer expectations must remain aligned.


Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP, PgMP, or an equivalent program or project management credential.
  • Relevant agile delivery training or experience where agile practices are used by the assigned workstreams.

  • Channel — resellers/VARs (e.g., SHI, TD-Synnex), distributors (e.g., CDW, Carahsoft), hyperscalers (e.g., AWS, Google, Microsoft), and government contractors (e.g., GSA)
  • Partner Development: Run structured discovery conversations with prospective partners, qualify fit, assess mutual value, and move the strongest relationships into pilots, referral arrangements, or joint go-to-market plans.
  • Commercial Structuring: Draft and negotiate partnership terms - referral fees, reseller agreements, co-sell frameworks, and integration commitments - in coordination with the VP of GTM and Legal.
  • Playbook & Enablement: Build repeatable playbooks per partner category (outreach templates, qualification criteria, onboarding steps, objection handling) as the ecosystem scales.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Comfort with ambiguity: proven ability to build a partner program from scratch — target lists, outreach, and playbooks — rather than executing against an established one.
  • Multi-threaded execution: able to run parallel outreach and relationship-building motions across several distinct partner categories at once.
  • Commercial fluency: comfortable structuring referral, reseller, and co-sell agreements, and negotiating with partner counterparts at varying levels of seniority.
  • Executive presence: able to represent AST credibly with partner executives, while also being hands-on enough to run early-stage outreach personally.
  • Mission alignment: genuine interest in accessibility technology and its impact on the Deaf and Hard-of-hearing community.
  • Relevant industry exposure a plus: accessibility, enterprise collaboration/ communications software, media technology, or public sector/government channel experience.

Come be a part of our mission and make a meaningful and positive impact with the industry leading provider of language services for the Deaf and hard-of-hearing!

jobs.description:
Who we are

Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Central Ohio, we’re a privately-owned, independent healthcare navigation organization. We believe that no one should have to navigate the cost and complexity of healthcare alone, and we’re on a mission to make healthcare simpler and more effective for our millions of members. Our big-hearted, tech-savvy team fights to ensure that our members get the care they need, when they need it, at the most affordable cost – that’s why we call ourselves Healthcare Warriors®.

We’re committed to building diverse and inclusive teams – more than 2,000 of us and counting – so if you’re excited about this position, we encourage you to apply – even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement.

The Sr Client Success Executive, Strategic Accounts serves as the executive relationship owner and strategic business partner for Quantum Health’s most complex and high-value clients. This role is accountable for retention, revenue expansion, performance guarantee achievement, and long-term client value realization across a portfolio of national and jumbo accounts.

Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this leader drives enterprise-level strategy, aligns executive stakeholders, translates client business objectives into actionable success plans, and ensures cross-functional orchestration across Quantum Health to deliver measurable outcomes. Success in this role is defined by sustained client growth, executive-level trust, operational excellence, and strategic partnership that positions Quantum Health as an indispensable advisor.

Location: This position is remote anywhere in the United States of America.

What you’ll do (Essential Responsibilities)

Strategic Account Leadership & Value Realization

  • Serve as the executive relationship owner for assigned strategic and jumbo accounts, developing multi-year partnership strategies aligned to client enterprise objectives.
  • Establish and maintain C-suite and senior stakeholder relationships to position Quantum Health as a trusted strategic advisor.
  • Translate client business priorities (cost containment, member experience, health outcomes, risk mitigation) into actionable account plans with defined KPIs and measurable ROI.
  • Lead annual and multi-year strategic planning sessions, business reviews, and executive presentations that demonstrate value realization and forward-looking innovation.
  • Own performance guarantee oversight, proactively identifying risks and implementing mitigation strategies to ensure successful outcomes.
  • Drive enterprise adoption and optimization of Quantum Health solutions to maximize client value and long-term partnership stability.

Revenue Growth, Retention & Portfolio Expansion

  • Own full retention accountability and revenue performance across assigned portfolio.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive renewal strategies, including executive alignment, value articulation, and competitive positioning.
  • Identify and lead expansion opportunities including cross-sell and upsell initiatives aligned to client strategic priorities.
  • Proactively assess account health through data analytics, stakeholder engagement, and risk monitoring to prevent churn and uncover growth opportunities.
  • Partner with Sales and Growth teams to position Quantum Health for expanded footprint within client organizations.

Enterprise Orchestration & Operational Excellence

  • Act as the internal quarterback for assigned accounts, aligning Operations, Clinical, Product, Finance, and Implementation teams to deliver a seamless client experience.
  • Anticipate and resolve complex, escalated issues with executive-level visibility, ensuring rapid resolution and root-cause prevention.
  • Convey client market trends, competitive intelligence, and strategic objectives to internal leadership to inform product roadmap and service innovation.
  • Ensure disciplined CRM management and account hygiene, maintaining accurate forecasting, health scoring, and strategic documentation.
  • Provide executive insights and portfolio reporting to senior leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and strategic initiatives.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What you’ll bring (Qualifications)

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 2+ years of direct experience managing jumbo or national accounts (e.g., large, complex, multi-location, high-revenue employer groups).
  • 10–12+ years of progressive experience in strategic account management, consulting, health insurance, or enterprise client leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated success retaining and growing high-value, complex client portfolios.
  • Proven ability to influence and engage executive-level stakeholders in high-stakes, high-visibility environments.
  • Strong financial acumen with the ability to articulate ROI, performance guarantees, and value realization metrics.
  • Exceptional strategic thinking, negotiation, analytical, presentation, and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to operate independently with a high degree of ownership and accountability.
  • Experience in healthcare, health insurance, or benefits consulting strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and executive-level reporting.
  • Travel as required based on client and business needs.
  • A high degree of personal accountability and trustworthiness, a commitment to working within Quantum Health’s policies, values and ethics, and to protecting the sensitive data entrusted to us.

Leadership Expectations (Manager-Level Without Direct Reports)

  • Lead through influence across matrixed teams without formal people management responsibility.
  • Demonstrate executive presence and sound judgment in high-impact decision-making environments.
  • Drive accountability across internal stakeholders to ensure client commitments are met.
  • Model strategic thinking, ownership mindset, and enterprise collaboration.

What’s in it for you:

  • Compensation: Competitive base and incentive compensation
  • Coverage: Health, vision and dental featuring our best-in-class healthcare navigation services, along with life insurance, legal and identity protection, adoption assistance, EAP, Teladoc services and more.
  • Retirement: 401(k) plan with up to 4% employer match and full vesting on day one.
  • Balance: Paid Time Off (PTO), 7 paid holidays, parental leave, volunteer days, paid sabbaticals, and more.
  • Development: Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250 annually, certification/continuing education reimbursement, discounted higher education partnerships, paid trainings and leadership development.
  • Culture: Recognition as a Best Place to Work for 15+ years, dedication to diversity, philanthropy and sustainability, and people-first values that drive every decision.
  • Environment: A modern workplace with a casual dress code, open floor plans, full-service dining, free snacks and drinks, complimentary 24/7 fitness center with group classes, outdoor walking paths, game room, notary and dry-cleaning services and more!

What you should know:

  • Internal Associates: Already a Healthcare Warrior? Apply internally through Lever
  • Process: Application > Recruiter Video Interview > Online Assessment(s) > Interview(s) > Offer > Background Check.
  • Diversity, Equity and Inclusion: Quantum Health welcomes everyone. We value our diverse team and suppliers, we’re committed to empowering our ERGs, and we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer .
  • Tobacco-Free Campus: To further enable the health and wellbeing of our associates and community, Quantum Health maintains a tobacco-free environment. The use of all types of tobacco products is prohibited in all company facilities and on all company grounds.
  • Compensation Ranges: Compensation details published by job boards are estimates and not verified by Quantum Health. Details surrounding compensation will be disclosed throughout the interview process. Compensation offered is based on the candidate’s unique combination of experience and qualifications related to the position.
  • Sponsorship: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent and ongoing future basis without requiring sponsorship.
  • Agencies: Quantum Health does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach from third-parties. Absent a signed MSA and request/approval from Talent Acquisition to submit candidates for a specific requisition, we will not approve payment to any third party.

Reasonable Accommodation:

Should you require reasonable accommodation(s) to participate in the application/interview/selection process, or in order to complete the essential duties of the position upon acceptance of a job offer, click here to submit a recruitment accommodation request.

Recruiting Scams:

Unfortunately, scams targeting job seekers are common. To protect our candidates, we want to remind you that authorized representatives of Quantum Health will only contact you from an email address ending in @quantum-health.com. Quantum Health will never ask for personally identifiable information such as Date of Birth (DOB), Social Security Number (SSN), banking/direct/tax details, etc. via email or any other non-secure system, nor will we instruct you to make any purchases related to your employment. If you believe you’ve encountered a recruiting scam, report it to the Federal Trade Commission and your state’s Attorney General.

California Employee and Job Applicant Notice of Collection of Personal Information:

If you are a California resident, Quantum Health may collect personal information in connection with your application for employment and, if hired, during the course of your employment. The categories of personal information collected and the purposes for which that information is used are described in our California Employee and Job Applicant Notice of Collection of Personal Information.

Please review the notice here:

California Employee and Job Applicant Notice

Use of Technology Notice:

Quantum Health and its authorized service providers may contact applicants by email, phone, and text message about their application and related employment opportunities. Text messages may cover application status, interview invitations, and reminders, and applicants will have the option to opt out at any time. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply.

Quantum Health uses AI-assisted recruiting technology to support communication, scheduling, and candidate evaluation, including tools that may review application materials and analyze recorded interviews. These tools assist our recruiting team; final employment decisions are made by human reviewers. Applicants who will be interviewed using these tools receive advance notice describing the technology and what it evaluates, are asked for permission before the interview is recorded or analyzed, and may request deletion of their recording.

jobs.title: Client Relationship & Retention Specialist
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a Client Relationship & Retention Specialist to take ownership of complex customer situations where there is a risk of disengagement, cancellation, refund, or loss of trust.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Client Relationship & Retention Specialist to take ownership of complex customer situations where there is a risk of disengagement, cancellation, refund, or loss of trust.

This is a high-accountability, client-facing role requiring strong judgment, confident phone communication, commercial awareness, and the ability to remain calm and effective in difficult situations.

You will investigate the full customer journey, identify the true cause of an issue, and work directly with customers to help them regain confidence and move forward. This means looking beyond the immediate complaint to understand what is actually driving the customer’s concern, whether that is a practical, technical, delivery, expectation, or mindset blocker.

You will be expected to troubleshoot appropriate issues directly, coordinate across internal teams when additional action is required, and maintain ownership of the customer relationship through resolution.

This is not passive customer support or an aggressive refund-prevention role. It is a high-trust, consultative role for someone who can combine strong call control and influence with genuine curiosity, empathy, and problem-solving.

Success requires the ability to build trust quickly, lead challenging conversations confidently, diagnose problems accurately, and help customers move toward a constructive next step without pressure, manipulation, or unsupported promises.

THE COMPANY

A multi-8-figure ARR business with 200+ team members, bootstrapped and profitable. The company launches and scales information and software products on a marketing and sales engine refined across a dozen product launches and $100M+ in ad spend.

This seat sits within our client operations team and plays an important role in strengthening customer relationships, resolving complex issues, improving retention, and protecting long-term customer value.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Take ownership of at-risk customer cases involving dissatisfaction, disengagement, cancellation, refund concerns, or loss of confidence
  • Contact assigned customers quickly by telephone and use SMS and email when appropriate
  • Review the customer’s complete journey before making contact to understand the history, context, and potential issues
  • Speak directly with customers by phone and build trust quickly, even when emotions are high
  • Diagnose practical, technical, delivery, expectation, or mindset blockers and identify the true root cause of the issue
  • Troubleshoot appropriate issues directly and coordinate additional support when required
  • Lead calm, confident resolution and de-escalation conversations
  • Separate the immediate complaint from the underlying issue and determine the most appropriate path forward
  • Help customers reframe unhelpful conclusions without dismissing legitimate concerns
  • Reconnect customers with their original goals and help establish a clear recovery plan and next action
  • Correct misunderstandings clearly and respectfully without becoming defensive or argumentative
  • Use strong conversational influence and judgment to help restore customer confidence without applying pressure or making unsupported promises
  • Make sound judgment calls while balancing customer experience, commercial considerations, and the facts of each case
  • Coordinate with Onboarding, Tech, Delivery, Sales, Finance, and other teams when additional action is required
  • Maintain ownership of the customer relationship while internal work is being completed rather than simply passing the customer between departments
  • Use approved support options or concessions when appropriate and justified
  • Escalate continued refund requests or complex cases through the appropriate process
  • Keep customers informed while outstanding issues are being resolved
  • Maintain clear and accurate records of conversations, decisions, commitments, actions, and outcomes
  • Identify recurring causes of disengagement, dissatisfaction, and refunds and recommend practical improvements to prevent them in the future

Requirements

  • Previous experience in consultative or high-ticket sales/closing, Customer Retention, Customer Success, Account Management, Escalations, Complaints, Dispute Resolution, Service Recovery, or a similarly high-touch client-facing role
  • Strong conversational influence and call control, with the ability to confidently lead a customer toward a constructive next step
  • Strong ability to build rapport with frustrated, disappointed, uncertain, or skeptical customers
  • Comfortable leading difficult and emotionally charged conversations

About Food4Education

Food4Education is an award-winning, African-led nonprofit tackling classroom hunger with a locally rooted, scalable model. Building on more than a decade of learning by doing, we’re powering a new school-feeding industry and sharing our blueprint to scale sustainable, nutritious, and affordable school-feeding programs across Africa. Today, we serve over 600,000 students daily in Kenya, but what we deliver goes beyond the meal. Each plate improves nutrition, fuels learning, and creates jobs that uplift entire communities. We are an experienced, trusted non-profit partner that operates with the excellence of a global business, reinvesting the value we create into local economies.

Over the past decade, F4E has expanded its reach exponentially, serving over 200 million cumulative meals since its inception and growing from just 25 children fed daily in 2012 to over 635,000 students receiving meals every day in 2026. We deliver daily meals to children in 2,000+ public schools and early childhood centers. Parents pay for these meals through a mobile money system linked to NFC wristbands, which their children wear and ‘Tap2Eat’ in under 5 seconds to access their meal.

Our goal is to sustainably reach 1 million students in Kenya by 2027 and at least another 2 million across Africa by 2030 through our new Center of Excellence and technical assistance arm.


Our Values
At Food4Education, our values are guiding principles that provide us with purpose and direction and set the tone for our interactions with all stakeholders:
  • Build with excellence and curiosity - We’re not afraid to try new things and iterate as much as we can to find the best and most efficient way to get results.
  • Be the change you seek - We acknowledge that continuous improvement is a shared responsibility.
  • We do what we say, and say what we do - We embrace an ownership mentality;
  • Ask why, and commit- Share openly and question respectfully, and commit fully. When we understand the why, we can work with purpose.

About the Role
The purpose of this role is to identify and cultivate US-based Corporate Donors and to support and manage current Major Donors, stewarding and engaging them throughout an annual cycle.

Key outcomes will be:
  • Actively work with the Development team to close F4E’s annual fundraising gap
  • Creation of new partnerships with enthusiastic annual donors who understand their investment is changing the trajectory of children’s futures and food security across Africa
  • Clear, concise, and captivating materials that capture the essence of who F4E is, what F4E does, and the benefits we provide to our partners
  • Excellent management of the stewardship calendar for current Major Donors

Key Responsibilities
  • Drive a moves management timeline for 100 prospective and current donors, preparing and sending monthly comms to each, or prepping Head of US Philanthropy to do the same
  • Build out a US Corporate Partnerships platform with clear and exciting ways for collaboration, including employee activations with F4E, as well as other relevant marketing benefits for companies
  • Create coffee table book-level materials for Major Donor progress reports and proposals that are beautiful, clear, and convey impact and excitement for donors
  • Represent F4E at relevant US conferences with corporate prospects in attendance

Minimum Requirements

Education:
  • Undergraduate degree required
Experience:
  • 7+ years of related experience in fundraising, donor management, marketing or an adjacent field like PR or sales
  • Working in an international development context, ideally in Sub-Saharan Africa, preferred
Skills & Competencies:
  • Excellent experience with moves management
  • Excellent writing skills and very strong design skills
  • Experience working with CRM systems, such as Salesforce, required

Preferred Qualifications
Fascination with what a world looks like without hungry children trying to get through a day of school. Someone who loves to write and tell a story and engage someone in a journey. Someone who is not shy and feels honored to represent an opportunity to others for transformational change.

What Success Looks Like
  • Creating clear and captivating materials demonstrating F4E and why a prospective donor should partner with us.
  • A strong planning timeline indicating outreach plans and engagement strategies, and supporting the Head of US Philanthropy in consistent and timely missives to current and future donors.
  • Recruiting corporate partners and raising funds through their corporate headquarters and employees alike.

What is in it for you?
F4E has a strong culture of constant learning, and we invest in developing our people. You will have weekly check-ins with your manager and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You will have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding, long-term career.

F4E in the US is a small and mighty team of three, with external consultants working on many of our projects. You would be working directly with the Head of US Philanthropy and have high visibility and exposure to senior management.

Join Us
To apply, please submit your updated CV and answer the application questions listed. All applicants will receive communication on the outcome of their application, regardless of outcome.

We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, and people are supported to do their best work. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and lived experiences and make employment decisions based on merit, potential, and alignment with our values.

jobs.description:
Position Description:

We are seeking a Front-End Designer & Developer to own how our website looks, feels, and converts, and to bring that same design craft to the campaigns, collateral, and creative our Marketing Team puts in front of the construction industry every day. This position is responsible for writing real front-end code: clean, responsive HTML, CSS, and JavaScript inside our WordPress and Elementor environment. Our Front-End Designer & Developer will also work at a high level in Adobe Creative Cloud to support production of the graphics, ads, collateral, and campaign assets the Marketing Team relies on. The ideal candidate can seamlessly build landing pages and design tradeshow graphics, and do both well. The person in this role will partner closely with our Web Platform Engineer, who owns the technical health, security, and infrastructure of the site, while staying focused on design and front-end craft. If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, measuring what works with data, and using modern tools (including AI) to do your best work, this might be the perfect role for you.

NOTE: To be considered for this role, applicants must provide a portfolio for review. Your portfolio should show both design work and websites or pages you personally built.

Why Tenna?

At Tenna, we believe the best is right in front of all of us, and that each day holds more potential than the one before. We believe that every new discovery can lead to something better than we thought possible. When we boil it down, the top five qualities that define the Tenna Team are quality-obsessed, gritty, continuous learners, collaborative problem solvers, and just plain awesome. Sound like you? Join us as we empower our customers to control their mixed assets anytime, anywhere, on one comprehensive platform. Apply now!

Responsibilities

  • Designs and builds responsive page templates, components, and landing pages on tenna.com, writing clean, scalable, well-structured HTML, CSS, and JavaScript within WordPress.
  • Translates ideas and requirements into wireframes, prototypes, and production-ready designs, and moves them through stakeholder review efficiently.
  • Builds and maintains reusable blocks, patterns, and templates in the Elementor page builder to publish on-brand pages without custom development.
  • Ensures pages meet WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards (semantic markup, keyboard navigation, color contrast, alt text, and focus states) and tests for them.
  • Owns the front-end contribution to Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) through disciplined markup, asset optimization, and script management.
  • Maintains cross-browser and cross-device compatibility, and QAs work before it ships.
  • Builds branded landing pages, emails, forms, and templates in HubSpot, including personalized or smart content where it improves performance.
  • Owns and evolves Tenna's digital design system (components, design tokens, type scale, iconography, and Figma libraries) so the brand stays consistent as the site and team grow.
  • Applies and helps enforce Tenna brand standards across marketing output, including co-branded and partner materials.
  • Documents design and front-end standards so the work is repeatable, reviewable, and transferable.
  • Designs creative across the full marketing mix using Adobe Creative Cloud: digital advertising, social graphics, email, sales collateral, tradeshow and event materials, product launch assets, and print, alongside the Digital Content Creator.
  • Turns complex product and data stories into clear visuals, infographics, and presentation graphics for Sales, Customer Success, and executive audiences alongside Content Marketers and Senior Product Marketing Manager.
  • Coordinates video and photography projects from concept through delivery, briefing and managing external production partners, scheduling internal stakeholders, and reviewing cuts for brand and message accuracy.
  • Uses GA4, HubSpot, heatmapping, and search data to identify friction and opportunity, then designs and runs A/B tests on pages, forms, and calls to action.
  • Reports on the performance of web and creative work (conversion rate, engagement, campaign results) and uses what is learned to prioritize what gets built next.
  • Tracks design, web, and B2B digital trends and evaluates competitor sites to keep Tenna's digital presence ahead.
  • Partners with the Web Platform Engineer on anything touching plugins, infrastructure, tracking, or server-side performance.
  • Works cross-functionally with the Marketing, Events, Sales, TKC and Customer Success teams to deliver design support on realistic, negotiated timelines.
  • Uses Tenna-approved AI tools to accelerate concepting, asset variation, copy iteration, code scaffolding, and QA, while personally owning the accuracy, quality, accessibility, and brand fidelity of everything that ships.

Requirements

  • 4+ years designing and building websites, with a portfolio demonstrating both design craft and shipped front-end code.
  • Bachelor's degree in graphic design, digital media, visual communications, interaction design, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • Video editing and motion graphics experience (Premiere Pro, After Effects, or similar) is a plus.
  • Photography or videography capture experience for jobsite and customer content is a plus.
  • Experience marketing to construction, industrial, or other field-based B2B audiences is a plus.
  • Strong hands-on HTML5, CSS3 (including Flexbox and Grid), and JavaScript; comfortable working inside a WordPress theme and writing custom CSS to extend or override a page builder.
  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining pages in Elementor, including templates, global styles, custom widgets, and working within Elementor's markup and performance constraints. Tenna's website runs on Elementor, and this role works in it daily.
  • Practical WordPress experience with themes, templates, custom fields, and page-level components.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign), with a portfolio showing polished work across digital and print formats.
  • Proficiency in Figma for design, prototyping, component libraries, and developer handoff.
  • Working knowledge of HubSpot for landing pages, emails, forms, and templates.
  • Demonstrated understanding of UI/UX fundamentals, responsive design, and visual hierarchy.
  • Working knowledge of WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility requirements and how to test against them (axe, WAVE, keyboard and screen reader checks).
  • Familiarity with on-page SEO fundamentals and Core Web Vitals as they relate to front-end decisions.
  • Disciplined change management: works in a staging environment, tests before publishing, and keeps a clear record of what changed and why.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted design and development tools, paired with the judgment to know when human craft and review are required.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, communicate timelines clearly, and meet deadlines in a fast-moving marketing environment.

Benefits, Perks, & Additional Information:

  • Full-time opportunity.
  • Location: Remote - United States. East coast preferred.
  • Travel is required, up to 15%.
  • Competitive compensation packages offered.
  • Opportunities for growth and personal development within highly dynamic team.
  • Robust, low-cost benefit packages offered.
  • Benefit coverage begins the first date of employment.
  • Paid Time Off and Volunteer Time Off offered.
  • Dependent Care offered.
  • 401k match.
  • Employee referral bonuses.
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Tenna is committed to building a diverse team. We welcome different perspectives and opinions to foster innovation, authenticity, and excellence across all parts of our company, and are committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment.

Job Title: Manager, Customer Support

Location: Remote - US Only
