jobs.title: Oracle Functional Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Dream Big.  Go Beyond.  Be Unstoppable. About UsKyriba is a global fintech leader empowering CFOs and finance teams with cloud-based treasury, payments, risk management and working capital solutions.
jobs.description:
Dream Big. Go Beyond. Be Unstoppable.

About Us

Kyriba is a global fintech leader empowering CFOs and finance teams with cloud-based treasury, payments, risk management and working capital solutions. We serve 3,000+ customers worldwide, managing $15 trillion in payments annually and helping businesses optimize liquidity performance across the enterprise.

We're on a mission to become the most sought-after cloud technology company globally. We think big, innovate relentlessly, and challenge the status quo every day. If you are a problem-solver who’s ready to push boundaries and achieve more than you thought possible-you'll find an exceptional career within an extraordinary business.

About the Role

Kyriba is looking for a Product Owner to own the product strategy and delivery roadmap for Oracle ERP connectivity — bridging Oracle Cloud Financials and Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) with Kyriba's treasury and finance platform. This is a high-impact role sitting at the intersection of enterprise finance, ERP expertise, and next-generation AI-native product thinking.

You will work closely with Solutions Architects, engineering teams, and internal stakeholders to define what gets built, why it gets built, and how it scales. You won't just document requirements, you'll shape a connectivity vision that is intelligent, automated, and built for the future of finance operations.

This role is ideal for someone who has lived inside Oracle Financials deeply enough to know where the real pain is, and who is energized by the opportunity to solve it with modern, AI-first product design.

What You'll Own

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Define and maintain the product roadmap for Oracle Cloud Financials and EBS integration with Kyriba, covering AR, AP, GL, Payments, and Cash Management connectivity

  • Translate complex ERP financial workflows — procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, bank reconciliation, intercompany — into scalable, well-scoped product capabilities

  • Identify gaps in current connectivity patterns and prioritize improvements based on customer impact, technical feasibility, and strategic value

  • Develop a point of view on how AI and automation can fundamentally improve ERP-to-TMS data flows, exception handling, and financial intelligence

AI-Native Product Thinking

  • Champion an AI-first mindset across the Oracle connectivity surface — from intelligent transaction matching and anomaly detection to automated reconciliation and predictive cash positioning

  • Partner with engineering and data science to identify where LLMs, ML models, or AI agents can replace manual configuration, reduce implementation friction, or surface actionable insights

  • Define AI-enabled features with clear success metrics, rollback criteria, and responsible design guardrails

  • Stay current on how Oracle itself is embedding AI (Oracle Fusion AI, OAC, Digital Assistant) and identify partnership or interoperability opportunities

Discovery & Requirements

  • Lead structured discovery with internal SMEs, solutions architects, and implementation teams to surface requirements rooted in real Oracle deployment patterns

  • Write clear, actionable epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering teams can execute against confidently

  • Define and maintain FBDI template standards, API integration patterns (Oracle REST APIs, OIC), and data model requirements for scalable ERP connectivity

  • Own the Oracle-side data contract: chart of accounts structures, ledger sets, MOAC configurations, multi-currency — and how these map cleanly into Kyriba

Delivery & Execution

  • Serve as the product voice in Agile ceremonies — sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives — ensuring the team is always building the right thing at the right fidelity

  • Define UAT strategy and acceptance criteria for new Oracle connectivity features; partner with QA and solutions teams on validation

  • Maintain a prioritized, well-groomed backlog that balances new capability development with platform reliability and scalability

Stakeholder Communication

  • Serve as the connective tissue between technical teams and business stakeholders — translating ERP complexity into clear product narratives

  • Deliver regular roadmap updates and release communications to the Sr. Solutions Architect and product leadership

  • Bring a consultative, credible voice to conversations about Oracle configuration tradeoffs, integration architecture, and implementation scope

What You Bring

Required

  • 5–8 years of experience in product management, product ownership, or a senior business analyst role with a clear transition into product, with meaningful exposure to Oracle Cloud Financials and/or Oracle EBS

  • Deep functional knowledge of AR, AP, GL, Payments, and Cash Management; you understand the data, the workflows, and where implementations break down

  • Experience translating Oracle ERP concepts (FBDI, MOAC, Flexfields, payment process profiles, bank statement formats) into product requirements that engineers can act on

  • Demonstrated ability to write well-structured user stories, PRDs, or product specs

  • Familiarity with Oracle integration patterns: REST APIs, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), FBDI/ADFdi, BI Publisher

  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with cross-functional engineering teams

  • Fluent English communication skills; ability to work with distributed, global teams during US business hours

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with treasury management systems (TMS); Kyriba, FIS Integrity, GTreasury, or similar or financial middleware/connectivity platforms

  • Exposure to AI/ML product development: you've written requirements for AI features, worked alongside data scientists, or shipped intelligent automation in a product context

  • Familiarity with bank connectivity formats: BAI2, MT940, CAMT.053, ACH, SWIFT

  • Oracle Cloud Financials Certified Implementation Specialist or equivalent certification

  • Experience with Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC), OTBI, or Financial Reporting Studio (FRS)

  • Knowledge of SOX compliance and financial controls as they apply to ERP configuration and data flows

Why This Role

This isn't a role where you maintain someone else's backlog. You will own the Oracle connectivity product end-to-end — with the authority to set direction, the support of a strong technical team, and the opportunity to build something that scales across Kyriba's entire customer base. The addition of an AI-native lens makes this a genuinely rare opportunity to reimagine how enterprise ERP connectivity works.

Our Values Guide Everything We Do

  • Think Big & Constantly Innovate: We have the confidence to think big, embrace change, challenge the status quo, and continuously evolve - incorporating new technologies and driving industry progress.

  • Put our Customers’ Outcomes First: We are passionate about delivering the highest value for our customers and supporting them with end-to-end care throughout their journey with us.

  • Act with Integrity: Integrity is at the heart of everything we do. We take personal responsibility for our actions, own our decisions, and honour each other’s contributions. We empower each other through honesty, respect, trust and transparency.

  • Work as One Team: We are driven by our common goals and share in each other’s successes and failures, learning and working together as a team where everyone can bring their best selves.

  • Strive for Excellence while Having Fun: We enjoy tackling new challenges together, and revel in continuous improvement as we deliver, with ultimate professionalism, the very best for our customers, while exceeding our own expectations.

At Kyriba we value pay transparency and fairness.

For new hires, the annual base salary range for this role is zł218,000.00 - zł299,750.00 based on a full-time schedule. Salary can progress beyond this range through sustained performance and demonstrated success in the role. In addition to base pay, this position may be eligible for variable compensation (eg. performance bonus or commission-based plan) and a long-term incentive. The final package will be determined by factors such as skills, experience and qualifications.

Kyriba also offers a comprehensive compensation package, including a range of health, welfare and wellbeing benefits designed to support both your professional and personal life.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

Position Description

We’re seeking a Principal Data Engineer to own data architecture across our connected equipment platform. Reporting directly to the CTO, you’ll design the data systems and patterns that our engineering teams implement, from our IoT device ingestion pipeline handling data from our growing fleet of devices, to our data storage and processing infrastructure, to the data models and APIs that power our products. This is an organization-wide architectural role: you’ll set data architecture standards, provide design oversight to engineering teams, and ensure our data infrastructure can support our aggressive growth. If you thrive at the intersection of hands-on data engineering and architectural leadership, apply today!

Why Tenna?

We take pride that our roots are in the construction industry. With this experience and knowledge, we have built a platform that revolutionizes construction equipment fleet operations. We provide innovative solutions to customers looking for competitive ways to better manage and track their assets, such as heavy and light equipment, large fleets, tools, and materials.

At Tenna, we believe the best is right in front of all of us and that each day holds more potential than the one before. We believe that every new discovery can lead to something better than we thought possible. When we boil it down, the top five qualities that define the Tenna Team are quality-obsessed, gritty, continuous learners, collaborative problem solvers, and just plain awesome. Sound like you? Join us as we empower our customers to control their mixed assets on one comprehensive platform anytime, anywhere.

Your Responsibilities

  • Owns organizational-wide data architecture, defining standards, patterns, and designs that our teams will implement. Solves complex data challenges regardless of perceived ambiguity or degree of clarity.
  • Reviews data-related designs and implementations across teams for architectural consistency, performance, and scalability.
  • Produces reference implementations, proofs of concept, and hands-on guidance when teams encounter complex data engineering challenges.
  • Designs and develops data pipelines, integrations, and platform features with performance and scalability in mind.
  • Builds and maintains data APIs and ingestion systems that can handle complex, high-volume data efficiently.
  • Takes responsibility for the quality of data systems across the organization, including testing strategies and data integrity standards.
  • Owns the data architecture strategy across the platform, including database design patterns, data API standards, and data flow architecture.
  • Consults with product managers to define, scope, and plan new data features and capabilities.
  • Partners with the CTO and engineering leadership on strategic data initiatives and long-term architectural direction.
  • Partners with teams to define data quality standards, automated data validation patterns, and testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Partners with engineering and product teams to design and support data infrastructure for AI/ML initiatives, including model training pipelines, feature stores, and inference data flows.
  • Designs the IoT data ingestion and distribution architecture to support data from a significantly expanding device fleet, including replayability, aggregation, and real-time distribution patterns.
  • Tests, evaluates, and recommends technologies to improve our overall data infrastructure.
  • Produces excellent documentation.

Qualifications

  • 12+ years of professional data engineering or software development experience; self-motivated and driven to deliver impactful data products.
  • 2+ years’ experience providing architectural direction and design oversight to engineering teams, not just individual mentorship. Excellent communication skills are a must.
  • Experience setting data architecture standards and providing technical oversight across multiple engineering teams.
  • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or equivalent experience; intimately familiar with the fundamentals of computer science, data architecture, and distributed systems.
  • Substantial experience with SQL; experience with NoSQL is a plus.
  • Experience with Python for data engineering workflows; experience with Node.js is a plus.
  • Experience with distributed data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark or Apache Flink is a plus.
  • Experience with data orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow or similar is a plus.
  • Experience with containerized application deployments, especially using Docker, is highly preferred.
  • Experience with large-scale data systems and data warehousing solutions is highly preferred; possesses in-depth knowledge of the open source data ecosystem and how to incorporate it into scalable solutions.
  • Experience with message queueing architectures, especially RabbitMQ, is preferred.
  • Experience with Amazon Web Services, especially S3, RDS, DMS, and VPC; experience with Redshift or EMR is a plus.
  • Experience working with AI/ML systems, including building data infrastructure to support model training, inference pipelines, or AI-powered features, is a plus.
  • Experience designing data architectures for IoT or high-frequency telemetry systems is highly preferred.

Benefits, Perks, & Additional Information:

  • Full-time opportunity.
  • Location: Remote - nationwide.
  • Travel is required, 8 - 10%.
  • Opportunities for growth and personal development within a highly dynamic team.
  • Robust, low-cost benefit packages offered.

  • Paid Time Off and Volunteer Time Off offered.

jobs.description:
🏆 Great Place to Work® Certified | USA

Harbor Compliance is a leading technology platform for entity compliance, helping more than 80,000 businesses and nonprofits manage licensing, tax registration, and legal entity requirements nationwide. Founded in 2012 and recognized repeatedly by the Inc. 5000 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500, we've grown through five strategic acquisitions — and are now backed by a 2026 majority growth investment from Bregal Sagemount to accelerate product, AI, and customer experience. We're a passionate team making compliance simpler and smarter for every organization we serve.

The Director of Demand Generation & Digital Marketing owns paid, organic, and web demand across Harbor Compliance and its owned companies and brands. This is a build role as much as a scale role: we are evolving from a predominantly sales-led motion into a business that also acquires and expands through self-service and product-led growth, while moving deliberately toward mid-market and up-market customers. You will lead the demand side of that shift, positioning us for a new audience, building the measurement foundation to prove what works, and owning acquisition efficiency as the guardrail on investment. You will work in close partnership with Product Marketing and with Lifecycle & Customer Marketing, who own positioning and the post-acquisition journey respectively.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the demand generation strategy and roadmap across all brands, accountable for qualified pipeline and new ARR growth.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing demand generation team, and own the web estate and conversion surface with the Web Developer as a direct report.
  • Design and execute a testing roadmap (A/B and multivariate) across landing pages, campaigns, and conversion paths to continuously improve funnel performance.
  • Scale qualified pipeline through GEO/SEO strategy, content, and multi-channel demand campaigns across every brand in the portfolio.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to align messaging, targeting, and lead quality with pipeline and conversion objectives, across both sales-led and self-service motions.
  • Own acquisition efficiency across brands and funnels, using LTV-to-CAC as the guardrail on investment decisions, and treat budget as an output of funnel performance rather than a fixed allocation.
  • Establish data-driven reporting standards, translating web analytics and campaign performance into actionable insight for executive stakeholders.
  • Lead the demand side of our shift from sales-led to product-led growth, building self-service acquisition and conversion paths that run alongside the existing sales motion rather than replacing it.
  • Drive the move up-market, designing and executing demand programmes aimed at mid-market and larger customers, a segment the current funnel and positioning do not yet serve.
  • Build the measurement and attribution foundation, establishing reliable tracking, definitions, and reporting standards before optimising against them.
  • Play a pivotal role in pricing and packaging strategy, partnering with Product, Product Marketing, and Finance to shape how we price and how we present pricing in market, then leading the demand-side execution of those changes.
  • Own competitive positioning in paid channels in a fast-moving, easily imitated category, keeping our acquisition defensible and managing to payback discipline.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Marketing on positioning, messaging, and industry-specific conversion paths, ensuring campaign performance feeds back into positioning decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with Lifecycle & Customer Marketing to hand off acquired demand cleanly and to align acquisition targeting with retention and expansion outcomes.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of B2B marketing experience leading demand generation across both sales-led and product-led motions.
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience, with a track record of building and developing high-performing marketing teams.
  • Proven experience owning revenue and efficiency metrics (e.g., ARR contribution, CAC) in a high-growth environment.
  • Technical proficiency with marketing automation, CRM platforms (HubSpot preferred), and web analytics tools (e.g., GA4).
  • Demonstrated ability to align marketing programmes with sales objectives, and to build a self-service motion that complements rather than competes with the sales team.
  • Strong track record of diagnosing funnel friction and implementing pragmatic, measurable improvements.
  • Direct experience building or scaling a self-service / product-led acquisition motion inside a company that was previously sales-led.
  • Experience positioning and generating demand for a new audience, including mid-market and enterprise buyers, and building the funnel, content, and channels to reach them.
  • Has contributed materially to pricing and packaging decisions and led the go-to-market execution of a pricing change.
  • Has built or rebuilt a marketing measurement and attribution implementation, not only operated a working one.
  • Experience running demand generation across multiple brands or business units.

Skills and Knowledge

  • Advanced understanding of SEO-informed content strategy and its role in pipeline generation.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered outbound tools and workflows (e.g., Clay, Apollo, enrichment/automation platforms).
  • Practical knowledge of conversion-focused UX principles and funnel optimization methodologies.
  • Commercial fluency in pricing, packaging, and monetisation, and how each shapes demand.
  • Understanding of product-led growth mechanics, including self-service onboarding, in-product conversion, and where they hand off to sales.

Trustpair stops vendor fraud before it happens. We're the automated vendor validation platform protecting 550+ enterprise companies worldwide. Since 2017, finance and procurement teams have used Trustpair to eliminate vendor fraud while reclaiming 90% of the time they once spent on manual checks.

As vendor fraud grows more sophisticated, we stay ahead by combining deep expertise in financial crime with cutting-edge technology. Our core product focuses on secure, reliable vendor account validation to wipe out fraud and boost efficiency.

Internally, teams across Trustpair use AI tools in their day-to-day work to automate repetitive tasks and unlock strategic insights that help us build and operate better. From day one, you’ll be encouraged and trained to integrate these tools into your workflow in a practical, hands-on way.

With offices in New York, Paris, London, and Milan, we're a diverse team united by a bias for action. We ship fast, learn from experiments, and tackle problems that matter: protecting billions in payments for companies worldwide. If you want to see your work make an immediate impact in financial security, Trustpair is built for you.

Learn more abouthow we use AI in our everyday work.



About the role

Integrated into our talented Engineering Department, we have two positions open, you’ll work on creatinga scalable and efficient product which consistently meets the needs of our clients. You’ll work oncollaborative topics such as designing new features & functionalities, implementation, development and even testing the application.

Trustpair’s engineering team works with the latest technologies, as a Cellular Organization, meaning we reshape and adapt to ensure our teams stay autonomous, independent and have impact on the decisions made.

This is a permanent contract (CDI), suitable for candidates based in France. Hybrid or full remote within France is possible.

What you'll do:

  • Take the lead in creating innovative features by following best practices and maintaining exceptional code quality

  • Engage in every phase of the SDLC; contribute to the architecture, code development, and even oversee the launch of new releases

  • Support critical services for our customers which ensures the security of their payments

  • Keep a finger on the pulseof the technology landscape. Identify emerging technologies and industry trends, and be proactive in recommending relevant improvements to our existing stack

  • Champion engineering excellence by fostering a culture of continuous improvement. Lead by example in practicessuch as code reviews, Test-Driven Development (TDD), pair programming, writing clean and maintainable code, etc

What’s in it for you 👀

  • High-Impact in a High-Growth Environment: Join a company with 50% business growth, where tech is one of the core accelerators. You'll be building solutions for a platform with rapidly increasing usage, directly influencing our success.

  • Shape Our Future: We want your voice in making the critical architectural, product, and organizational decisions that will define our future.

  • Modern Stack & AI-Powered Engineering: Work with a clean Ruby on Rails stack, state-of-the-art DevOps, and managed tech debt. We are aggressively adopting AI, both in our product (LLMs) and to boost your own efficiency with tools like Cursor.

  • Culture of Full-Fledged Engineering Ownership: We don't see you as just a developer. You are an engineer with a strong voice and full accountability. We empower you to drive initiatives from technical design to final impact.

  • Accelerated Career Growth: Our rapid expansion creates constant and significant opportunities for career advancement, skill development, and taking on new leadership responsibilities.

  • Collaborative & International Team: Thrive in a diverse, cross-functional, and international environment. We leverage collective intelligence and a supportive, senior team to solve cutting-edge challenges.

Why join Trustpair? A full list of our perks here!

Must-Haves:

  • 5 years of experience in Ruby (Rails) back end development

  • Ability to conceive the technical design of a complex product feature

  • Experience on working on a rapidly growing product; knowledge of architectural models of large scale web applications

  • Experience working in an Agile environment like Scrum or Kanban

  • Experience in API development and knowledge of resilience, scalability and security constraints

  • Fluent in English

  • Desire to work on longer term technical challenges & accomplish them

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience in full stack development (React, Javascript, Typescript...)

  • DevOps culture, ability to work on deployment pipelines and CI/CD tools like but not limited to: Docker, AWS, GitLab CI

  • Experience in an environment where security is important; sensitivity to good security practices

  • Experience in mentoring and leadership of junior and experienced people for good practices of software craftsmanship

  • Experience with other technologies in high-throughput environments

Recruitment process

  • First call with Aicha, Talent Acquisition Manager (30 mins)

  • Experience interview with our CTO (1h)

  • Case study with our Engineering Manager & an Engineer from our team (1h30)

  • Coffee fit with a Product Manager & an Engineer (30 mins)

  • Cofounders interview with Alexandre, our MD (45 mins)

jobs.title: Growth Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era.  Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it.
jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. The category is growing rapidly because AI doesn't work on bad data.

We're hiring a GTM Engineer to build the machinery that gets that message to the people who need it. You'll join the Growth team reporting to a co-founder, and build the systems the rest of the team runs on: content, visuals, videos, skills, agents- whatever the biggest constraint is that quarter. Your first and largest project is the content engine.

Requirements

We publish a lot - webinars, technical blogs, founder LinkedIn, product marketing - and most of it is still hand-made. Your job is to build a pipeline that turns a raw source into content a Staff Data Engineer or CDO with 20 years of experience would read and forward: real prompt engineering, a defined voice per author, evals that catch regressions, and the taste to kill output that's accurate and lifeless. Anti-slop is the point: an engine that ships slop faster has negative value. We build agentically here - Claude Code, MCP servers, and agent skills are the daily workflow.

What You'll Do

  • Build the content engine end-to-end: ingestion, theme extraction, drafting, evals, and the review step
  • Create content including webinars and product videos
  • Own and grow audience
  • Our team writes in distinct ways; the engine should sound like them, not like a model.
  • Make quality measurable.
  • Own the numbers - reach, engagement, pipeline influence - and cut what doesn't work.
  • Contribute the rest of the Growth stack as constraints move.
  • Work directly with the founders, customers, customer engineers, to lean and improve on how Soda talks about the category. Your opinion matters here.

You Should Have

  • 3+ years building things that go to market: growth engineering, marketing ops, technical content, RevOps, or a founder background. Titles vary; portfolios don't.
  • You can write, story tell, and you can tell good writing from bad: send us something you wrote that a technical audience read. The most important line in this ad.
  • Serious prompt engineering: multi-step LLM pipelines with structured outputs and evals, not chatting with a model. You know why the naive version produces slop.
  • Enough code to be autonomous: Python or TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, a database. Nothing should be blocked waiting for an engineer.
  • Generalist instinct: you find the constraint and fix it, and you'd rather build the workflow than do the task fifteen more times.
  • Enough data fluency to be credible: you can hold your own on pipelines, dbt, and warehouses.
  • Independence: you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries.
  • Fluent English.

Good to Have

  • Marketing or growth in data, developer tools, or infrastructure.
  • You've grown a technical audience of your own: newsletter, blog, LinkedIn, open source.
  • Building agentic workflows: MCP servers, Claude skills, or tool-using agents shipped to real users.
  • Data quality, data management, or data observability industry experience.

Benefits

  • $120,000-$130,000 base salary + equity.
  • Fully remote (US-based), with our Brooklyn office available if you want one.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • PTO, 401k, medical insurance.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • You own a function, not a queue: the content engine is yours to design, and behind it is a list of things nobody here has built yet.
  • Direct line to the founders: how Soda talks about the category gets decided with you in the room.
  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours, colleagues in 12+ countries.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • New and broad: no playbook for this role yet, and you'll be judged on output, not architecture. An elegant pipeline nobody reads from is a failure.

Hiring Process

  1. Screening - send one piece of writing or video you're proud of, and one thing you've built with AI.
  2. 20-minute phone screen - with a founder
  3. Craft deep dive (90 min)
  4. Culture fit (1 hour)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3-5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

jobs.description:
About PlanITROI

For more than 25 years, PlanITROI has helped organizations maximize the value of their retired technology through secure IT Asset Disposition (ITAD), lifecycle management, reverse logistics, refurbishment, repair, redeployment, and re-marketing services. Every device we recover creates financial value for our clients while extending the life of technology and helping provide affordable devices to individuals, schools, nonprofits, and businesses around the world. PlanITROI is a recognized leader in sustainable IT lifecycle solutions, helping enterprise organizations improve financial performance, strengthen security, and advance ESG initiatives through our circular economy model.

Today, we are building something even greater!

The world’s greatest Repair, Refurbishment, and Lifecycle Services organization!

At the center of that vision is our state-of-the-art Center of Excellence in Youngsville, North Carolina. A high-performance operation where technology, automation, engineering, compliance, and people come together to transform retired and underutilized IT devices into enterprise-grade, re-certified technology solutions.

PlanITROI is more than an ITAD company. We are redefining how the world’s largest channel organizations, OEMs, GSIs, MSPs, VARs, and enterprises think about lifecycle value, sustainability, circularity, risk reduction, and technology access. Our work strengthens ESG outcomes, recovers value, reduces operational and data-security risk, and creates new revenue opportunities across the IT lifecycle.

As we continue scaling globally, we are investing heavily in strategic partnerships, alliance ecosystems, executive engagement, and category leadership. We are seeking visionary, execution-driven leaders who want to help shape the future of lifecycle services, circular technology, and enterprise channel transformation.

If you are energized by building strategic partnerships, influencing enterprise ecosystems, creating category-defining messaging, and driving growth through world-class channel and alliance marketing, we invite you to help build that future with us.

This is a remote role, based in Latin America in Eastern Standard Time.

Engagement Type: Contractor

AI Video Production Specialist Overview

PlanITROI is seeking an AI Video Production Specialist to transform transcripts, scripts, and educational concepts into engaging video content that explains complex IT life-cycle topics clearly and compellingly. This role will create a continuous stream of professional video content ranging from short clips to full descriptive videos for various social media platforms, webinars, landing pages, and educational resources. The goal is to build a large educational video library that helps prospects understand IT life-cycle services, data security, sustainability, and IT asset disposition while positioning PlanITROI as the most educational voice in the ITAD industry.

Key Responsibilities

Video Production & Storytelling

  • Transform transcripts, scripts, slide decks, and raw story concepts from internal and client conversations into polished video content, including short-form clips, educational content, and longer-form storytelling videos that clearly communicate complex IT life-cycle topics.
  • Develop visual narratives that simplify complex processes such as device life-cycle management, chain-of-custody, refurbishment, reuse, and data security through motion graphics, animated visuals, and illustration-driven storytelling
  • Convert real operational photos from PlanITROI facilities into engaging visual content using overlays, motion graphics, and animated sequences.
  • Produce a range of video formats optimized for different use cases, including short social clips (15–60 seconds), educational content (2–5 minutes), and longer walk-through or case study videos (5–10 minutes).
  • Leverage modern AI video production tools (avatar-based videos, voice-driven videos, AI-assisted animation, and generative video) to scale content creation while maintaining professional quality.
  • Create and optimize video content for multi-channel distribution, including LinkedIn, YouTube, Reddit, X, Facebook, TikTok, email campaigns, landing pages, webinars, and website resources.
  • Contribute to and help scale PlanITROI’s long-term educational video library, covering industry insights, process education, sustainability, compliance, and thought leadership content.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong ability to communicate complex ideas through video storytelling, narrative structure, pacing, and educational content design.
  • Experience creating visual explanations using motion graphics, animated illustrations, or process-driven storytelling.
  • Proficiency with modern AI video production tools (HeyGen, Synthesia, Runway, VideoGen, Eleven Labs AI Voice, or similar), including avatar-based, AI-generated, and script/voice-to-video workflows.
  • Experience with AI-driven, video editing, and content re-purposing tools (CapCut, Descript, OpusClip, VEED, or similar platforms).
  • Strong video editing and motion design skills using professional tools (Adobe Premiere, After Effects, Final Cut, or equivalent).
  • Ability to independently translate ideas, transcripts, or concepts into polished, professional video content with minimal direction.
  • Experience producing and optimizing content for multi-channel marketing environments, including social media, email, websites, and educational content libraries.
  • C1-C2 English comprehension and communication skills to accurately interpret source material and develop clear, effective narratives.
  • All candidates should have a portfolio

jobs.excerpt: At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality.
jobs.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

About the Role

Forbes Advisor is looking for a SEM Strategist to join the Forbes Advisor Performance Marketing team, supporting Forbes Advisor's Financial Services business.

This role is responsible for driving the strategic direction and long-term growth of key paid search categories. The ideal candidate combines deep SEM expertise with strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence stakeholders across the organization. They will identify new opportunities, develop scalable growth strategies, champion innovation, and serve as a key driver of business outcomes across their owned verticals.

If you're looking for challenges and opportunities similar to those of a start-up, with the benefits of an established, successful company, read on.

The Paid Search Strategist will own category growth, shape roadmap priorities, influence cross-functional initiatives, and work closely with publishers, Product, Business Development, Data, Engineering, Finance, Compliance, and leadership teams to unlock new opportunities and drive meaningful business results.

Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership & Growth

  • Own the strategic direction, growth plans, and commercial success of key categories.
  • Develop and execute short-term and long-term growth strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Build clear category roadmaps that balance immediate performance opportunities with long-term capability development.
  • Identify, prioritize, and champion high-impact initiatives that drive sustained growth and competitive advantage.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for owned categories, proactively identifying market trends, opportunities, and risks.
  • Influence performance beyond directly owned accounts through thought leadership, best-practice development, and cross-category initiatives.
  • Generate innovative ideas that challenge existing approaches and establish new best practices across the organization.
  • Evaluate emerging industry trends, platform developments, and product innovations to maintain competitive advantage.

Performance Ownership

  • Take full ownership of category performance, including revenue, profitability, volume, efficiency, and growth targets.
  • Drive category growth through data-driven decision making and strategic allocation of resources.
  • Develop forecasting models and growth plans for owned categories, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
  • Analyze performance trends, identify root causes of variance, and communicate strategic recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and account audits to identify opportunities for optimization and expansion.
  • Utilize advanced analytical approaches to identify growth opportunities across campaigns, audiences, funnels, landing experiences, and partner ecosystems.

Innovation & Testing

  • Design and own testing frameworks that support strategic category growth.
  • Identify, prioritize, and scale innovative PPC tactics, automation opportunities, audience expansion strategies, and emerging platform capabilities.
  • Drive experimentation initiatives from conception through implementation and performance evaluation.
  • Build strong hypotheses based on data, market insights, and business needs to unlock new growth opportunities.
  • Scale successful initiatives across additional categories and share learnings broadly within the organization.
  • Partner directly with publishers and platform representatives to leverage beta programs, product innovations, and new capabilities.

Stakeholder Influence & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Build strong relationships with Business Development, Product, Engineering, Finance, Compliance, Analytics, and Leadership teams.
  • Influence stakeholders and obtain buy-in for strategic initiatives through compelling data, analysis, and business cases.
  • Partner with Business Development teams to identify new partner opportunities, market expansion opportunities, and monetization initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to identify and prioritize enhancements that improve business performance.
  • Present category performance, growth strategies, recommendations, and insights to senior stakeholders and leadership audiences.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor and thought leader within the Performance Marketing team.

Capability Expectations

  • Operates with high levels of autonomy and limited oversight.
  • Owns category strategy and growth as if managing their own business.
  • Develops and drives initiatives that influence performance beyond directly managed accounts.
  • Proactively identifies opportunities and challenges before they impact performance.
  • Leads strategic projects with significant business impact.
  • Creates clear vision, roadmap, and execution plans for owned categories.
  • Builds alignment across multiple stakeholders to deliver business outcomes.
  • Balances commercial performance with long-term strategic investments.
  • Drives adoption of new ideas, processes, and best practices across the wider team.
  • Acts as a trusted strategic partner to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Professional Competencies

  • Deep passion for search marketing and digital advertising.
  • Strategic thinker with a forward-looking mindset and strong commercial awareness.
  • Proven ability to identify growth opportunities and convert them into measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to make decisions using incomplete information.
  • Outstanding analytical and critical thinking abilities.
  • Ability to influence and negotiate effectively across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Exceptional communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving change.
  • Ability to connect market dynamics, business objectives, and performance marketing strategies.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and prioritization skills.
  • Growth mindset with a focus on continuous learning and innovation.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of experience in Paid Search / SEM, including extensive experience with Google Ads and Microsoft Ads.
  • Proven track record of owning and growing large-scale PPC programs.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing long-term growth strategies that drive measurable business impact.
  • Advanced understanding of Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, automation, smart bidding strategies, and audience targeting.
  • Experience managing significant budgets and delivering revenue and profitability growth.
  • Strong forecasting, planning, and performance analysis experience.
  • Deep knowledge of web analytics platforms, including Google Analytics and internal reporting solutions.
  • Experience using competitive intelligence and market research tools such as SEMrush, Adthena, Similarweb, or equivalent platforms.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive organizational change.
  • Experience presenting business cases, strategic recommendations, and performance insights to senior stakeholders.
  • Advanced Excel and data analysis skills.
  • Bachelor's Degree required.

Position Summary -

The Senior Payroll Specialist is responsible for ensuring the accurate and timely processing of multi-state payroll while maintaining compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements. This role serves as a trusted resource for employees, leaders, and business partners by providing payroll expertise, resolving complex issues, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a customer-focused approach to deliver exceptional payroll operations and customer service.

Key Responsibilities -

  • Processes multi-state payrolls timely and accurately by coordinating with HR to ensure accurate processing and maintenance of data while maintaining a high level of confidentiality
  • Processes and maintains payroll records including but not limited to new hire information, payroll changes, fringe benefit disbursements in accordance with company policy, regulatory requirements, and governmental requirements
  • Provides high level of customer service to all levels of the organization by troubleshooting and escalating payroll and timekeeping issues
  • Enrolls all newly hired hourly employees in the timekeeping system and trains timecard approvers in reviewing and approving timecards within payroll deadlines
  • Prepares, reviews and analyzes reports to maintain documentation of payroll activities and conducts appropriate audits to ensure data integrity
  • Oversees system entries and general ledger activity related to payroll functions
  • Identifies and implements system and process improvements and documents workflow and work procedures

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. Mid-Level Java Full-Stack / API Developer, Federal Civilian Programs, Remote (East Coast) Summary:• Job Title: Mid-Level Java Full-Stack / API Developer • Level: Mid-level (approximately 3–6 years of professional software development experience) • Security Clearance: U.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Mid-Level Java Full-Stack / API Developer, Federal Civilian Programs, Remote (East Coast)

Summary:

  • Job Title: Mid-Level Java Full-Stack / API Developer
  • Level: Mid-level (approximately 3–6 years of professional software development experience)
  • Security Clearance: U.S. citizenship required. Requirement depends on program. CBP: must be able to obtain and maintain a CBP Public Trust; an existing DHS Public Trust is preferred. Department of State: active Secret clearance required.
  • Work Type: Remote: East Coast working hours, with travel approximately once per quarter; candidates in the Washington, DC area preferred
  • Job Type: Full-time
  • Agency name: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), Department of Homeland Security, or U.S. Department of State, Bureau of Consular Affairs, depending on program
  • Start Date: Immediate. Start follows a favorable suitability determination (CBP) or clearance verification (State) and completion of customer onboarding.

BizFirst is assisting our client with recruiting a skilled and experienced Mid-Level Java Full-Stack / API Developer. Our client is the prime contractor and incumbent on federal civilian programs at U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) and the U.S. Department of State. The developer builds modern, secure, cloud-native enterprise applications for these programs using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, relational databases, enterprise messaging, and modern front-end technologies. The work covers the full application lifecycle, from database development and API-first design with OpenAPI to event-driven integration with JMS and Apache Kafka, automated testing, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and API/developer portals built with React and/or Angular. Experience with AI-assisted development and automated test-case generation is highly desirable. The role is fully remote on East Coast hours and requires U.S. citizenship.

Our client is an IT solutions and services company based in Alpharetta, Georgia, founded in 2000 to build mission-critical systems that run around the clock. Its cloud experts design and build cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, with work spanning cloud strategy and architecture, cloud modernization and engineering, security and compliance, cloud DevOps, and data and analytics. Federal civilian agencies are a core part of that work, supported through a GSA Multiple Award Schedule contract, and the company is an AWS Advanced Tier Services Partner.

What will you do

Build enterprise applications from the database to the browser. You will design schemas and write SQL, build Java and Spring Boot services, define REST APIs in OpenAPI first, connect systems through JMS and Kafka messaging, automate testing, package services in Docker, and deploy them to Kubernetes through CI/CD pipelines. You will also build the API/developer portals and React or Angular front ends that help developers find and use those APIs. You will work across synchronous REST integration and asynchronous, event-driven architectures, troubleshoot issues across applications, databases, messaging platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure, and collaborate with DevOps, platform engineering, UX, API, and backend teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise applications, microservices, and backend services using Java and Spring Boot, applying established design patterns, secure coding practices, and development standards.
  • Build data-access components with Spring Data, JPA/Hibernate, and JDBC, and develop synchronous and asynchronous integrations between enterprise applications.
  • Design and implement secure, production-grade RESTful APIs using an API-first approach: create and maintain OpenAPI definitions, and generate or integrate API clients, server interfaces, documentation, validation, and test artifacts from them.
  • Apply consistent API standards for versioning, error handling, authentication, authorization, pagination, and observability, and take part in API design and governance reviews.
  • Develop event-driven and message-based integrations with JMS and Apache Kafka using Spring JMS and Spring Kafka, including producers, consumers, listeners, topics, queues, and event-processing components across publish/subscribe and point-to-point patterns.
  • Build resilient messaging with sound acknowledgment, retry, timeout, error-handling, and dead-letter queue/topic (DLQ/DLT) strategies, accounting for message ordering, delivery semantics, idempotency, duplicate messages, and consumer concurrency.
  • Work with Kafka topics, partitions, consumer groups, offsets, serialization, and schema management; monitor messaging flows, consumer lag, and failed messages; and apply security controls to messaging and event-streaming solutions.
  • Design and optimize relational database components in PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, or similar platforms, including logical and physical data models, normalization, schemas, views, indexes, constraints, stored procedures, and SQL queries; manage transactions, locking, isolation levels, connection pooling, and concurrency; and version schema changes with Flyway or Liquibase.
  • Develop unit, integration, API, database, messaging, and regression tests, including tests for Kafka/JMS producers, consumers, and event-driven workflows, and run them automatically in CI/CD pipelines.
  • Use automated and AI-assisted approaches to generate test cases, test data, and test scenarios, working with API testing and automation technologies such as Arazzo or similar tools.
  • Package applications with Docker, build optimized container images, and deploy, operate, and troubleshoot them on Kubernetes using Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, Ingress, and health probes.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Harness, or similar) that integrate builds, automated tests, database migrations, security scanning, container builds, and Kubernetes deployments, and promote releases from development through production.
  • Build and maintain API/developer portals with Scalar, Redocly, Swagger UI, Backstage, or similar platforms, including interactive OpenAPI documentation, API catalogs, getting-started guides, examples, and developer onboarding workflows.
  • Develop responsive, accessible web applications and portal interfaces in React and/or Angular using JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, with reusable UI components integrated with REST APIs.
  • Troubleshoot complex application, integration, database, messaging, and performance issues, and take part in peer code reviews and continuous improvement.

Requirements:

  • U.S. citizenship.
  • CBP positions: able to obtain and maintain a CBP Public Trust background investigation. Department of State positions: active Secret clearance.
  • Approximately three to six (3–6) years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong Java programming experience and hands-on experience with Spring Boot and the Spring ecosystem.
  • Experience designing and developing REST APIs and microservices, with working knowledge of OpenAPI/Swagger and API-first development.
  • Experience with enterprise messaging technologies such as JMS and Apache Kafka, and an understanding of asynchronous processing and event-driven architectures.
  • Strong SQL and relational database development experience with PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, or comparable databases, including schema design, data modeling, SQL optimization, indexing, and transactions.
  • Experience using JPA/Hibernate, Spring Data, and/or JDBC.
  • Experience writing automated unit, integration, API, database, and messaging tests with tools such as JUnit, Mockito, and REST Assured.
  • Experience with Docker and containerized application development, and working knowledge of Kubernetes.
  • Experience with automated CI/CD pipelines, Git, and modern source-control workflows.
  • Experience developing web applications with React and/or Angular, and working knowledge of JavaScript and/or TypeScript.
  • Understanding of application, API, messaging, and database security principles.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Able to work remotely on East Coast hours and travel approximately once per quarter.

Desired Skills

  • Experience with Spring Kafka and Spring JMS.
  • Experience with Kafka consumer groups, partitioning, schema management, retries, and dead-letter topics.
  • Experience with JMS-compatible messaging platforms such as IBM MQ, ActiveMQ, or Artemis.
  • Experience with automated or AI-assisted test-case generation, and knowledge of Arazzo or comparable API testing and automation solutions.
  • Experience with Flyway or Liquibase.
  • Experience developing or maintaining API/developer portals with Scalar, Redocly, Swagger UI, Backstage, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience deploying Spring Boot applications to Kubernetes, and familiarity with Helm and Kubernetes deployment automation.
  • Understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, and API authentication and authorization.
  • Familiarity with API gateways and API management platforms.
  • Experience with application, database, API, and messaging observability.
  • Familiarity with DevSecOps practices and automated security scanning.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Chief of Staff–style operator to serve as the President’s right hand and help run, maintain, and continuously evolve the Product, Engineering & Design operating model and cadence.

This role will turn strategy into a durable execution system. You will own the connective tissue across the President’s leadership cadence: preparing the right inputs, creating clarity on decisions and tradeoffs, ensuring commitments are followed through, surfacing risks early, and improving the operating model as the organization changes. You will work across Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Finance, People, and your peers in Business Operations, partnering with senior leaders who do not report to you and influencing through judgment, trust, and clarity.

The successful candidate will combine executive judgment, operational rigor, business acumen, comfort with ambiguity, strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to move fluidly between strategic questions and the execution details required to make the system work.

AI fluency is an important part of this role. You will use approved enterprise AI tools, including tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Glean, Cursor, or comparable platforms, to automate repeatable operating work, synthesize information across functions, improve leadership preparation, surface risks and dependencies, and accelerate strategic-initiative delivery.

This role reports to the VP of Operations at Squarespace and is based remotely in California or locally at our New York City headquarters.

You’ll Get To…

  • Run the President's operating cadence. Own end-to-end orchestration of the leadership rhythm: staff meetings, WBRs, MBRs, and QBRs, finance and portfolio reviews, priority updates, and annual operating-plan inputs. Ensure each ritual has a clear purpose, owner, input, output, decision authority, and downstream cascade.
  • Drive decision quality. Synthesize diverse inputs into concise narratives that make priorities, risks, options, tradeoffs, and recommended decisions clear to the President and leadership team. Document decisions in the room, assign owners and deadlines, track commitments, and escalate unresolved issues with context and a proposed path forward.
  • Improve execution velocity. Identify alignment and execution risks before they surface as leadership surprises, and facilitate resolution across Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Customer Operations, Finance, People, and Business Operations, connecting planning, performance, financial, organizational, and roadmap inputs. Use AI and advanced tooling to make decisions faster and better-informed.
  • Evolve the operating model. Treat the operating system as a living thing. Establish health measures such as decision latency, action closure, cascade reach, pre-read quality, participation, recurring issue themes, and use them to assess whether rituals, artifacts, and escalation paths are producing the right outcomes. Recommend and implement changes to cadence, governance, templates, roles, and channels as strategy and priorities evolve, codifying what works so the model is easy for leaders to understand and operate.
  • Lead high-priority strategic initiatives. Drive complex, ambiguous, cross-functional work on behalf of the President, from framing and workplan through decision, implementation, and follow-through, including emerging problems that don't yet have a clear owner. Support annual strategy, goals, headcount, and budget processes by connecting them to the department's operating rhythm.
  • Represent the President and build transparency. Stand in for the President in meetings, events, and discussions, exercising the remit of the position. Navigate difficult conversations and cross-functional tradeoffs without relying on formal authority. Support two-way access to the President through Town Halls, Roundtables, Office Hours, and written follow-up, using sound judgment about what should be broadly communicated, selectively shared, or handled privately.
  • Serve as a trusted thought partner to the President and senior leadership team, offering an independent perspective and respectfully challenging assumptions when needed.

Who We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in Chief of Staff, Product Operations, Business Operations, Strategy & Operations, or management consulting
  • A track record of owning an operating model, leadership cadence, or portfolio of complex cross-functional initiatives, preferably in tech companies
  • Knowledge of the product / software development lifecycle
  • Demonstrated proficiency with enterprise AI tools, such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Glean, Cursor, or comparable approved tools, and experience integrating them into daily workflows to automate repeatable tasks, optimize processes, improve synthesis, and accelerate project delivery.
  • Exceptional written communication: you can turn a large volume of input into a concise, decision-ready narrative tailored to the audience
  • Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to understand metrics, forecasts, resource tradeoffs, product or portfolio performance, and organizational implications.
  • Strong executive presence and facilitation skills; you can create clarity and momentum in high-stakes or ambiguous settings.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, build consensus, resolve conflict, and push for decisions without formal authority.
  • High judgment and discretion when handling sensitive organizational, people, financial, and strategic information.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, switching between strategic altitude and detailed execution, and taking ownership of problems that cross organizational boundaries.
  • A continuous-improvement mindset: you distinguish between process and content, challenge ineffective routines, and make change practical and durable.
  • A bias toward action, paired with the judgment to know when to decide, when to seek input, and when to escalate.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 6–12 months, you will:

Position Description:

We are seeking a Talent Acquisition Partner who thrives at the intersection of strategy and fast-paced execution, someone who doesn't just fill roles, but builds the talent engine that powers a scaling company. In this highly visible role, you will partner closely with leadership to drive full-cycle recruiting across our teams, architecting sourcing pipelines before the need is urgent, shaping how candidates experience our brand from first touchpoint to hire, and staying two steps ahead of our hiring needs. You bring serious full-cycle recruiting chops, a sharp eye for data, and the kind of sourcing creativity that finds exceptional talent others overlook. Most importantly, you believe that who you hire defines the culture and capability of everything a company builds. If you're energized by the challenge of attracting top-tier talent to a product that's transforming an industry, this role was made for you.

Why Tenna?

At Tenna, we believe the best is right in front of all of us, and that each day holds more potential than the one before. We believe that every new discovery can lead to something better than we thought possible. When we boil it down, the top five qualities that define the Tenna Team are quality-obsessed, gritty, continuous learners, collaborative problem solvers, and just plain awesome. Sound like you? Join us as we empower our customers to control their mixed assets anytime, anywhere, on one comprehensive platform. Apply now!

Responsibilities

  • Design, drive, and continuously improve Tenna’s recruiting strategies to align with growth objectives and workforce planning in partnership with the Director of Human Resources.
  • Collaborate with leadership and Hiring Managers to anticipate talent needs and establish proactive sourcing pipelines.
  • Analyze external labor market data and internal talent gaps to develop sourcing strategies by function and level.
  • Partners with the Director of Human Resources to identify opportunities for internal mobility and succession-based hiring pipelines.
  • Own and optimize the candidate journey from sourcing to onboarding, ensuring every touchpoint reflects Tenna’s core values positively.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and up-to-date ATS, including but not limited to candidate notes, disqualification reasons, job statuses, and tagging, to ensure accurate reporting and compliance.
  • Ensure that all recruiting data is clean and auditable. Conduct periodic ATS audits and train stakeholders on best practices for data hygiene as needed.
  • Develop structured interview guides, scorecards, and decision-making frameworks to reduce bias and improve consistency.
  • Maintain SLAs with hiring managers, facilitate kickoff and debrief sessions, and provide training to ensure best-in-class (consistent and objective) hiring practices.
  • Oversee and grow the company’s employer brand through digital campaigns, career site enhancements, and social media content in partnership with the Marketing Team.
  • Identify, coordinate, and execute recruiting event attendance, including career fairs, virtual hiring days, university meetups, hackathons, and community initiatives.
  • Partner with internal teams to develop branded event materials and promotional strategies.
  • Build relationships with external organizations, boot camps, and diversity-focused communities to expand event reach and increase candidate flow.
  • Build and maintain a database of high-potential passive candidates through research, networking, and direct sourcing efforts.
  • Utilize Boolean search techniques to identify and engage passive candidates through advanced search logic.
  • Leverage social media platforms (e.g., LinkedIn, X/Twitter, GitHub, Slack communities) to source talent and promote open roles.
  • Engage with niche and industry-specific job boards to attract candidates with specialized skill sets.
  • Promote and manage employee referral programs to drive warm leads and expand candidate reach through internal networks.
  • Establish a structured CRM process to nurture and revisit top-tier past candidates and alumni for open roles.
  • Proactively create and adapt candidate outreach strategies on sourcing platforms to improve engagement and pipeline performance.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in sourcing tools and platforms, including LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, job boards, and CRM systems.
  • Recommend sourcing budget allocations and tracking the return on investment (ROI) of channels and events.
  • Ensure all recruiting activities comply with relevant employment laws, including EEO, OFCCP, and GDPR/CCPA, as applicable.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in Human Resources, with demonstrated expertise in full-cycle talent acquisition and recruitment operations.
  • 5+ years’ experience leading talent acquisition initiatives for at least 5 years, ideally within a high-growth or fast-paced environment.
  • Proven success hiring across technical, corporate, and high-volume roles, with flexibility to adapt sourcing strategies accordingly.
  • Proven success in strategic sourcing, candidate evaluation, and stakeholder partnership across multiple functions and levels.
  • Hands-on experience using ATS platforms such as Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, or iCIMS to manage workflows, data, and compliance.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze recruiting funnel data and use insights to recommend and implement process improvements.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Suite: Excel, Word, PPT, and Outlook.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and sustain effective relationships with internal stakeholders, hiring managers, and external partners.
  • Diligent, thorough, and detail-oriented.
  • Proven ability to manage confidential and sensitive information.
  • Deadline-driven with a strong sense of urgency and accountability to meet business hiring goals.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and consult across all levels of the organization.
  • Experienced in handling confidential and sensitive information with discretion and integrity.
  • Self-starter with a service-oriented mindset, capable of adapting to shifting priorities and taking ownership of outcomes.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in a business-related major is required or equivalent.

Benefits, Perks, & Additional Information:

  • Location: Remote - United States. East coast preferred.

  • Opportunities for growth and personal development within highly dynamic team.

  • 401k match.
  • Employee referral bonuses.

This role focuses on building strategic relationships with hotel brands, channel partners, and industry stakeholders while positioning the company as a trusted provider of secure, scalable, and high-performance connectivity solutions. 

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of managed Wi-Fi, networking fundamentals, and recurring revenue (MRR) business models, with experience selling into hospitality, multi-dwelling units (MDU), retail, healthcare, education, or enterprise environments.

Frames solutions around measurable business outcomes rather than features, and guides customers through complex decisions with credibility and insight.

  • Curious and adaptable problem solver: Explores new market opportunities, identifies emerging trends, asks thoughtful questions, and thrives in dynamic and fast-moving environments.
