jobs.title: Manager, Policy and Compliance, Certification
jobs.excerpt: At LegitScript, we are passionate about making the internet and payment ecosystems safer and more transparent.
jobs.description:
At LegitScript, we are passionate about making the internet and payment ecosystems safer and more transparent. We help companies of all sizes keep their services legal and safe for consumers. To do this, LegitScript combines big data with the world’s leading team of experts skilled in highly regulated and complex sectors, including transaction laundering detection, pharmaceuticals, online gambling, and more.

The result? Unmatched accuracy and deep risk analysis that identifies which commercial entities play by the rules, and which do not. Our diverse industry partnerships provide unique insights that keep businesses and governments at the forefront of emerging trends. That’s why LegitScript is trusted by the world's largest search engines, internet platforms, payment companies, and regulatory agencies.

Overview:

The Manager, Policy and Compliance - Certification is responsible for overseeing Certification's compliance frameworks and proactively monitoring industry trends, laws, and regulations to keep the Certification business unit ahead of regulatory change. At its core, this role ensures the certification team stays current on regulatory developments and partners with cross-functional teams to effectively integrate policy expertise into Certification Operations. A core part of this work involves translating complex policy and technical regulatory requirements into clear, plain language that clients and internal stakeholders can easily understand and act on.

This role also oversees the Policy and Compliance team's escalation-based support for analysts' review work, providing guidance and hands-on support when compliance-related escalations arise during application and monitoring reviews. A key part of this role involves partnering closely with the legal and research team to ensure internal compliance frameworks remain current, certification standards and terms and conditions are updated as needed, and escalations related to denials, suspensions, and certification operations are adequately addressed — including joining external calls as needed.

This role also carries responsibility for leading critical calls with clients around complex compliance concerns and considerations, at times requiring close coordination with LegitScript’s legal team given the sensitive nature of these conversations.

As the leader of Certification's subject matter expertise, the Manager, Policy and Compliance, will partner closely with the Director of Certification Program Risk Strategy in guiding certification jurisdictional and scope expansions.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead subject matter experts (SMEs) for Certification program offerings, staying informed about industry trends, regulatory updates, and market changes. Utilizes knowledge to adapt operational strategies and guide the team in responding to shifts in the regulatory landscape.
  • Report on key regulatory shifts and trends tailored to different levels of the organization, offering documentation outlining insights, key takeaways, and forecasting potential business impacts and opportunities.
  • Identify and lead cross-functional initiatives that strengthen certification standards, streamline compliance operations, and scale P&C's processes to keep pace with jurisdictional, regulatory, and business growth
  • Oversee and update compliance frameworks as needed, including leading the annual Certification Standards Refresh.
  • Join customer calls as needed to support compliance client-facing work.
  • Support Sales with documentation needs/requests, scoping decisions, and client questions.
  • Develop policy team members through coaching, feedback, and growth planning; monitor team capacity and provide recommendations to leadership when adjustments to the Policy and Compliance team's structure or resourcing are needed.
  • Partner with theCertification Innovation Leader to identify ongoing opportunities to introduce AI and automation into policy and compliance workflows, improving efficiency and accuracy
  • Partner with the legal team on denials, escalations, suspensions, litigation concerns, and other matters as needed — joining calls and creating documentation to support the Certification compliance risk framework
  • Support the Director of Certification Program Risk Strategy on scope expansions by conducting discovery into the relevant regulatory facts, helping guide decisions about regulatory requirements and operational feasibility, creating documentation, and supporting team upskilling.
  • Manage day-to-day operations of the Policy and Compliance team, including hiring, coaching, and holding team members accountable to KPIs and performance standards.
  • Actively engage in behaviors that reflect LegitScript’s core values.

What You'll Bring:

  • In-depth knowledge of policy management, industry regulations, and compliance standards across relevant verticals.
  • Strong experience in managing risk and compliance programs, with a demonstrated ability to oversee policy development, implementation, and monitoring across operations.
  • Extensive subject matter expertise, with the ability to develop and execute strategies that align with industry trends, business needs, and regulatory requirements.
  • A forward-thinking approach to staying informed about industry trends and regulatory developments.
  • Demonstrated experience in building, coaching, and managing high-performing teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, and guiding teams through periods of growth and change.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to work across departments, operational strategies, and with broader business goals.
  • Strong ability to work in dynamic and evolving markets with a continuous improvement mindset.
  • Open to feedback and adaptable to change, viewing it as an opportunity for growth and enhancement of operational processes.
  • Excellent time management and problem-solving skills, allowing for the delivery of high-quality work even under pressure.
  • Proficient in MacOS, Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, etc.), and Microsoft Excel.
  • Skilled in professional writing, with experience developing and reviewing documentation to support team efficiency and compliance initiatives.
  • Well-developed ability to speak, read, comprehend, and write English.
  • Open to candidates with a 4-year college degree or a comparable blend of education and experience. We value practical skills, a strong work ethic, and a passion for learning, regardless of formal education
  • 2-4 years of experience managing people and/or policy & compliance related programs.

We succeed together, care deeply, stay curious, and inspire trust — and we look for those qualities in the people we hire. LegitScript offers competitive compensation, flexible work options, and a team that's genuinely invested in your success. If our mission resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Bamboo Health is the leader in Real-Time Care Intelligence™ solutions aimed at improving lives for everyone experiencing physical and behavioral health challenges. We are driven by our mission to empower clients to deliver seamless, high-quality and cost-effective care during pivotal moments to improve health outcomes. From coast to coast, Bamboo Health partners with all major retail pharmacy chains, 52 states and territories, 100% of the top 10 best hospitals and more than half of the country’s largest health plans to improve more than 1 billion patient encounters annually. Join us in improving lives during pivotal care moments!

Summary:

The Product Strategy Manager leads the evaluation and recommendation of strategic investments, growth opportunities, and market expansion initiatives that shape Bamboo Health's multi-year business strategy. You’ll build a deep understanding of the healthcare landscape, our customers and buyers, and the markets in which we compete, using those insights to help shape our strategy and multi-year roadmap.

In this role, you’ll evaluate strategic opportunities through market and competitive analysis, financial modeling, and business case development, translating complex information into clear recommendations for decision makers. You’ll also help inform solution packaging, pricing, and go-to-market planning and support the evaluation and prioritization of roadmap investments.

Reporting to the VP of Product Strategy, this is a highly visible, cross-functional role with regular collaboration across Product Management, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, External Affairs, and Engineering. You should be comfortable working through ambiguity, getting up to speed quickly on complex topics, and moving seamlessly between building the analysis and communicating the recommendation.

What You’ll Do:

  • Analyze market trends, customer needs, competitive dynamics, emerging technologies, and AI-driven changes in healthcare to identify areas for growth and investment.
  • Size market opportunities through TAM/SAM/SOM analysis and develop business cases that bring together market potential, customer value, competitive differentiation, financial impact, and risk.
  • Build financial models and projections to evaluate the bookings, profitability, and overall value of potential investments.
  • Evaluate strategic, customer-specific, and ongoing product investments to help inform roadmap priorities and tradeoffs.
  • Develop insights and recommendations related to solution packaging, pricing, positioning, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Partner across Product Management, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, External Affairs, and Engineering to gather perspectives, pressure-test assumptions, and build alignment around recommendations.
  • Turn complex analyses into clear, executive-ready recommendations and materials for leadership discussions, operating meetings, board communications, and customer advisory boards.
  • Stay close to the market and competitive landscape, bringing relevant insights and implications into strategic planning and decision making.
  • Lead strategic analyses from initial question through recommendation, bringing structure and clarity to complex or ambiguous business problems.
  • Stay curious about emerging AI tools and how they can streamline or enhance work within your function.

What Success Looks Like:

In 3 months…

  • Develop a deep familiarity with Bamboo Health’s existing solutions and solution positioning.
  • Understand our core buyers, market trends, and competitive landscape across customer segments.
  • Build an understanding of our strategy and roadmap and begin supporting the evaluation of strategic opportunities.
  • Explore opportunities to enhance workflows through AI or automation tools (e.g., document summarization, task routing, or data parsing).

In 6 months…

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Product Marketing, and Commercial teams on analyses that help inform the strategy and direction of the 12-to-36-month roadmap.
  • Translate opportunities into clear, quantified business cases and develop prioritization frameworks to support investment decisions.
  • Develop bookings growth and profitability projections for strategic investments.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships and establish yourself as a trusted partner for strategic analysis and insight.

In 12 months…

  • Be a recognized and trusted advisor to long-term business line investment and strategy discussions.
  • Help create strong alignment on strategy and investment priorities across key internal teams and executive leadership.
  • Independently lead strategic analyses from initial question through recommendation, bringing together market, customer, competitive, and financial perspectives.

What You Need:

  • 5+ years of experience in management consulting, healthcare, or in-house strategy roles – value-based care and behavioral health experience is a plus.
  • Experience developing business cases that consider value proposition, competitive differentiation, and market dynamics, complete with quantitative bookings forecasts and profitability projections.
  • Business financial fluency and an understanding of key business unit financial KPIs.
  • Ability to create succinct executive-level materials for communication of investments and strategy to the Bamboo executive team and our board.
  • A strong desire and willingness to learn; a roll-up-your-sleeves attitude toward tackling novel problems.
  • An ability to work productively with and drive alignment and consensus among various internal stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Experience driving projects from start-to-finish with a predictable cadence, involving multiple stakeholders from diverse disciplines.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence executive-level decision makers through data-driven recommendations and strategic storytelling.
  • A passion for improving healthcare outcomes.
  • Comfort using or learning AI-supported tools (e.g., ChatGPT, CoPilot, or role-specific tools) to improve daily workflows.
  • Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-growth, and rapidly evolving environments.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote-first environment, ensuring high-quality virtual interactions with minimal distractions.
  • The ability to travel periodically for work.

What You Get:

jobs.excerpt: CALLING FOR: Senior Software EngineerYou're the kind of engineer who reads a pull request and immediately spots the architectural decision hiding behind it.
jobs.description:
CALLING FOR: Senior Software Engineer

You're the kind of engineer who reads a pull request and immediately spots the architectural decision hiding behind it.

You think in systems, solve problems creatively, and bring both structure and imagination to your code. You don't just write code – you design systems, own trade-offs, and care deeply about what happens after you ship.

At ShippyPro, we're scaling a platform that handles tens of millions of shipments a month. The backend is where the complexity lives: carrier integrations, async workflows, distributed systems, edge cases that would make most engineers sweat.

If you think in abstractions, move with precision, and get genuinely excited about building things that scale – keep reading

About Us

Our journey began with a vision to Make people work better – and today, following our Series B funding round of $15M, we're transforming how companies worldwide deliver their products.

Engineering is at the core of everything we do. We're modernizing our architecture, integrating AI across the platform, and moving fast without cutting corners. You won't be maintaining legacy code in the dark – you'll be shaping how the system evolves.

Our fast-paced, collaborative environment is the breeding ground for creativity and innovation. You'll be surrounded by a diverse team of experts, all driven by a shared purpose, constantly pushing each other to reach new heights.

The Product

ShippyPro is a shipping and fulfillment platform that helps merchants automate the entire shipping workflow, from choosing the best carrier service to generating labels and tracking deliveries. It connects with e-commerce platforms and hundreds of couriers, giving teams one place to ship faster, reduce manual work, and keep full control over costs and delivery performance.

The Challenge

We're not looking for someone who closes tickets.

We're looking for someone who owns systems.

Our backend – built on PHP Laravel, NodeJS, and Python, while the frontend in React and TypeScript – is evolving into a microservices and microfrontend architecture with serverless and stateful services, handling hundreds of millions of global requests. We're also integrating AI capabilities across the platform, automating complex workflows and building intelligent solutions that transform how merchants handle shipping.

You're more than a developer – you're a true engineer. You're hands-on, but you're not just operational: you design, evaluate, and build solutions that scale. Your job is to bring structure to complexity, and ship things that last.

Why ShippyPro

  • You'll work on a backend that actually scales – millions of API calls, real distributed systems, real trade-offs
  • You'll shape the architecture, not just implement it
  • You'll use AI as a genuine engineering tool, not a buzzword
  • You'll collaborate directly with Product and Design – from idea to delivery
  • You'll see your work in production fast, with real merchants depending on it

Curious about our engineering culture? Check out this short video →

What You'll Do

  • Design and build scalable backend services in various languages
  • Architect microservices and contribute to our distributed systems evolution
  • Be hands-on with a big-picture mindset: you'll code, but also lead technical design and explore creative applications of AI
  • Integrate AI and LLMs to automate workflows and reduce manual work for merchants
  • Own performance and reliability – we handle millions of shipments every month
  • Collaborate with Product and Design from discovery through delivery
  • Write clean, tested, production-ready code – and hold the bar for the team

Our tech stack:

  • Backend: PHP (Laravel), NodeJS, Python
  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
  • Testing: PHPUnit, Jest, Cypress
  • Databases: MySQL, DynamoDB, Postgresql, Redshift, S3
  • Caching & Messaging: Redis, AWS EventBridge, RabbitMQ
  • Infrastructure: AWS (ECS, Lambda), Docker, GitHub
  • AI & Automation

What You'll Bring

The core, non-negotiable:

  • 5+ years of backend development experience
  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • Solid understanding of system design, clean architecture, and engineering trade-offs
  • Experience with microservices, async patterns, and distributed systems
  • A problem-solver mindset: logical, curious, and solution-oriented
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken – we work in English)
  • Experience on SaaS products or platforms is highly valued

Strong plus:

  • Hands-on experience across our stack
  • Experience with AI/ML integration, LLMs, or intelligent automation

What Makes You a ShippyProer

  • You care about the “why” behind every architectural decision
  • You take ownership – if something's broken, you fix it; if something's slow, you fix it
  • You have strong opinions, and you update them when the evidence changes
  • You're comfortable in ambiguity and thrive in fast-moving teams
  • You don't wait for the perfect spec – you ask the right questions and move

Why Join Us

  • Competitive salary between €42,000 and €56,000, calculated through our salary simulator – built on objective metrics, because we believe in unbiased compensation
  • Meal vouchers (office or remote)
  • Mental health support & fitness benefits
  • Yearly learning budget and AI tools
  • Remote flexibility with expenses-paid trips to HQ for team meetups
  • No clock-in/out policy and one-time home office allowance
  • Birthday Time Off – one extra day off, just for you!
  • Career Growth Program – clear growth paths, structured goals, and continuous feedback
  • An international team that moves fast and cares about building things well

Want to know more? Click here

Our Hiring Process

We take the time to carefully evaluate each step of the process to ensure the best fit for our team. After the initial review of your application, here's what you can expect:

1. Interview with the People & Culture team

This step is focused on getting to know you better and understanding whether there is a good cultural fit with our team + a short reasoning exercise (non-technical)

2. High-level technical interview with a Team Leader

A deep discussion of your technical experience and approach to problem-solving, led by one of our Team Leaders.

3. Technical skills assessment

This includes a practical evaluation of your technical skills, such as a live challenge, to see how you approach real engineering problems

A Note Before You Apply

If you want to move on with the application, you'll have to answer a few questions. We love AI (it's part of almost everything we do!) so feel free to use it, but make sure your answers still sound like you. We're not looking for polished corporate responses – we're looking for builders.

Thanks for considering joining our team. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.description:
Job brief

This role bridges regulatory rigor with shipboard reality protecting the lives of our seafarers, maintaining vessel integrity, and ensuring our ships remain commercially cleared by global charterers and Oil Majors.

Responsibilities

    • Document Control: Developing, reviewing, and updating the company's SMS manuals, procedures, and checklists (just like the Management of Change procedure you are currently working on).
    • Continuous Improvement: Ensuring the SMS remains practical, audit-defensible, and aligned with the latest industry regulations and best practices.
    • Implementation Verification: Ensuring that both shore-based staff and shipboard crew actually understand and follow the documented procedures.
    • Internal Audits: Planning and conducting annual internal ISM, ISPS (Security), and MLC (Labor) audits on the company's vessels and at the shore offices.
    • External Audits: Acting as the primary liaison during external audits conducted by Classification Societies, Flag States, and Port State Control (PSC).
    • Deficiency Management: Tracking and closing out any non-conformities (NCs) or observations raised during audits, ensuring corrective actions are implemented effectively.
    • SIRE : Preparing vessels for third-party inspections (like the Ship Inspection Report Programme - SIRE) required by Oil Majors or charterers.
    • Response Drafting: Formulating root-cause analyses and professional responses to vetting observations to clear the vessel for commercial trading.
    • TMSA (Tanker Management and Self Assessment): Driving the company's TMSA program, gathering evidence, and proving continuous improvement across various safety and operational KPIs.
    • Investigations: Leading or participating in the investigation of accidents, near misses, environmental spills, or equipment failures.
    • Corrective & Preventive Action (CAPA): Identifying the root cause of incidents and ensuring corrective actions (e.g., new training, updated procedures) are deployed fleet-wide.
    • Lessons Learned: Distributing safety bulletins and lessons learned to the fleet to prevent the recurrence of similar incidents.
    • Risk Assessments: Reviewing and approving complex risk assessments for non-routine or hazardous operations.
    • MoC Gatekeeper: Reviewing Management of Change requests (as seen in your email thread) to ensure that technical, operational, or organizational changes do not introduce unmitigated risks to the vessel or crew.
    • Horizon Scanning: Keeping track of upcoming changes to international maritime regulations (IMO, SOLAS, MARPOL) and updating company policies accordingly.
    • KPI Monitoring: Tracking fleet performance metrics (e.g., lost time injuries, outstanding MoCs, PSC deficiency rates) and reporting these to top management.

Requirements

    • Education: Open to any Bachelor's Degree. A degree in Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, Nautical Studies, or a Maritime Academy graduate is highly advantageous
    • Experience: 2–3 years in a QA, QC, or HSEQ role within maritime and/or Oil & gas Company.
    • Certified Awaness for ISO 9001
    • Proficient in maintaining audit logs, tracking vessel certificates, and monitoring Non-Conformance Reports (NCR/CAPA)
    • Willing to travel and attend seminars
    • Strong communication and presentation skills
    • Detail Oriented

About ev.energy
We are building the world's largest EV-centric virtual power plant (VPP). By connecting to vehicles, chargers, batteries, solar, and other distributed energy resources, we turn households into flexible grid assets that balance supply and demand, preventing blackouts and reducing reliance on fossil fuels.
We are scaling rapidly across North America and Europe. We are moving fast, we are AI-first, and we are looking for builders who want to power the grid of the future.

About the roleOur core platform is built in Python and Django, so we're looking for experienced backend software engineers with strong Python skills; Django experience would be beneficial but we’re open to other frameworks.

You'll be the person who takes a product idea and builds the systems, services, and infrastructure that make it real — reliable, scalable, and fast to iterate on. We're not looking for generalists who dabble across the stack — we're looking for someone with deep backend craft who can move fast, build with AI as a core part of how they work, and take genuine ownership of what they ship.

We're hiring for a number of roles across both of our Technology teams: new product development and customer delivery. We'd love to talk to you about both teams, understand what excites you, and place you into the team where we think you'll thrive best.

What you’ll do

Backend engineering and architecture
  • Design, build, and own backend services and APIs that power our product — from data models to infrastructure to production reliability
  • Make sound architectural decisions that balance shipping speed against long-term maintainability and scale
  • Take ownership of significant technical areas — from identifying the right approach to shipping and iterating in production
Building and shipping with AI
  • Use AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, or equivalent) as a core, daily part of how you write and ship code — not an occasional add-on
  • Build working backend prototypes fast — good enough to validate with real usage, not over-engineered before it's proven
  • Know when a rough implementation is right for the moment and when production-grade engineering is needed — and apply that judgment confidently
  • Ship, measure, learn, iterate — kill what isn't working, double down on what is
Product and stakeholder collaboration

  • Act as a credible engineering voice in cross-functional discussions, pilot programmes, and technical scoping conversations
  • Partner with Customer Support, Program Management, and Demand Generation to understand how customers find, adopt, and stay with ev.energy
Raising the bar
  • Share what you learn openly, challenge how things are built, and raise the technical bar for the engineers around you
  • Model what AI-native backend engineering looks like in practice — not in theory
  • Contribute to a culture of experimentation, velocity, and commercial impact

Our tech stack
  • Python and Django for our core platform
  • Django REST Framework for our APIs
  • React, React Native and TypeScript for our web and mobile app
  • PostgreSQL, Redis and DynamoDB for data storage
  • AWS for hosting, with infrastructure managed as code using Terraform
  • Claude (via the Anthropic API) features to power AI

What we're looking for

Must-haves
  • Strong Python experience (5+ years), with a clear track record of building and shipping production backend systems
  • Experience building backend services with a Python framework (e.g Django, FastAPI or Flask)
  • Strong experience building with AI — you've taken AI-powered features or products from concept through to production, and use AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, or equivalent) as a genuine daily practice, not just occasionally
  • Solid understanding of backend fundamentals — APIs, data modelling, databases, system design, and production reliability
  • Experience leading technical decisions and influencing direction without relying on hierarchy
  • Strong communication skills — written, verbal, and technical — credible with engineers, product, and commercial stakeholders
  • High bias for action and comfort with ambiguity — you make good technical decisions with incomplete information
Nice to haves
  • Experience in energy, utilities, cleantech, or adjacent domains
  • Experience with Django
  • Familiarity with EV fleet operations, home energy management, or grid services
  • Front-end or full-stack capability that lets you prototype independently without blocking on others
  • A portfolio of backend systems, tools, or products that prove how you work
  • Direct customer conversation experience that's shaped what you've built

Salary, benefits & how we work

The salary range for this role is $138,900-$170,200 USD.

Key benefits include:
  • Equity - you'll own a part of the business through our share options program
  • Healthcare options - to help keep you and your family in tip-top condition (provided by Cigna & Guardian)

You can find out more about our full range of perks and benefits here.

Location & how we work
This role is fully remote in the US, but we're specifically looking for someone based in EST.

We balance our remote set up by getting everyone together once a year for an offsite, as we know that spending time together IRL is super important.

jobs.excerpt: About UsWe are dedicated to helping uninsured and self-pay patients by negotiating medical bills on their behalf.
jobs.description:
About Us

We are dedicated to helping uninsured and self-pay patients by negotiating medical bills on their behalf. Through a structured process of investigation, fair price determination, and negotiation, we advocate for patients by leveraging billing expertise, price transparency data, and legal advocacy pathways. Our mission is to ensure patients are treated fairly, free from unjust or inflated medical debt.

Position Overview

The Paralegal strengthens our ability to advocate for patients by bringing legal research, issue spotting, and escalation support into the medical bill negotiation process.

This individual will research federal and state laws affecting medical billing, collections, consumer debt, credit reporting, financial assistance, and patient rights; help our team understand how those laws apply to individual cases; and identify legal or regulatory leverage that may help move difficult negotiations toward resolution.

When a case requires legal representation beyond our company’s scope, the Paralegal will help identify appropriate attorneys in the patient's geographic area, facilitate the connection, and serve as a liaison between the patient, outside counsel, and our company as appropriate.

The Paralegal will work closely with Patient Advocates and leadership to translate legal research and analysis into actionable strategies that strengthen patient advocacy and advance difficult cases toward resolution.

Key Responsibilities

Legal & Regulatory Research

  • Research federal and state laws, regulations, and regulatory guidance related to:

    • Medical billing and collections

    • Fair debt collection practices

    • Medical debt credit reporting

    • Hospital and facility financial assistance requirements

    • Charity care requirements

    • Balance billing and patient billing protections

    • Collection agency practices

    • Statutes of limitation applicable to medical debt

    • Facility-specific and jurisdiction-specific collection requirements

    • Other consumer protection laws relevant to medical debt

  • Monitor changes in state and federal law that may affect our negotiation strategies or patient rights.

  • Research facility policies, nonprofit hospital obligations, collection practices, and other information that may inform negotiation strategy.

  • Translate complex legal requirements into clear, actionable guidance for our team.

Negotiation Strategy & Case Support

  • Partner with Patient Advocates on difficult, stalled, or escalated medical bill negotiations.

  • Review case facts and identify potential legal, regulatory, procedural, or consumer-protection issues that may strengthen the patient's position.

  • Assist in identifying when a case presents legal or regulatory issues that warrant escalation to leadership of outside counsel.

  • Draft or assist with correspondence to providers, facilities, collection agencies, and other parties.

  • Maintain research resources, state-specific guidance, templates, and playbooks that Patient Advocates can use independently.

Outside Counsel & Patient Support

  • Research and identify attorneys or legal resources in the patient's jurisdiction when a matter may require legal representation beyond our company’s scope.

  • Support patients through the process of connecting with outside counsel while maintaining clear boundaries between our advocacy services and the provision of legal advice.

  • Serve as a liaison between the patient, our company, and outside counsel, when appropriate.

  • Track referred matters and communicate relevant developments to our team when they may affect the medical bill negotiation.

  • Build and maintain a network of attorneys and legal resources across states and areas of practice relevant to our patients.

Trends, Tools & Process Improvement

  • Identify recurring provider practices, legal issues, or state-specific trends that could inform broader negotiation strategies.

  • Develop practical research tools, reference materials, escalation guides, and templates for the Patient Advocacy team.

  • Partner with leadership to improve negotiation strategies based on legal and regulatory findings.

  • Train Patient Advocates on relevant laws, patient protections, research techniques, and escalation opportunities.

  • Maintain organized, up-to-date documentation of legal research and source materials so findings can be easily verified, referenced, and reused.

Qualifications

Required

  • Paralegal certificate, bachelor's degree in paralegal studies/legal studies, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

  • Strong legal research skills, including the ability to research statutes, regulations, case law, regulatory guidance, and state-specific requirements.

  • Excellent written communication skills and the ability to translate complex legal concepts into clear, practical guidance.

  • Strong critical-thinking and issue-spotting skills.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage research and support across multiple active matters simultaneously.

  • Comfortable communicating directly with patients, attorneys, healthcare providers, and internal team members.

  • Strong judgment in recognizing when an issue may require attorney involvement or further legal review.

Preferred

  • Experience working as a paralegal in healthcare law, consumer protection, debt collection, medical billing, creditor/debtor law, or a related field.

  • Familiarity with the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), state consumer-protection laws, and medical debt regulations.

  • Experience researching laws and regulations across multiple states.

  • Experience working with hospitals, healthcare providers, collection agencies, or medical billing disputes.

  • Familiarity with nonprofit hospital financial assistance and collection requirements.

  • Experience working directly with consumers or clients facing stressful financial or legal situations.

Skills & Competencies

  • Research: Able to conduct thorough legal research, identify authoritative sources, and determine which laws, regulations, and guidance are relevant to a particular case. .

  • Practical legal thinking: Able to turn research into a strategy the team can actually use.

  • Issue spotting: Recognizes when something about a provider's billing or collection activity deserves a closer look.

  • Curiosity: Willing to dig until they understand what happened, what rules apply, and what options remain.

  • Advocacy mindset: Motivated by helping patients navigate a healthcare and medical billing system that can be difficult to understand and challenge.

  • Communication: Able to explain complicated legal concepts clearly to people without legal backgrounds.

  • Judgment: Understands the boundary between providing research and advocacy support and the provision of legal advice or representation requiring an attorney.

  • Persistence: Comfortable working cases where the answer isn't obvious and the other side may not be particularly responsive.

  • Collaboration: Works closely with Patient Advocates and leadership rather than operating as a separate legal silo.

Expected Outcome

Our Patient Advocates are better equipped to resolve difficult medical bill negotiations because they have reliable legal research, stronger escalation strategies, and clear pathways to outside counsel when needed.

Success in this role means:

  • Patient Advocates have actionable legal and regulatory tools they can use in negotiations.

  • Difficult cases are escalated strategically rather than simply remaining stalled.

  • Potential legal, regulatory, or patient-protection issues are identified early and appropriately elevated.

  • We develop a strong, reusable knowledge base of federal and state laws and protections relevant to medical debt.

  • Patients whose circumstances may require legal representation are connected with appropriate counsel efficiently and supported through the handoff.

  • Lessons learned from individual cases strengthen our negotiation strategy across future cases.

jobs.description:
ÜBER DAS SYNTAX INSTITUT (EINE MARKE VON BILDUNG FÜR MORGEN)

Das Syntax Institut ist eine Marke von Bildung für Morgen und ein schnell wachsendes EdTech-Unternehmen aus Berlin, das von erfolgreichen Unternehmern gegründet wurde. Unsere Mission ist es, Menschen praxisnah für gefragte Berufe in der Tech-Branche zu qualifizieren und sie erfolgreich in den Arbeitsmarkt zu integrieren. Unser Angebot umfasst praxisnahe Weiterbildungen in den Bereichen Softwareentwicklung, IT-Administration, Cloud & IT-Security, Künstliche Intelligenz sowie Projektmanagement. Darüber hinaus bieten wir deutschlandweit an mehreren Standorten Umschulungen im Bereich Fachinformatik an. Dabei vermitteln wir aktuelle Technologien, moderne Arbeitsmethoden und die Fähigkeiten, die Unternehmen heute tatsächlich benötigen.

Aufgaben

DEINE ROLLE

Du willst einen Job mit gesellschaftlichem Mehrwert und dabei etwas aufbauen? In der Rolle als Standortmanager*in verantwortest du den Aufbau und den reibungslosen Betrieb unserer Umschulungsstandorte. Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zu IHK, Standortpartnern wie Berlitz und unseren Co-Working Spaces, sorgst dafür, dass alle regulatorischen Vorgaben eingehalten werden, und schaffst die Strukturen, auf denen erfolgreiche Umschulungen überhaupt erst laufen können.

Die Rolle eignet sich besonders für Organisationstalente mit hoher Ownership und Freude an Prozessarbeit, die Verantwortung übernehmen und unser Standortnetz aktiv mitgestalten wollen.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Standortaufbau & Koordination: Du meldest neue Standorte bei Gewerbeamt und IHK an, begleitest Begehungen und Abnahmen und verantwortest die räumliche sowie technische Ausstattung.
  • Partner- und Schnittstellenmanagement: Du bist die primäre Ansprechperson für Berlitz, unsere Co-Working Spaces und die internen Fachbereiche. Du baust gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern eine strukturierte Betreuung der Umschulungsstandorte auf und sorgst für verbindliche Abstimmungen über alle Schnittstellen hinweg.
  • Koordination der Umschulungsmaßnahmen: Du planst und koordinierst Kurslaufzeiten, Start- und Endtermine, Praktikumszeiten, Prüfungstermine und Kursferien in enger Abstimmung mit unserer Team Lead Student Success. Außerdem verantwortest du die An- und Abmeldung der Teilnehmenden gegenüber IHK, Co-Working Space und Partnern.
  • IHK- und AZAV-Compliance: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Umschulungen den aktuellen IHK-Richtlinien entsprechen, pflegst die Kooperationen mit der IHK gemeinsam mit unserem Head of Product und arbeitest eng mit unserem QM-Team an der AZAV-konformen Umsetzung, inklusive Unterstützung bei Auditvorbereitungen.
  • Prozesse & Dokumentation: Du entwickelst einheitliche Abläufe und Standards für unsere Standorte, dokumentierst diese sauber in Notion und unterstützt bei der Entwicklung eines Praktikumskonzepts gemäß IHK-Vorgaben.

Qualifikation

DAS SOLLTEST DU MITBRINGEN

  • Erfahrung: Du bringst Erfahrung im Office- oder Standort-Management mit und kennst die Anforderungen an den Aufbau und den operativen Betrieb von Standorten. Erfahrung im Bildungsumfeld oder in einem dynamischen Start-up-Umfeld ist ein Plus.
  • Ownership & Zuverlässigkeit: Du übernimmst Themen von Anfang bis Ende, arbeitest eigenständig und sorgst dafür, dass Aufgaben und Prozesse zuverlässig umgesetzt werden.
  • Kommunikations- und Koordinationsstärke: Du kommunizierst souverän mit internen und externen Stakeholdern, unter anderem IHK, Berlitz, Standortpartnern und unseren Fachbereichen, und schaffst verbindliche Zusammenarbeit.
  • Organisationsvermögen & Struktur: Auch bei mehreren parallel laufenden Standorten, Projekten und Fristen behältst du den Überblick und priorisierst effizient. Sorgfalt und Detailgenauigkeit sind für dich selbstverständlich, gerade bei Dokumentation und Fristenmanagement.
  • Prozessverständnis: Du entwickelst, dokumentierst und optimierst standardisierte Prozesse und achtest auf deren nachhaltige Umsetzung.
  • Qualitäts- und Compliance-Kenntnisse: Idealerweise hast du bereits mit IHK-, AZAV- oder vergleichbaren regulatorischen Anforderungen gearbeitet und Audits vorbereitet oder begleitet.
  • Technische Kenntnisse: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Google Workspace und MS Office sowie mit Dokumentations- und Projektmanagement-Tools wie Notion.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst und schreibst ausgezeichnetes Deutsch (C1 bis C2), um eine klare Kommunikation mit Partnern und Teilnehmenden zu gewährleisten.

Benefits

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Ein Business mit Purpose: Bei uns arbeitest du an Themen, die wirtschaftlich, gesellschaftlich und sozial höchst relevant sind (Digitalisierung, Wettbewerbsfähigkeit des Wirtschaftsstandorts Deutschland, Arbeitsmarktpolitik, Gleichberechtigung, Technologie etc.).
  • Verantwortung: Als Standortmanager*in trägst du viel Verantwortung für den Aufbau unserer Standorte sowie im Umgang mit aufkommenden komplexeren Themen oder Konflikten.
  • Attraktives Package: Neben einem marktüblichen Gehalt profitierst du bei uns von einem vergünstigten Sportangebot bei unserem Partner Urban Sports Club oder EGYM Wellpass und erhältst hochwertige Betriebsgeräte (MacBook, iPhone).

Wenn du glaubst, dass diese Rolle gut zu dir passt, auch wenn du nicht jeden Punkt erfüllst, bewirb dich gerne bei uns. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Wir freuen uns über deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung mit CV und optional einem kurzen Anschreiben.

jobs.description:
TrueCommerce is hiring a Systems Administrator II to join our Tech Ops team, supporting the hosted SaaS platform applications and customer-facing services that make up our core network. You will support the infrastructure backbone for TrueCommerce. The systems you manage have direct revenue impact. You will gain experience in a production environment that demands high availability, thoughtful change management, and genuine engineering judgment.

You will work alongside an experienced team of engineers, taking ownership of application-level administration across Windows Server environments, IIS, and the platform services that keep the business running.

This is a hands-on role. You will own day-to-day systems operations, respond to incidents, maintain and improve infrastructure, and contribute to the documentation and automation that keeps the team running efficiently. This role is ideal for a builder, someone who likes to establish operations and process that will improve our outcomes. We are working to scale and automate what we do and looking for talent that operates with high agility, curiosity and initiative.

What You'll Do:

Day to Day Operations

  • Administer Windows Server environments across production, staging, and development, including patching, configuration, and lifecycle management
  • Administer IIS and application server configurations, including app pools, site bindings, logging, and performance settings
  • Support Kubernetes-hosted workloads as part of the team's growing containerized platform, including pod-level troubleshooting, deployment support, and monitoring of cluster health alongside the DevOps team
  • Monitor system health, respond to alerts, and participate in the team on-call rotation
  • Perform routine maintenance: backups, patch cycles, certificate renewals, storage management, and capacity checks
  • Support Active Directory administration, including user and group management, GPO, and DNS

Azure Operations

  • Perform day-to-day Azure administration tasks for the tc.net environment, including VM management, storage, monitoring, and access control
  • Triage and resolve Azure alerts and incidents within the systems and platform pillar
  • Maintain and improve Azure monitoring dashboards and alerting configurations
  • Contribute to documentation of Azure resources, runbooks, and operational procedures

Incident and Change Support

  • Participate in incident response, performing diagnosis and remediation for systems-layer issues
  • Follow and improve change management procedures, including pre-change testing and rollback planning
  • Write and maintain runbooks and SOPs so that operational knowledge is captured and transferable
  • Contribute to post-incident reviews, identifying root causes and recommending preventive measures

Production Deployments and Release Support

  • Serve as the infrastructure-side partner in the release process, working closely with development, QA, and engineering teams to advance the architecture of the customer-facing platform
  • Own environment readiness for every production deployment: validate configurations, confirm infrastructure health, and ensure rollback paths are defined and tested before any release proceeds
  • Participate in release coordination, contributing infrastructure judgment to deployment timing, environment sequencing, and risk assessment
  • Work directly with QA and engineering on environment design and scaling decisions that affect production reliability
  • Participate in deployment post-mortems and help drive improvements to the release process over time

Automation and Improvement

  • Identify repetitive manual tasks and propose and implement automation to reduce operational toil
  • Support infrastructure-as-code efforts as the team matures its automation practices
  • Collaborate with the DevOps team on infrastructure changes tied to modernization and containerization efforts

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience as a systems administrator or infrastructure engineer
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • Must be willing to work rotating on-call, shared across the systems pillar
  • Windows Server administration, including installation, configuration, patching, and troubleshooting
  • Hands-on Azure experience, including VM management, Azure Monitor, storage, and RBAC
  • Hands-on Kubernetes experience, including kubectl, workload management, and cluster observability
  • Active Directory fundamentals: user and group management, GPO, DNS, and basic domain operations
  • Experience administering IIS or comparable application server platforms, including configuration, troubleshooting, and performance management
  • Familiarity with backup and recovery procedures and tools
  • Experience supporting production deployments, including pre-deployment environment validation and rollback readiness
  • Ability to read logs, trace issues across systems, and communicate findings clearly
  • Organized and documentation-oriented, comfortable writing and maintaining runbooks and SOPs

Preferred Experiences

  • PowerShell or other scripting experience for automation and administration tasks
  • Experience working in an ITSM or ticketing environment such as ServiceNow, Jira, or similar
  • Microsoft certifications such as AZ-900, AZ-104, or Windows Server equivalent
  • Familiarity with EDI, supply chain platforms, or integration middleware

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote first and casual work environment
  • 401k with 3.5% company match and vested after 2 years
  • 20 PTO days - 1 birthday day off - 3 summer days - 1 Volunteer day - 10 company holidays
  • Medical, dental, vision and other life/health insurance plans
  • Paid parental leave
  • Wellness reimbursement program

Who is TrueCommerce?

TrueCommerce is a high-performing global supply chain network that delivers fully integrated, end-to-end supply chain visibility and management. We help some of the world’s leading brands improve supply chain performance, including Schneider Electric, DanoneWave, Siemens, Ocean Spray, and many others.

jobs.excerpt: Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes.
jobs.description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is a leader in diagnostics, drug development and healthcare innovation. Across every role, we harness data and AI to work smarter, move faster and create breakthrough solutions that improve health outcomes for people. With our global scale and deep expertise, you'll do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact. Together, we're improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives.


Labcorp is seeking a Principal, Clinical Translation and Scientific Engagement Tead, Real World Data to join our team remotely in Bulgaria.


Work Schedule:

This is a full‑time, exempt (salaried) position with standard business hours in your time zone, Monday through Friday. Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible.


Main Responsibilities:


Strategic leadership & execution

  • Work with Global Head RWD Data strategy & technical solutions, as well as the wider RWD team, to understand shifts in RWD requirements and their implications to current strategy and product roadmap.
  • Contribute to product roadmap by identifying potential use cases and requirements to address shifts in technology and clinical practice.
  • Keep current with and appropriately evaluate the medical literature, guidelines, and other clinical information sources to identify relevant shifts in key shifts in medical practice and guidance that may drive shifts in RWD requirements.
  • Stay informed of shifts in technology (including use of AI technologies) to support clinical interpretation and how this is impacting data generation, clinical analyses and interpretation.

Clinical translation

  • Provide subject matter expertise in defining and translating clinical concepts/requirements into data definitions.
  • Collaborate with technical and business leaders in RWD to enhance and refine our solutions based on clinical experience and shifts in clinical practice.
  • Work with Technical teams to define key analyses to confirm scientific and clinical accuracy and appropriateness of Labcorp RWD Data and solutions, and consistency with existing scientific evidence base.
  • Work with Labcorp clinical and scientific experts, as needed, to refine data definitions, analyses and interpretation of findings from Labcorp RWD data and solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI solutions to enhance clinical translation.

Operational excellence

  • Serve as the primary resource for cohort and feature definition and clinical inquiries within the RWD team.
  • Identify and engage other clinical and scientific experts within Labcorp to provide timely input as needed.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance engagement, patient satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
  • Identify and lead efforts to implement AI solutions to support clinical aspect of data and product workflows, collaborating with other teams (including Technical, Compliance and data governance) to ensure consistency and compliance of implementation and development of KPIs and guardrails to track performance and impact.
  • Ensure timely input and resolution of clinical enquiries within data and product development and delivery.

Partner management

  • Work with Global Head RWD Data strategy and technical partnership to establish relationships with key opinion leaders, healthcare practitioners, academic institutions and industry personnel.
  • Build and develop relationships with clinical leaders within Labcorp to test and refine use cases & clinical definitions and test & validate emerging findings.
  • Confidently and credibly present use cases, definitions and RWD content / interpretations by leading presentations, and demonstrations to both internal and external stakeholders.

Scientific and clinical leadership

  • Work with BD and Marketing to identify clinical events / congresses where Labcorp/RWD could attend.
  • Contribute to congress and publication strategy to support elevation of Labcorp RWD scientific and clinical leadership.
  • Collaborate with RWD analytics teams to identify and develop insights for external communication in publications and at scientific congresses.
  • Attend key congresses, to present finding and support RWD colleagues in engaging clinical leaders.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Healthcare professional degree (e.g., MD, PharmD) with 3 or more years of clinical practice.
  • 2 or more years of experience in RWD/RWE and/or healthcare analytics.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Post graduate research experience in Life sciences (e.g. Masters, PhD)
  • Demonstrable experience in publication of scientific research and/or presentation at medical congresses on topics related to RWD/E

Additional Job Standards:

  • Knowledge and understanding about real world data and the life science/healthcare industry.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA and data privacy laws and best practices.
  • Deep understanding in key medical coding ontologies (e.g., ICD-10, NDC RxNorm
  • Knowledge and experience in leveraging AI tools to support data generation, interpretation and validation activities
  • Ability to work in a cross-functional environment including with clinical, business, and technical teams as well as external partners/collaborators.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong planning, multi-tasking, and prioritization skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Critical thinking and sound decision making.
  • High level of persistence, professionalism, and positive attitude.

Working conditions

Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible.

Limited (10-20%) travel may be required based on partner needs and business priorities.


About the role:

The Clinical translation and scientific engagement lead, Real-world data plays a vital role translating clinical concepts into technical definitions to enable data curation and analysis. This position will serve as the key point of clinical expertise within the RWD to support development of data products & solutions.

Internally, the position will directly support technical and business teams to develop and refine definitions, approaches and interpretation within RWD/E. The position is also responsible for engaging Labcorp SME’s on clinical topics relevant to RWD to further enhance the RWD teams operational work and strategic planning.

This role will also work with RWD leads in Labcorp to build relationships with external clinical experts as well as contributing to efforts to enhance Labcorp’s scientific leadership through supporting team in planning, writing, submission and presentation of abstracts and publications to congresses and conferences.

jobs.excerpt: Meet the Moment with AlteryxWe're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done.
jobs.description:
Meet the Moment with Alteryx

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

ALTERYX

Director of Product Management, AI

Location: West Coast, US (Seattle preferred)

Department: Product Management | Reports to: SVP of Product


The Opportunity

Alteryx is the agentic analytics and automation company that powers actionable insights for more than 8,000 customers worldwide — organizations that together run over 380 million automated workflows a year on the Alteryx platform. We're looking for a Director of Product Management, AI to own one of the most important stories in the company: proving, in hard numbers, why Alteryx plus large language models beats either one alone.

This isn't a research role for AI's own sake. It's a product leadership role focused on ROI — building and articulating the value proposition that governed Alteryx workflows make AI faster, better, and cheaper than raw LLM usage, and then shipping the product capabilities that make that promise true for every customer.

Every enterprise is asking the same question about generative AI: is it actually paying off? Alteryx has the receipts. When an LLM operates on raw, ungrounded data, it guesses at business rules and burns tokens doing it. When that same LLM is paired with a trusted, governed Alteryx workflow, the results change dramatically.

This is the Faster / Better / Cheaper equation you'll own: Faster, because governed workflows resolve in a fraction of the time raw LLM reasoning takes. Better, because every answer is Visible, Understandable, Repeatable, and Auditable (Alteryx calls this VURA) instead of a one-off, unverifiable guess. Cheaper, because customers stop paying the “re-work tax” of rebuilding business logic and re-burning tokens every time they plug in a new agent or model.

What You'll Do

Location

This role is remote based on the West Coast, with a strong preference for Seattle.


Senior Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst


Alteryx is searching for a Senior Security Operations Analyst in the United States. We’re looking for problem solvers, innovators, and dreamers who are searching for anything but business as usual. Like us, you’re a high performer who’s an expert at your craft, constantly challenging the status quo. You value inclusivity and want to join a culture that empowers you to show up as your authentic self. You know that success hinges on commitment, that our differences make us stronger, and that the finish line is always sweeter when the whole team crosses together.


Position Overview


As a member of the Security Operations team, you will be on the front line of protecting Alteryx products, infrastructure, and applications. You will triage and investigate alerts, lead incident response activities, and improve detection coverage and response outcomes across endpoint, identity, SaaS, and multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). This role is SOC-focused and is intended for a Senior level analyst with demonstrated depth in one or more of the following areas: Forensics, Cloud Security Investigations (AWS/Azure/GCP audit logs and cloud-native security signals), Threat Hunting, and Detection Engineering.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Triage and respond to security alerts and incidents across on-prem and multi-cloud enterprise and product environments, leading in-depth investigations using SIEM, EDR, cloud audit logs, identity telemetry, and network data to determine scope, root cause, attacker TTPs, and business impact.
  • Lead incident communications (severity updates, stakeholder coordination, executive-ready summaries as needed)
  • Execute incident response activities through containment and remediation coordination with partner teams (IT, Cloud/Platform, Engineering), including clear escalation when needed.
  • Produce high-quality incident documentation (timelines, evidence collected, hypotheses tested, IOCs, actions taken, lessons learned) and ensure follow-ups are tracked to completion.
  • Conduct hypothesis-driven threat hunts mapped to common adversary behaviors (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK).
  • Translate hunt findings into actionable improvements: new detections, tuning, playbooks, and telemetry/visibility recommendations.
  • Develop, tune, and maintain detection content (correlation rules, SIEM analytics, alert logic) to improve coverage and reduce false positives.
  • Validate detections with testing and retrospective analysis; continuously improve alert fidelity and response workflows.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define and maintain monitoring and detection use cases that drive risk reduction and operational effectiveness.
  • Perform basic endpoints and/or cloud forensics during escalated incidents and preserve evidence appropriately.
  • Support malware triage and artifact analysis as needed during investigations.
  • Investigate cloud-related threats and anomalies using cloud-native security signals and audit telemetry (AWS/Azure/GCP).
  • Partner with Cloud/Platform teams to close investigation gaps (logging, retention, telemetry coverage) and validate remediation actions.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to provide 24x7 incident response coverage and serve as an escalation point for high-severity events.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field (or equivalent experience/training). A master’s degree is a plus.
  • 4+ years of relevant security operations / incident response experience
  • Strong understanding of the security incident management lifecycle and operational response practices.
  • Strong experience with SIEM/log management platforms (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, ELK, Snowflake-based analytics, or similar) and demonstrated ability to query and analyze telemetry.
  • Ability to analyze and interpret security-relevant data including security event logs, system logs, application logs, cloud logs, and device logs.
  • Hands-on investigation experience using cloud-native security services (e.g., AWS Security Hub, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Google Security Command Center) and cloud logs.
  • Experience with one or more scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, shell) to support investigations, enrichment, and analysis.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including clear ticket documentation, incident reporting, and stakeholder updates.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a bias toward action and operational rigor.

Preferred Qualifications (One or More Areas of Depth)

  • Forensics: Endpoint or cloud forensics, evidence handling, artifact interpretation, malware triage.
  • Threat Hunting: Demonstrated experience leading hypothesis-driven hunts and operationalizing results into detections, playbooks, and response improvements (e.g., ATT&CK mapping and coverage tracking).
  • Detection Engineering: Detection lifecycle ownership (build/test/deploy/tune/retire), alert quality improvement, playbook development.

jobs.title: Instructional Designer (Contract)
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT THE WORKAlchemy designs and builds online courses for universities and workforce education providers.
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE WORK

Alchemy designs and builds online courses for universities and workforce education providers. You would work on a per-course basis alongside a faculty subject matter expert, taking a course from the first conversation through to a finished build the client signs off on.

Engagements are contracted per course, so you can take one course or several depending on your capacity. Most courses run eight to fourteen weeks of development.

This is a collaborative role. You will work directly with your SME on a regular cadence, and there are project and client calls from time to time. If you are looking for work that can be done entirely asynchronously with no contact with faculty or the client, this is not that role.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Design and development

Partner with a faculty subject matter expert to develop the course plan: learning outcomes, assessment map, and the overall shape of the course.

Write the course guide or blueprint, the document that contains everything that will be built in the LMS. This includes instructional narrative, activity and assessment design, rubrics where used, and links to resources.

Review and write learning outcomes using Bloom's Taxonomy and related frameworks, making sure they are stated in performance terms, pitched to the audience, and sequenced to match the course design.

Design formative and summative assessments, knowledge checks and learning activities that actually measure the outcomes.

Draft a media plan with the SME, specifying what each asset is for, which outcome it addresses and roughly how long it should be, then work with media producers and interactive developers to get it made.

Work to the client's templates, style guide, terminology and design standards, which differ by client and which we will give you at kickoff.

Hold the standards: accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), the client's style guide, and the design standards for the project. Remediating accessibility issues in your own deliverables is part of the work.

Meetings and collaboration

Hold regular working sessions with your subject matter expert through the design phase. Plan on a standing weekly meeting. The course gets designed in those conversations, and a designer who only emails the SME will not get what the course needs.

Attend additional project and client calls as necessary, or as your contract stipulates.

Project administration

Keep your own task status current in the client's project system (usually ClickUp). The project manager owns the schedule, but nobody can run a schedule off tasks that are not updated.

Run the review and approval process for your courses: submit on the dates in the plan, use the client's review request form, and route it to the named reviewers.

Review the built course in the LMS against your approved blueprint, log what needs fixing in one place, confirm the fixes landed, and sign off before it goes to the client.

Raise problems early. If a date is going to slip, an SME has gone quiet, or the scope has crept, say so while it can still be managed.

HOW THE ENGAGEMENT WORKS

Contracted per course under a work for hire agreement. Deliverables are owned by the client.

Paid a fixed fee per course at defined milestones, on acceptance of each deliverable. This is not hourly work and there is no timesheet.

A defined number of review cycles is included in the fee. The cycle count, the turnaround time we expect from you, and the revision window are stated in your contract.

Revisions requested inside that window are included. Work beyond it, or a change to the course scope after sign off, is handled as a contract amendment before it is started, not after.

Course assignments can change. Courses get added, removed, delayed or reassigned by the client. When that happens we amend the contract rather than absorbing it quietly.

You will work in our systems and the client's: Google Workspace, Slack, the project system, and the client's LMS. Some clients provide guest access with rules attached, and we will tell you what those are.

We use AI tooling in our process, including our own platform. You do not need to be an expert, but you do need to be comfortable working alongside it and following our rules about what client content can and cannot be put into external tools.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

Experience designing courses in higher education, K-12 or workforce learning and development, with at least one full course taken from outline to delivery.

Fluency with learning management systems, Canvas and Brightspace in particular.

The ability to work with a faculty subject matter expert who is an expert in their field but not in course design, and to lead that relationship without taking it over.

Comfort in client-facing conversations, including ones where you have to say no or explain why something will not work.

Clear, structured writing and the discipline to follow a style guide and a template rather than your own preferred format.

The self-management to hit dates in a distributed team without being chased.

A degree in education, instructional design, instructional technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Candor about what you have not done. We would much rather know at the application stage that you have never built an interactive or never worked in Brightspace than find out when it blocks a deliverable.

NICE TO HAVE

Experience with Articulate Storyline or Rise, H5P, or other interactive development tools.

Familiarity with Quality Matters or similar course design standards.

Experience picking up a partially built course from another designer and finishing it.

Experience using AI tools as part of a design workflow, with judgement about where they help and where they do not.

Experience in a specific discipline area: business, criminal justice, education, psychology, health sciences or data analytics.

Position Overview

The Senior Consultant, Compensation is a senior individual contributor who provides expert analysis, recommendations, and program leadership across broad-based and incentive compensation. The role independently evaluates complex pay matters, interprets market and internal data, and advises Human Resources and business leaders on decisions that materially affect compensation programs, employee outcomes, compliance, and business risk. Reporting to the Vice President of Total Rewards, the Senior Consultant exercises discretion and independent judgment in developing alternatives, assessing tradeoffs, and recommending solutions within established compensation philosophy, governance, and approval frameworks. Success in this role requires an obsessive attention to detail, proactive assertiveness, and a high level of curiosity to gather information and question everything.

Key Responsibilities

Pay Recommendations and Consultation

  • Independently evaluate and develop pay recommendations for merit increases, market adjustments, new hires, transfers, promotions, retention actions, and other compensation events.
  • Apply compensation philosophy, salary structures, market data, internal equity, performance, experience, geographic considerations, and business context to determine supportable recommendations and alternatives.
  • Identify exceptions and patterns that may create inequity, compression, compliance, employee-relations, or retention risk, and recommend appropriate action.
  • Advise Human Resources partners and business leaders on complex or sensitive pay decisions, clearly articulating rationale, tradeoffs, risks, and required approvals.
  • Participate in salary surveys; evaluate survey methodology, job matches, peer groups, and data quality; and recommend appropriate market references for jobs and employee populations.

Incentive, Retention, and Severance Programs

  • Design, evaluate, and support governance of incentive compensation plans in alignment with business objectives, compensation philosophy, financial parameters, and applicable requirements.
  • Assess incentive compensation plan efficacy, including eligibility, target opportunities, performance measures, payout relationships, affordability, competitiveness, and unintended outcomes.
  • Prepare incentive plan design alternatives, modeling, plan terms, eligibility provisions, performance measures, payout mechanics, etc.
  • Develop and administer retention and severance programs, including eligibility, award or benefit levels, business rationale, internal consistency, cost, and documentation requirements.
  • Monitor plan/program operations and outcomes, identify design or control issues, and recommend corrective or prospective changes.

Pay Communications, Training, and Transparency

  • Develop clear, accurate, and audience-appropriate communications for compensation programs, pay decisions, salary structures, incentive plans, and related processes.
  • Create and deliver training, tools, and guidance for Human Resources, managers, and other stakeholders to promote consistent, informed, and compliant compensation decisions.
  • Support pay transparency initiatives, including job-posting disclosures, employee and manager communications, pay-range practices, and readiness for changing requirements.

Regulatory Compliance and Governance

  • Interpret and apply applicable compensation-related laws, regulations, and company policies, including requirements involving wage and hour/FLSA classifications, minimum wage, pay equity, pay transparency, and incentive compensation.
  • Monitor legislative, regulatory, litigation, and market developments; evaluate potential impact; and recommend changes to programs, policies, processes, communications, or training.
  • Maintain decision documentation, program records, approval evidence, and other controls needed to support consistent administration and audit readiness.

Compensation Program Leadership

  • Continuously improve compensation processes, analytics, governance, and stakeholder experience while balancing employee, business, financial, and compliance considerations.
  • Develop and maintain analytical tools, models, controls, and documentation that improve the consistency, accuracy, and governance of compensation decisions.
  • Partner with Human Resources, Finance, Legal, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, HR technology teams, and business leaders to resolve complex compensation matters and implement approved solutions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 5-7 or more years of progressively responsible compensation experience, including complex analysis, program design, and consultation with senior stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated expertise in broad-based compensation, market pricing, pay equity and compression analysis, salary structures, incentive compensation, and compensation governance.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate incomplete or competing information, develop alternatives, and make well-supported recommendations on matters of significance.
  • Ability to exercise discretion and independent judgment while operating within company philosophy, policies, governance, and approval requirements.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex compensation concepts to varied audiences and influence decisions without direct authority.
  • Proficiency with spreadsheet modeling, compensation survey and market-pricing platforms, and human resources information systems; experience with data visualization or analytical tools is preferred.

  • Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) designation or comparable expertise is preferred.

    The salary range for this position is expected to be $85,000 – $105,000 per year, depending on geographic location, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate.
