jobs.excerpt: SWITCH BC is a collaborative organization that influences, invests in, and supports provincewide activities to improve occupational health and safety.
jobs.description:
SWITCH BC is a collaborative organization that influences, invests in, and supports provincewide activities to improve occupational health and safety. Our organizational model, unique in Canada, brings together health employers, unions, physicians, the Ministry of Health, and WorkSafeBC on SWITCH BC’s Board of Directors making consensus, strategic decisions.

Our purpose is to: 

  • Promote safe and healthy workplaces throughout British Columbia’s healthcare sector.
  • Collaborate with unions, employers, and Doctors of BC to develop and pursue a provincial framework, systems and programs aimed at improving the health, safety, and wellbeing of B.C.’s health care workers. 

SWITCH BC is an inclusive organization, focused on advancing Indigenous cultural safety, anti-racism, diversity, equity, and inclusion in our policies and practices. We are helping create an environment that addresses systemic barriers, biases and inequities that exist for First Nations, Inuit and Métis peoples, racialized individuals, individuals with disabilities and complex health conditions, immigrants, 2SLGBTQIA+, and other underrepresented groups. 

Job Summary

Reporting to the Manager, Psychological Health and Safety, the Psychological Health and Safety Lead serves as SWITCH BC's technical subject matter expert in psychological health and safety, psychosocial hazard prevention, and related occupational health and safety approaches. The Lead develops, implements, evaluates, and continually improves evidence-informed provincial resources, tools, frameworks, guides, learning supports, and implementation approaches that address shared psychological health and safety priorities across British Columbia's healthcare sector.

Working collaboratively with internal teams and external partners, the Lead applies subject matter expertise, partner feedback, system input, leading practices, and continual improvement approaches to develop practical, scalable resources and supports that strengthen psychological health and safety across diverse healthcare settings.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Provides subject matter expertise and technical guidance regarding psychological health and safety, psychosocial hazards, occupational health and safety principles, safety management systems, workplace wellbeing, prevention strategies, and the National Standard of Canada for Psychological Health and Safety in the Workplace.
  2. Translates complex concepts, evidence, and technical information into accessible, practical learning resources, tools, and supports that promote understanding and application across diverse healthcare settings.
  3. Develops and continually improves evidence-informed resources, frameworks, tools, guides, learning supports, and implementation materials that address identified needs and support psychological health and safety across diverse healthcare settings.
  4. Ensures resources and supports are practical, accurate, accessible, aligned with applicable standards and leading practices, and informed by partner feedback, evaluation findings, and lessons learned.
  5. Incorporates partner feedback, evaluation findings, lessons learned, and leading practices into the continual improvement of psychological health and safety resources, tools, frameworks, and implementation supports.
  6. Prepares materials and facilitates meetings, workshops, engagement activities, partner tables, or collaborative planning processes to gather input, support shared learning, and inform psychological health and safety program initiatives.
  7. Collaborates with healthcare partners, committees, working groups, and subject matter experts to identify needs, gather input, test approaches, and inform resource and program development.
  8. Develops high-quality reports, briefing materials, presentations, guidance documents, and knowledge products that communicate complex information clearly and are suitable for senior leaders, provincial partners, committees, and diverse audiences.
  9. Applies occupational health and safety, safety management system, change management, adult learning, and continuous improvement principles to support practical and sustainable psychological health and safety approaches.
  10. Collaborates with project, evaluation, implementation, and subject matter experts to ensure psychological health and safety resources, tools, and supports are practical, scalable, and responsive to partner needs across diverse healthcare settings.
  11. Develops and supports learning, engagement, and capacity-building activities that strengthen knowledge, awareness, and application of psychological health and safety practices across the healthcare sector in line with SWITCH BC’s mandate and approved initiatives.
  12. Applies research, evaluation findings, partner input, emerging practices, and subject matter expertise to develop practical solutions, resources, recommendations, and capacity-building supports.
  13. Monitors emerging research, legislation, standards, and leading practices to identify opportunities for innovation, continuous improvement, and future resource development.
  14. Fosters a safe, just work culture, encouraging and welcoming open identification of issues, non-violent dialogue, and practices for cultural safety and inclusion.
  15. Performs other related duties as assigned.

Education, Training, and Experience

A level of education, training, and experience equivalent to a master's degree in occupational health and safety, behavioural science, human factors, organizational psychology, public health, or a related discipline plus five (5) years of recent related experience. Experience working within British Columbia's healthcare sector and familiarity with collective bargaining associations is an asset.

Skills and Abilities

  • Demonstrated knowledge of psychological health and safety principles, psychosocial hazards, workplace wellbeing, psychological safety, occupational health and safety principles, safety management systems, hazard identification, risk management, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the National Standard of Canada for Psychological Health and Safety in the Workplace and its practical application within complex organizational environments.
  • Working knowledge of British Columbia occupational health and safety legislation, workplace standards, WorkSafeBC requirements, collective bargaining association environments, and the ability to incorporate these considerations into resource and tool development.
  • Ability to build productive relationships and work collaboratively with employers, unions, physicians, healthcare leaders, joint committees, and other partners.
  • Proficiency in full cycle product development including design, development, implementation, evaluation, and refinement of resource materials, pilot initiatives, learning supports, and capacity-building tools.
  • Highly skilled in translating findings, partner input, and leading practices into practical, evidence-informed resources, tools, frameworks, and implementation supports.
  • Ability to prepare high-quality reports, recommendations, presentations, briefing materials, and knowledge products suitable for leaders, provincial partners, committees, and diverse audiences.
  • Highly organized and able to gather, synthesize, and document partner feedback into resource development and continuous improvement activities.
  • Proficiency in change management frameworks, continuous improvement, facilitation, and/or adult learning methodologies.
  • Excellent systems and critical thinking, analytical, and problem solving skills.
  • Proven ability to facilitate discussions, engagement activities, and collaborative processes involving diverse perspectives, interests, and priorities.
  • Ability to taking complex concepts and turning them into accessible, usable learning products and supports and proven ability to communicate complex concepts into clear and practical language tailored to diverse audiences.
  • Able to navigate ambiguity and support solution-focused approaches in evolving environments.
  • Able to work independently, exercise sound judgment, prioritize workload, and manage multiple competing priorities.
  • Commitment to equity, diversity, inclusion, cultural safety, anti-racism, and humility.
  • Advanced proficiency using Microsoft Office Suite, collaboration platforms, virtual engagement technologies, and project management tools.

Compensation and Benefits

In joining SWITCH BC, we are pleased to offer you a rewarding career. In recognition of your skills and experiences, and in alignment with our core values of building safe and healthy work environments, we are pleased to offer comprehensive benefits which includes, but is not limited to:

  • Competitive salary
  • Generous extended health benefits with no waiting period, long-term disability benefits, and Municipal Pension Plan
  • Paid vacation (20 days per year - prorated in first year) and sick leave allowances
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Professional development and membership opportunities

As a key organization within the BC healthcare sector, we also encourage current health sector employees to ask about pension and benefits portability options, which may also be available. SWITCH BC is committed to be an equitable, diverse, and inclusive workforce.

We recognize that there are a variety of experiences that contribute to the overall qualifications for each role. If you feel that you could excel in this position, but do not necessarily meet the formal requirements, we still encourage you to apply.  We wish to thank all applications for their interest and effort in applying; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

  • Oversees team responsible for translating business needs into IT work product and project requests; assimilates and documents business needs, project requests and benefit value documentation including high level IT requirements, compliance implications and cost/benefit analysis.

    • Analyzes, reviews and measures information technology (IT)-related service level performance against agreed upon service level agreements (SLAs) and operating level agreements (OLAs) with service providers (internal and external).

    • Organizes complex IT project requests into manageable approaches, and advises on project setup/structure based on proposed scope.
    • Collaborates with corporate IT leadership on key business initiative delivery; facilitates process improvements, manages SLAs, and deploys business communications.
    • Leverages knowledge of business processes, IT technologies and processes to inform appropriate project triage; consults with the business/IT on project scope, assumptions, development progress and estimation.
    • Strategically informs standard business case development method outlined by IT project team to support evaluation and prioritization.
    • Drives down the cost of development and support while improving quality by implementing standard processes (systems development lifecycle (SDLC), architecture, project management, etc.).
    • Recognizes, identifies and documents changes to IT services and supporting processes and or opportunities for service delivery improvement; facilitates groups for problem-solving and service improvement including definition/documentation, and business workflow analysis.
    • Develops effective processes, forums and tracking mechanisms to continuously improve process through business feedback, proactive handling of business complaints and facilitation of resolution.
    • Develops and maintains a service delivery plan (SDP) for corporate functions to include business strategies/needs with corresponding IT strategies/plans, IT projects, IT performance measurements, customer satisfaction improvement plans and other items as determined by IT senior leadership.

    • Collaborates closely with business partners and service providers to negotiate and define service‑level requirements for new IT services and changes to existing services.
    • Collaborates with business and service providers to define proper metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs) in evaluating service delivery quality and performance levels.
    • Generates and distributes regular reports on service performance, trends and achievement to applicable stakeholders.
    • Organizes and maintains the service level review process with the business and service providers; initiates actions required to maintain or improve service levels.
    • Represents as a change agent to implement and manage quality improvement processes in service delivery management.
    • Monitors budgets and expenses within department and demonstrates accountability for meeting financial goals.
    • Provides recommendations and input into IT-related policies, procedures and governance standards.
    • Provides IT support and coordination to functions/departments to facilitate timely issue resolution and service restoration
    • Effectively manages business escalations within the IT organization by ensuring appropriate accountability, sense of urgency, communication and follow-through to closure.
    • Develops and implements reports using repeatable processes to satisfy key business stakeholders; supports continuous improvements of established reports in production to ensure optimal performance.
    • Maintains technical skills that can be utilized to solve complex IT problems.
    • Hires, trains, mentors, and develops a high-performing team, and demonstrates accountability for team performance and achievement of department-specific goals.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 8 years of information technology (IT) and systems experience, including advanced experience with IT service level performance, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

    • Advanced understanding of IT operations and major health care technology applications that support business functions.
    • Experience providing IT support in alignment with state Medicaid contract service level agreement (SLA) requirements.
    • Knowledge of emerging technologies required to support business needs and project execution.
    • Subject matter expertise/knowledge of managed care organization (MCO) contract compliance requirements that impact IT services or processes.

    • Understanding of business management, operations, and strategy.
    • Understanding of key functions, application accountabilities and services performed by each area including knowledge of PMO, architecture and service methodologies (current or developing), and ability to train the business on applicable services, processes and technologies.
    • Experience in strategic planning, project scoping and planning and background/experience in project management and use of project management tools.
    • Strong data-analysis and critical-thinking skills.
    • Experience summarizing data and creation and delivery of leadership presentations.
    • Analytical ability to identify issues, solve problems and develop/facilitate solutions; includes alternative analysis and cost/benefit analysis/project value realization.
    • Experience facilitating change management and process improvement initiatives.
    • Strong organizational and time-management skills, and excellent follow-through.
    • Ability to collaborate cross-functionally in a highly matrixed organization, and influence stakeholders on scalable solutions.
    • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
    • Proficiency with the Microsoft technology stack (including advanced Excel) and working knowledge of SQL.

Preferred Qualifications

• Six Sigma black belt.

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

CircusTrix is the leading indoor active entertainment company in the U.S., operating and franchising over 270 parks with more than 500,000 members and 60+ attractions. We create fun, high-energy experiences for all ages while hosting thousands of memorable birthdays, team events, and school parties each year. Recognized by Franchise Times and Entrepreneur, our success is driven by a culture of curiosity, creativity, and growth. At Sky Zone, we empower builders, problem-solvers, and lifelong learners to explore bold ideas, challenge assumptions, and make a meaningful impact—creating a place where imagination thrives and people are inspired to grow.


JOB SUMMARY:

The Sr.Social Media & Community Manager will serve as the day-to-day owner of Sky Zone's social presence, bringing our brand to life through engaging content, authentic community interaction, and seamless execution across our owned social channels.


Working closely with the Vice President of Brand & Demand Marketing and Sky Zone's social agency, this role will help execute the social strategy by managing publishing, fostering community engagement, coordinating creator and influencer activations, and ensuring content is delivered consistently across channels. As the internal champion for social, this individual will play a critical role in connecting marketing campaigns, park experiences, and customer conversations to build brand affinity and support demand generation.


The ideal candidate is passionate about social media, understands platform culture, enjoys engaging with online communities, and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.


RESPONSIBILITIES:


Social Media Strategy & Planning

  • Partner with Brand & Demand leadership and agency partners to develop and evolve Sky Zone’s social strategy in alignment with broader brand, marketing, and business objectives
  • Help shape annual and seasonal social plans, including channel roles, audience priorities, content strategy, and key opportunities for the brand
  • Translate brand strategy, campaign priorities, and business objectives into clear social priorities and strategic direction
  • Bring forward proactive recommendations on emerging platforms, evolving consumer behaviors, and opportunities to strengthen Sky Zone’s social presence and relevance

Content Publishing & Channel Management

  • Manage the day-to-day publishing across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging social platforms
  • Execute the social content calendar in partnership with Sky Zone's social agency and internal marketing team
  • Coordinate publishing schedules, approvals, and asset management
  • Ensure content is accurate, on-brand, and optimized for each platform
  • Support the execution of seasonal campaigns, promotions, partnerships, and brand initiatives across social channels

Community Management

  • Serve as the voice of Sky Zone across owned social channels by monitoring and engaging with comments, direct messages, tags, and brand mentions
  • Foster authentic conversations and build meaningful relationships with our online community
  • Identify opportunities to encourage user-generated content and guest participation
  • Escalate customer service, operational, or reputational issues to the appropriate internal teams
  • Help cultivate an engaging, positive brand experience across all social touchpoints

Content Creation

  • Capture engaging photo and video content that brings the Sky Zone experience to life across social platforms
  • Create and edit social-first content, including Reels, TikToks, Stories, and short-form videos using mobile-first editing tools
  • Produce timely, platform-native content that supports campaigns, seasonal promotions, partnerships, and cultural moments
  • Partner with the social agency to supplement produced content with authentic, in-the-moment storytelling
  • Assist with on-site content capture during events, park visits, creator activations, and brand experiences

Agency & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day partner to Sky Zone's social agency
  • Collaborate on content planning, campaign execution, creator activations, and reporting
  • Coordinate with Brand, Digital, PR, Operations, Partnerships, and Creative teams to ensure integrated execution
  • Partner with company-owned parks to support local content opportunities and community engagement

Content Production & Coordination

  • Coordinate content requests, approvals, and production timelines
  • Work with creators, photographers, videographers, agency partners, and internal teams to facilitate content creation
  • Identify opportunities to capture authentic in-park moments that showcase the Sky Zone experience
  • Maintain and organize the social content library to support ongoing publishing needs

Creator & Influencer Support

  • Coordinate creator visits, influencer activations, and content capture
  • Support creator communications, scheduling, logistics, approvals, and deliverables
  • Partner with the social agency on creator identification, campaign execution, and content usage
  • Help identify opportunities for user-generated content and creator storytelling

Social Listening & Consumer Insights

  • Monitor social conversations, audience sentiment, and emerging cultural trends
  • Surface actionable consumer insights, recurring questions, and content opportunities to the marketing team
  • Identify opportunities for Sky Zone to authentically participate in relevant social conversations
  • Share ongoing recommendations to improve engagement, content performance, and community growth

Performance & Reporting

  • Monitor channel performance and key social metrics
  • Own preparing recurring reports on audience growth, engagement, and content performance
  • Provide insights and recommendations based on platform trends and audience behavior
  • Support the development of reporting frameworks that measure social's contribution to brand awareness, community engagement, and demand generation

QUALIFICATIONS:


  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • 6-8 years of experience managing social media for a consumer, retail, entertainment, hospitality, lifestyle, or franchise brand
  • Deep understanding of Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging social platforms
  • Experience with community management and social publishing tools such as Social, Sprout Social, etc.

  • Comfortable shooting and editing content using an iPhone or similar mobile device
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • Experience working collaboratively with agencies and cross-functional teams
  • Experience supporting influencer or creator marketing programs·
  • Experience with Soci, Sprout Social, Sprinklr, Later, Hootsuite, or similar social management platforms
  • Experience working in entertainment, hospitality, retail, franchise, or consumer brands·
  • Passion for creating engaging content and building online communities

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • This position requires the ability to remain stationery, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Position Title: FP&A Analyst (Healthcare)

Location: Remote

Travel Required: Less than 5%

Who we are:

US Health Partners (“USHP”) seeks to redefine high-quality specialty care in the United States and establish a high-performing, technology-enabled care delivery platform. USHP is partnering with the country's leading physicians to build a comprehensive, out-patient focused specialty care network targeting the nation's cardiovascular concerns. Our physician-led organization is passionate about supporting exceptional care and enriching the lives of patients across the United States. We envision the opportunity to create a scaled, cutting-edge, technology-enabled healthcare services platform that leverages a value-based delivery model.

Position Summary:

The FP&A Analyst is an experienced contributor to the finance team, playing a key role in the company's budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting processes. This role independently builds and maintains financial models, monitors performance against budget, and delivers polished reporting and analysis that inform leadership decision-making. This is a strong opportunity for an experienced finance professional to deepen their FP&A expertise and take on greater ownership within a growing, physician-led healthcare organization.

Responsibilities may include:

Budgeting and Forecasting:

  • Lead the preparation of components of the annual budget and periodic financial forecasts, working directly with department and business unit leaders.
  • Consolidate and validate inputs from cross-functional departments, ensuring accuracy and alignment with corporate goals.
  • Track actual performance against budget and forecast, identify variances, and develop clear explanations and recommendations for leadership.

Financial Reporting and Analysis:

  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.
  • Independently conduct financial analysis to identify trends, variances, and opportunities for improvement, and translate findings into actionable insights.
  • Build and maintain supporting schedules, dashboards, and executive-ready summaries for leadership review.
  • Prepare revenue recognition reports as part of the close process, ensuring accurate accruals, cutoffs, and reconciliations across all practices.

Business Partnering:

  • Serve as a day-to-day finance partner to assigned business units, providing financial insights and guidance to support decision-making.
  • Proactively respond to data requests from business units and anticipate follow-on questions from leadership.
  • Lead scenario analysis and ad hoc financial calculations to support business decisions and investment discussions.

Process Improvement:

  • Identify and lead opportunities to streamline financial models, reports, and recurring processes.
  • Maintain data integrity and consistency across financial systems and reporting tools, and recommend improvements where gaps are identified.
  • Document and continuously improve FP&A processes and procedures, and help train junior team members on best practices.

Ad-hoc Analysis:

  • Lead ad-hoc financial analysis and reporting as requested by the FP&A team or senior management.
  • Provide analytical support for special projects, business initiatives, and cross-functional strategic efforts as needed.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

Experience:

  • 3–5 years of experience in FP&A, financial analysis, accounting, or a related role; healthcare or multi-site company experience is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of financial modeling, forecasting, and budgeting techniques, with demonstrated ability to work independently.
  • Strong proficiency with Excel; experience with financial planning tools or ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) is a plus.

Competencies:

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize large, complex data sets into clear, actionable insights.
  • Confident written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present financial information to non-financial stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy and the ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to build effective working relationships across cross-functional teams.
  • Experience with business intelligence (BI) tools and data visualization software (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) is a plus.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, use hands and fingers to handle or feel, as well as talk and hear. Co budujemy i z kim chcemy współpracować:

WinStreamly/New Game +tworzymy rozwiązania marketingowe, które pomagają markom docierać do graczy. Łączymytechnologię, gaming i AI, a nasze produkty wykorzystujemy w kampaniach prowadzonych na wielu rynkach.

Regularnie realizujemy kampanie dla największych globalnych marek, takich jak Netflix, Adidas, PlayStationczySamsung. Budujemy ekosystem mar-tech, który pomaga markom skutecznie komunikować się z graczami. To oznacza szybkie tempo, częste zmiany priorytetów i dużo procesów, które nadal trzeba zaprojektować lub uporządkować.

Równolegle rozwijamy własny system pracy, w którym zaufanie zastępuje kontrolę czasu i sposobu działania. Dajemy ludziom dużą autonomię, ale oczekujemy w zamian odpowiedzialności za wynik.Tutajmożesz dowiedzieć się więcej.

Co charakteryzuje nasz system pracy?

  • Myślimy o organizacji jak o drużynie: system działania oparty jest o wysokie wymagania i dążenie do mistrzostwa na każdej pozycji. Kładziemy jednocześnie bardzo duży nacisk na zespołowość i partnerskie podejście.

  • Ufamy i oczekujemy wyników:nie kontrolujemy procesu ani czasu pracy, ale bezkompromisowo rozliczamy rezultat – co jest trudne, bo wymaga samodzielności i brania odpowiedzialności.

  • Nie boimy się konfrontacji:publicznie oceniamy pomysły i wyniki. Analiza błędów to dla nas jedyna droga do progresu. Jeśli potrzebujesz miękkiego feedbacku lub boisz się bezpośredniej oceny efektów swojej pracy – może być Ci ciężko się tutaj odnaleźć.

  • Mamy wysokie tempo i zmienność: szybko reagujemy na rynek, co oznacza, że w ciągu roku zmieniają się priorytety strategiczne oraz projektowe. Potrzebujemy ludzi, którzy potrafią błyskawicznie dostosować swoją grę do nowych celów. W tym tempie kluczowa jest dla nas innowacyjność - aktywnie wykorzystujemy AI i automatyzację, by eliminować powtarzalne procesy i skupiać się wyłącznie na tym, co skaluje nasz biznes.

Więcej o sposobie naszej pracy możesz posłuchać w naszympodcaście.

Kontekst roli i wyzwania:
Jako GamingClient Growth Manager będziesz odpowiadać za identyfikacjęi rozwój szans biznesowych poprzez aktywną współpracę z działem Business Development, budowanie iskalowanie relacji z klientamiorazinicjowanie działań upsellowychicross-sellowych. To rola na styku sprzedaży, strategii i relacji - kluczowa dla skalowania współpracy z markami działającymi w świecie gamingu i livestreamingu.

Twój docelowy zespół:
Twoim bezpośrednim managerem będzie Jan Czerniecki, Head of Gaming Solutions. Na co dzień będziesz współpracować z całym zespołem Sales & Account Management:
z osobami odpowiedzialnymi za pozyskiwanie klientów (Business Development) i prowadzenie kampanii (Account Management) oraz z Project Managerami z zespołu New Game +, którzy prowadzą projekty naszych klientów.

Jak będzie wyglądał dzień w Twojej roli:

  • Współpraca z zespołem Business Development w celu skutecznego pozyskania nowych klientów.

  • Prowadzenie strategicznych działań mających na celu rozwój istniejących relacji klienckich (farmowanie + cross-sell/upsell).

  • Proaktywne identyfikowanie i rozwijanie nowych możliwości biznesowych w oparciu o dane rynkowe, potrzeby klientów i insighty konsumenckie.

  • Projektowanie i prezentacja propozycji współpracy odpowiadających na cele marketingowe klientów.

  • Stała współpraca z działem campaign delivery oraz produkcją w celu dostarczania wartościowych doświadczeń dla klientów i ich marek.

  • Udział w warsztatach strategicznych z klientami oraz partnerami (np. agencjami, domami mediowymi).

  • Wsparcie w tworzeniu i egzekucji strategii klienta w ramach produktów New Game+ (produkty specjalne, długoterminowe współprace, integracje).

  • Monitoring efektywności kampanii i aktywne rekomendowanie kolejnych kroków (koncepcyjnych lub sprzedażowych).

Szukamy osoby, która posiada:

  • Min. 3 lata doświadczenia w sprzedaży B2B lub obsłudze klienta w agencji reklamowej, firmie technologicznej lub marce z sektora digital/gaming.

  • Doświadczenie w pracy z markami FMCG, telco, tech lub gaming będzie dodatkowym atutem.

  • Umiejętność prowadzenia rozmów z klientami na poziomie strategicznym (działy marketingu, brand managerowie, media managerowie).

  • Wysoko rozwinięte umiejętności interpersonalne i prezentacyjne.

  • Zorientowanie na cel i umiejętność priorytetyzacji działań.

  • Proaktywne podejście do rozwijania klientów i projektów – mentalność „hunter/farmer hybrid”.

Najlepsi gracze to tacy, którzy potrafią szybko adaptować się do gry. Jeśli czujesz, że nasz system idzie w parze z Twoim i chcesz w nim dowozić wartość, zachęcamy Cię do aplikowania - nawet jeśli nie spełniasz teraz wszystkich oczekiwań z listy.

Co oferujemy?

  • Pracę na stykutechnologii, AIi gamingu, z realnym wpływem na strategię komercyjną oraz kierunek rozwoju produktów inStreamly.

  • Projekty o dużej skali:Możliwość współpracy z topowymi markami w Polsce i na świecie

  • Kulturę zaufania i autonomii:działamy w poczuciu extreme ownership, opartym na partnerstwie, szczerości i dużej decyzyjności.

  • Udziały w firmie (ESOP):Wierzymy w budowanie wspólnej wartości, dlatego oferujemy program akcji pracowniczych - stajesz się współwłaścicielem biznesu, który rozwijasz.

  • Model remote-first: Pracujemy w 100% zdalnie i asynchronicznie, stawiając na efekty, a nie godziny spędzone przed monitorem.

  • Nielimitowany płatny urlop:Ufamy naszemu zespołowi i stawiamy na work-life balance bez sztywnych limitów dni wolnych.

  • Kompleksowe wsparcie zdrowotne:Prywatna opieka medyczna oraz dedykowane wsparcie psychologiczne.

  • Elastyczność zatrudnienia:Jesteśmy otwarci na każdą formę współpracy (B2B, UZ, UoP) - wspólnie wybierzemy model najlepiej dopasowany do Twoich potrzeb.

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

We’re looking for a VP-level AI Architect to define and drive a consistent, modern AI- and agentic-first architecture across CrowdStrike. This company-wide role spans business units, customer-facing products, shared platforms, and internal AI capabilities.


You’ll connect AI applications with the software and infrastructure that make them work at scale. Working with business unit and engineering leaders, you’ll translate business priorities into practical designs, establish common technical foundations, and guide implementation across teams. The architecture must support distinct product needs while making shared capabilities easier to build, integrate, and operate.


Your work will range from company-wide architectural decisions to building reference implementations and resolving difficult engineering problems. You’ll bring deep systems expertise, sound judgment about emerging AI technologies, and a record of turning architectural direction into working products.


What You’ll Do:

  • Define and drive the company-wide AI architecture and roadmap. Establish shared interfaces and design patterns, resolve cross-business-unit tradeoffs, and work with product and engineering leaders to put architectural decisions into practice. Determine which capabilities should be common and where teams need flexibility.
  • Design and build full-stack AI and agentic systems. Connect models and retrieval to agent runtimes, memory, tools, and execution environments. Develop prototypes and production reference implementations that give teams a tested foundation for new capabilities.
  • Architect production AI systems for performance, resilience, and scale. Benchmark model and serving options, investigate bottlenecks across software and infrastructure, and improve latency, throughput, and compute efficiency. Guide deployment choices across cloud and edge environments.
  • Create a consistent developer experience across products through reusable components, common APIs, and shared tooling. Simplify integration and establish engineering practices that teams adopt. Contribute to critical implementations, review designs and code, and mentor engineers and technical leaders.
  • Design the AI lifecycle architecture, from data ingestion and model adaptation through evaluation, deployment, and operational feedback. Establish reproducible workflows, automated quality gates, and observability for model quality, agent task success, reliability, and cost. Build safe rollout, rollback, and recovery into production systems.
  • Embed security, governance, and auditability into AI architectures. Define permissions and execution boundaries for agents, address prompt injection and data exposure, and make system actions traceable. Partner with Security and Legal to translate requirements into practical engineering controls.

What You’ll Need:

  • BS, MS, or PhD in computer science, computer engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years of experience in software architecture, systems engineering, or AI engineering, including senior technical leadership across multiple products or business units.
  • A record of personally designing and delivering production AI systems, including generative or agentic applications and the infrastructure that supports them.
  • Strong foundations in distributed systems, software design, APIs, and performance engineering, with the ability to work across application and infrastructure layers.
  • Practical experience with model integration, inference serving, retrieval, and evaluation, including the tradeoffs involved in deploying and operating AI systems at scale.
  • Experience establishing shared platforms and engineering standards across independent teams. Ability to align senior stakeholders, explain architectural tradeoffs, and mentor engineers through implementation.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

jobs.title: Junior Gebietsverantwortlicher - Großraum Ingolstadt (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: hier ist dein traumjob Gesucht: Netzwerker mit NRW-Revierinstinkt und Vertriebs-DNA (m/w/d) Du kennst Nordrhein-Westfalen nicht nur von der Landkarte, sondern weißt, wie man zwischen Rheinland, Ruhrgebiet und Co.
jobs.description:
hier ist dein traumjob



Gesucht: Netzwerker mit NRW-Revierinstinkt und Vertriebs-DNA (m/w/d)

Du kennst Nordrhein-Westfalen nicht nur von der Landkarte, sondern weißt, wie man zwischen Rheinland, Ruhrgebiet und Co. Kontakte knüpft, Beziehungen pflegt und aus guten Gesprächen erfolgreiche Partnerschaften macht? Du erkennst Potenziale, bevor andere überhaupt wissen, dass da welche sind? Und für dich bedeutet Vertrieb nicht Klinkenputzen, sondern Menschen zusammenzubringen und gemeinsam etwas aufzubauen? Dann könnte Nordrhein-Westfalen schon bald dein Revier sein.

Als Gebietsverantwortlicher für den Großraum Nordrhein-Westfalen (m/w/d) bist du Netzwerker, Sparringspartner und Vertriebsstratege in einem. Du unterstützt dabei, unser regionales Vertriebsnetzwerk weiter auszubauen, entwickelst bestehende Partnerschaften weiter und sorgst dafür, dass aus Vertriebspartnern echte Erfolgspartner werden.

Dabei bist du nicht nur unterwegs, wenn alles läuft. Gerade wenn es irgendwo hakt, bist du gefragt: Du hörst zu, erkennst Herausforderungen frühzeitig und findest gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern und internen Teams Lösungen, die die Zusammenarbeit wieder auf Kurs bringen.

Kurz gesagt: Du verbindest Menschen, entwickelst Potenziale und machst unser Netzwerk in Nordrhein-Westfalen jeden Tag ein Stück stärker.

dein wirkungsbereich

  • Du unterstützt beim Auf- und Ausbau unserer regionalen Vertriebspartnerstruktur im Großraum Nordrhein-Westfalen und entwickelst unser Netzwerk mit Gespür für die richtigen Partner kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Du betreust und entwickelst bestehende Vertriebspartnerschaften und sorgst dafür, dass aus einer guten Zusammenarbeit eine langfristige Erfolgsgeschichte wird. Dabei behältst du auch bei einer großen Anzahl an Partnern den Überblick und schaffst es, unterschiedliche Persönlichkeiten fachlich zu führen, zu motivieren und auf gemeinsame Vertriebsziele auszurichten.
  • Du hältst Augen und Ohren nach neuen Kooperationsmöglichkeiten und Vertriebspartnern in Nordrhein-Westfalen offen und unterstützt bei der Anbahnung neuer Partnerschaften.
  • Du bist Sparringspartner für unsere Vertriebspartner und begleitest sie bei Vertriebsgesprächen, Kundenterminen und vertrieblichen Fragestellungen.
  • Du unterstützt bei Schulungen und der Weiterentwicklung unserer Partner, damit diese fachlich und vertrieblich bestens aufgestellt sind.
  • Du hast ein feines Gespür dafür, wenn es in einer Partnerschaft irgendwo knirscht: Du identifizierst Herausforderungen frühzeitig, entwickelst passende Maßnahmen und bringst die Zusammenarbeit wieder auf Erfolgskurs.
  • Du analysierst die Performance unserer Vertriebspartner, behältst relevante Kennzahlen und Abschlussquoten im Blick und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen zur Weiterentwicklung ab.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Vertriebsverantwortlichen, internen Fachbereichen und externen Kooperationspartnern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Strategie auch tatsächlich Umsetzung wird.
  • Du bringst deine Ideen, Marktbeobachtungen und Erfahrungen aus Nordrhein-Westfalen aktiv ein und hilfst uns damit, unseren Partnervertrieb kontinuierlich besser zu machen.

deine persönlichkeit

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, Partnervertrieb, Partnermanagement, Außendienst oder in einer vergleichbaren vertriebsnahen Position gesammelt. Dafür bringst du bereits Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung und Steuerung von Menschen bzw. Partnernetzwerken mit.
  • Du bist ein echter Beziehungsmensch: offen, verbindlich, kommunikativ und mit dem richtigen Gespür für unterschiedliche Charaktere und Situationen.
  • Du kannst Menschen für eine Idee begeistern und trittst auch gegenüber Entscheidern souverän und überzeugend auf.
  • Du denkst vertrieblich, erkennst Potenziale und Chancen und hast Spaß daran, daraus gemeinsam mit deinen Partnern konkrete Erfolge zu machen.
  • Du bist nicht nur Schönwetter-Netzwerker. Wenn es Herausforderungen gibt, gehst du sie lösungsorientiert,verbindlich und mit Fingerspitzengefühl an.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und strukturiert, kannst deine Region eigenverantwortlich organisieren und weißt trotzdem, wann Teamwork gefragt ist.
  • Zahlen schrecken dich nicht ab: Du kannst Kennzahlen und Vertriebsperformance analysieren und daraus die richtigen nächsten Schritte ableiten.
  • Du hast Lust darauf, Partner nicht nur zu betreuen, sondern sie durch Begleitung, Coaching und Schulungen aktiv weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Dein Arbeitsplatz ist nicht nur dein Schreibtisch: Du bist gerne in Nordrhein-Westfalen unterwegs, suchst den persönlichen Austausch und bringst die entsprechende Reisebereitschaft mit.

dein leben bei uns

  • Du erhältst ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis in einem zukunftsorientierten, leistungsstarken Unternehmen
  • Du bekommst ein Vertriebsgebiet, in dem du eigenverantwortlich arbeiten und wirklich etwas bewegen kannst
  • Du bekommst eine leistungsorientierte Vergütung und einen Dienstwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung
  • Du bist ein wichtiger Teil unseres bunten Haufens mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen
  • Du bekommst eine strukturierte Einarbeitung und wirst schnell integriert – inklusive Einblicken in unsere Fachabteilungen und persönlicher Begleitung während deiner Einarbeitung.
  • Du kannst deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten (Grundlage ist eine 38-Stunden-Woche)
  • Du machst am Freitag planmäßig um Punkt 12 Uhr Feierabend – mehr Wochenende für dich!
  • Du hast die Möglichkeit europaweit mobil zu arbeiten, das entsprechende professionelle IT-Equipment erhältst du von uns
  • Du erhältst individuelle Personalentwicklungsmaßnahmen – wir fördern, was dich weiterbringt
  • Schreibtisch- und Vertriebs-Auszeit gefällig? Dir stehen bis zu 4 Wochen Sabbatical zur Verfügung – denn auch Netzwerker müssen irgendwann mal abschalten
  • Du feierst mit uns gemeinsame Teamevents (Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier etc.)

About Hammer Creative

Hammer Creative is a global game marketing agency that seamlessly collaborates with developers, publishers and brands of all sizes to craft world-class campaigns. From trailers to key art to social, we combine elevated storytelling and innovative techniques with precise strategy. We move fast, sweat every detail, and already love your game.

Job Description:

Our Social Creative Producers do more than most! You'll own every facet of project management from first outreach to final delivery, and you'll also serve in an account capacity as the client's primary point of contact. This is not a job for someone who wants to make social content that follows the status quo or is focused simply on putting out a high volume of content. If you want to be the person who holds it all together and leads the team to constantly innovate the way in which social is produced, then this role is for you!

As a Social Creative Producer, you'll lead social content production across platforms like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, X, and emerging channels. You'll keep quality, budgets, and processes on track while making sure both clients and our team are set up for success. The role is a balance of speed and craft: you'll stay on top of platform trends and audience behavior while upholding the creative and brand standards that make our work stand out.

We're looking for someone who enjoys shaping how the work gets done. Social programs vary widely in volume, pace, and complexity, so you'll need to tailor workflows and processes to each project. That could mean building a lean, rapid-turnaround system for always-on content or a more structured approach for a larger campaign, then refining it as the work evolves.

You'll also take on account responsibilities. Along with leading production, you'll serve as the main point of contact for clients, owning the day-to-day relationship and finding opportunities to grow the partnership. You'll be someone clients can count on for clear, quick, and proactive communication, which is essential in a space that moves as fast as social.

As the primary lead of projects, you are expected to initiate and guide the process with a steady hand and motivational demeanor, ensuring all team members are well-informed and set up to do the best work possible. Likewise, as the main point of contact for clients, it’s essential for the Producer to communicate clearly and effectively and in a time-sensitive manner at all stages of production.

Qualifications:

  • 1-2+ years of professional producing experience in marketing and short-form social content.
  • Prior creative agency experience is highly preferred.
  • Prior game marketing experience is a plus, but not required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams and with clients.

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager
jobs.excerpt: About AI AcquisitionAI Acquisition is a bootstrapped, founder-led business helping founders and operators scale with AI, combining a sales and delivery engine, one-to-one consultation, and our own SaaS platforms.
jobs.description:
About AI Acquisition

AI Acquisition is a bootstrapped, founder-led business helping founders and operators scale with AI, combining a sales and delivery engine, one-to-one consultation, and our own SaaS platforms. We move fast, we build constantly, and we hold a high bar for the people who work directly with our clients.

We currently manage thousands of active clients across multiple products, with 250+ new clients onboarding every month. The Account Management function is the front line of that relationship.

The Role

You are the person between the client and the outcome. Not a relationship manager. Not a check-in scheduler. Not someone who forwards tickets and hopes for the best.

You own a portfolio of clients who are building real businesses with our support. Some are launching for the first time. Some are scaling. Some are stuck and frustrated. Your job is to diagnose where they actually are, figure out what's blocking their progress, manage their expectations when needed, and drive them toward commercial results, not just activity.

This means you need to understand marketing, sales, offer development, and fulfillment well enough to have real conversations about all of them. If a client's campaign is generating calls but nobody's closing, you need to be able to tell them why and what to do about it, not pass it to someone else.

Our clients purchase a fully built AI lead-generation business: brand, website, funnel, lead engine, and the systems that help turn leads into customers. You own the relationship around that delivery. You need to know what they bought, what was promised, where they are in the journey, and what needs to happen next, with specifics, not generalities.

You'll work directly with clients on Zoom, Slack, and through our internal systems. You'll run growth workshops, intro calls, and quick syncs. You'll manage escalations without panicking and celebrate wins without coasting. And when a client is about to walk, you'll be the person who finds the path to keep them or makes the honest call that they should go.

What You'll Own:

  • A portfolio of active clients across different stages: onboarding, growth, scale, and at-risk
  • Growth workshops, intro calls, and regular check-ins; you set the rhythm, not the client
  • Client expectation management, framing what's realistic, resetting when needed, never overpromising
  • Diagnosing why a client isn't getting results: is it the offer, the funnel, the sales process, the client's own execution, or something upstream?
  • Funnel and campaign literacy and understanding the client's lead engine (Meta ads, cold email, B2B book-a-call, DFY website), confirming it matches their contract and guarantee, and flagging mismatches before they become problems
  • Reading the client's specific contract, understanding the distinct payment flows (client pays AIA, client's customers pay client, ad spend reimbursement), and giving accurate answers under pressure rather than quoting generic numbers
  • Spotting the signals before a client escalates (sudden silence, short replies, frustration, refund language, contract/funnel mismatches) and acting on them with a structured escalation, not a panicked message
  • De-escalating frustrated clients without throwing the company under the bus, without panicking, and without making promises you can't keep
  • When you inherit accounts, you verify every client's status, contract, delivery stage, and risk level before assuming anything is fine
  • Spotting when a client is ready for more and positioning it as the natural next step, not a sales pitch
  • Every client interaction, decision, and next step logged in our systems (Athena ticketing, Slack channels)
  • Collaboration with the broader CS, delivery, and onboarding teams to make sure nothing falls through the cracks

Requirements

What We Need From You

  • 4+ years in a client-facing account management, CSM, or business consulting role where you were directly responsible for client outcomes, not just client satisfaction scores
  • You've consulted business owners on how to start, grow, or scale a business, walked them through the hard parts, not just handed them a playbook
  • You understand (or can learn fast) the mechanics of B2B lead generation: Meta ads, cold email campaigns, funnels, and how they connect to a client's revenue. You don't need to run campaigns yourself, but you need to diagnose why one isn't converting and have a real conversation about it with the client
  • You're comfortable navigating money conversations with clients, not quoting generic numbers, but reading the specific contract, understanding the payment flows, and giving accurate answers under pressure
  • You can manage difficult client conversations with composure, you stay calm, you don't blame, you find the path forward
  • You come with solutions, not just problems. When something breaks, your instinct is to propose a fix, not report the issue and wait
  • You're confident on camera and on calls; clients trust people who sound like they know what they're doing, even under pressure
  • You've worked in a startup, agency, or fast-moving environment where things change fast and you had to figure things out without a manual
  • You're comfortable with AI tools and either already use them in your workflow or are the kind of person who finds and tests them without being told to
  • You don't need to be chased. You manage your own time, your own portfolio, and your own follow-ups

This Is Not For You If:

  • You only know one side of the equation (only marketing, or only sales) and aren't interested in learning the other
  • You need everything documented before you can act; we're building the playbook, not following one
  • You wait for clients to come to you with problems instead of spotting them early
  • You avoid hard conversations or default to telling clients what they want to hear
  • You treat AI as a buzzword rather than something you actually use
  • You need heavy management and regular direction to stay productive
  • You hear "refund" and freeze instead of diagnosing what went wrong and whether it's fixable

What Success Looks Like:

  • Your clients are progressing; not just happy, but actually hitting milestones and getting results
  • Escalations that reach you don't reach anyone above you, you resolve them
  • You're the AM other people point to when asked "who handles clients well here"
  • You identify upsell opportunities because you actually understand where the client is and what they need next
  • Clients at risk are flagged before they ask for a refund, not after
  • You can audit a new book of business end to end and produce an accurate status picture within your first week of owning it
  • Your documentation is clean, current, and useful; anyone picking up your account can see exactly where things stand
  • You adopt new tools and processes fast and bring ideas for improving them

Our Process

After an initial screen, you'll complete a scenario-based Loom task, a real client situation that tests how you diagnose problems, manage expectations, and make commercial decisions. If you pass, you'll meet with our CS Leadership team for a deeper conversation.

We assess for judgment, not just experience. Show us how you think.

Benefits

The Environment

This is a high-performance, remote-first team operating at the cutting edge of AI-powered business building. Here's what that means for you:

  • Direct access to founders from day one, no layers, no politics. You'll work alongside people who are building the business, not managing from a distance.
  • Real growth path, strong performers are promoted from month three, not year three. We move people up based on what they deliver, not how long they've been here.
  • Exposure to AI-led systems and tools, you won't just use AI as a buzzword on your CV. You'll operate inside a business that builds and ships AI products daily, and you'll be expected to use them to get better at your job.
  • Compensation that rewards output, base plus performance bonus plus upsell commission. The harder you push, the more you earn.
  • Autonomy and ownership, you manage your portfolio, your time, and your client relationships. No micromanagement, no hand-holding.
  • A team that holds a high bar, the people around you are operators, not passengers. That's the standard, and it's what makes this place worth being in.

    If you're looking for structure handed to you, this isn't the right place. If you want to be the one "Lifting up the hood", build something real, and raise the bar every week with a team that moves fast - we want to talk.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Program Manager of Technical Development

Position Location: Remote – work virtually from anywhere in the United States. Must be located near a major US airport.

JOB SUMMARY

The Program Manager of Technical Development is responsible for the technical quality, standards, and capability of the Field Services workforce. This role ensures that commissioning execution is technically rigorous and consistent across all projects and sites — not dependent on the expertise of specific individuals — by developing field competency, owning technical standards and SOPs, and driving continuous improvement of processes and workflows.

The Program Manager of Technical Development partners directly with the Program Manager – Projects and Program Manager – People verticals and reports to the Associate Director, providing the technical input that informs staffing readiness, delivery risk, and training investment decisions across the program.

This role's primary objective is to ensure the technical execution of commissioning work is correct, consistent, and scalable across all Field Services programs, and to build a workforce technically capable of handling complex systems and abnormal conditions without dependency on a small group of senior experts.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Own Technical Standards and Processes (30%)

  • Develop, implement, and maintain commissioning SOPs, workflows, templates, and client programmatic requirements across all programs
  • Ensure consistent application of technical standards across all active projects and sites; monitor compliance and address deviations proactively
  • Own the technical onboarding process for new projects and programs: ensure workflows are integrated, client-specific requirements are documented, and field teams are trained prior to execution
  • Maintain a centralized, accessible repository of technical processes, deliverables, and field insights
  • Provide technical input on proposals and scope reviews to ensure execution approach, staffing qualifications, and deliverable commitments are technically sound

Develop Field Capability and Competency (25%)

  • Identify technical skill gaps across the workforce and develop structured plans to close them through training, mentoring, and field coaching
  • Deliver or coordinate onsite technical training, hands-on instruction, and real-time coaching during commissioning execution
  • Ensure the workforce develops depth in troubleshooting, system-level understanding, and abnormal condition response — not just procedural execution capability
  • Partner with Program Manager – People on development planning; provide technical competency input into promotion readiness calibration
  • Assess Technical Lead and SME performance; identify development needs and succession candidates within the technical track

Manage Technical Escalation and Field Oversight (20%)

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex technical issues during commissioning and testing; resolve at the Program Manager of Technical Development level before escalating to the Associate Director
  • Provide direct technical oversight and support during critical project phases, high-risk testing activities, or complex system integrations
  • Ensure accuracy and technical rigor in testing documentation, commissioning plans, and reports
  • Audit technical deliverable quality across active projects; identify recurring issues and initiate root cause analysis and standards updates as needed
  • Conduct regular site visits to observe technical execution firsthand, validate standards compliance, and deliver field coaching

Drive Continuous Improvement and Knowledge Management (15%)

  • Capture lessons learned across projects and systematically incorporate findings into SOPs, workflows, and training content
  • Drive iterative improvement of technical processes — standards should become more efficient, scalable, and consistently adopted over time
  • Identify recurring technical execution gaps and develop programmatic responses rather than one-off interventions
  • Contribute to routine reporting by preparing the technical capability and standards compliance section for Associate Director review and compilation

Ensure Cross-Functional Alignment and Project Onboarding (10%)

  • Partner with Program Manager – Projects to ensure technical standards are applied in the field; provide early warning on technical gaps that may affect schedule, quality, or delivery risk
  • Partner with Program Manager – People to align training priorities with workforce readiness and communicate technical capability requirements that inform staffing and hiring decisions
  • Provide technical input to the Associate Director on capability gaps, workforce readiness, and technical risk posture across the program portfolio
  • Coordinate with the Associate Director of Technical Development on programmatic and departmental standardization and training initiatives

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (ADVANCED LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING)

  • Demonstrated ability to develop and enforce technical standards at program scale
  • Experience developing SOPs, workflows, and technical process documentation
  • Advanced troubleshooting and system-level thinking capability
  • Strong training, mentoring, and technical knowledge-transfer capability
  • Ability to translate field observations into scalable process improvements
  • Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve standards development, training delivery, and technical documentation
  • Ability to operate effectively in a high-growth, distributed, remote environment
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment thru effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
  • Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision
  • Ability to analyze complex information and develop plans to address identified issues
  • Proficient in MS Office Suite and commissioning documentation tools
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently manipulating, moving or grasping small parts, devices or tools

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Model Integrations
jobs.excerpt: THE ROLE.  The next decade of film, episodic, and game production will be shaped by how well generative AI integrates into the pipelines artists already trust.
jobs.description:
THE ROLE.

The next decade of film, episodic, and game production will be shaped by how well generative AI integrates into the pipelines artists already trust. Foundry's bet — backed by 30 years of building the tools behind every VFX Oscar of the last decade — is that the winners won't be standalone AI apps. They'll be the studios that can compose, control, and reason over a fleet of AI models inside their existing workflows, with the security and traceability production demands.

Griptape Nodes is the orchestration layer that makes that possible: a Python-first, node-based platform where artists assemble pipelines spanning image, video, 3D, audio, and text models — running locally or in the cloud, model-agnostic, and stitched into Nuke, Maya, Blender, and beyond. Griptape Studio is what comes next: a context layer that gives agents real production awareness so AI work can finally be coherent across an entire production.

As a Software Engineer on this team, you'll work on the surface artists touch most in Griptape Nodes: how they access and use AI models. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you'll be the person who lands new model support on day one, translates technical model behavior into validation and error messages an artist can actually act on, and designs the next-generation interface for open-source and local models, including the deep local-model support that Griptape Studio and other parts of the platform will rely on for chat, agent loops, and more.

Our North Star is "Craveability." We build products people crave to use, not have to use. We measure success by how much users enjoy our products, not just tolerate them. Engineering is held to that bar — we keep users in flow, test the way they actually work, and build with the polish that earns trust.

Responsibilities

  • Ship model support on day one. When a major new foundation model, video generator, voice model, or open-weight checkpoint drops, artists should be able to try it in Griptape Nodes immediately. You build the node and library that makes that real.
  • Translate model behavior into artist language.When a model fails, the system knows what went wrong; the artist usually doesn't. Your job is closing that gap — turning "403: proxy model failed with [800 lines of garbage]" into "Your reference image needs to be at least 1024px wide and 32-bit; yours is 859px and 24-bit." Client-side validation, crisp error messages, sensible defaults, predictable behavior — the craft that turns "technically functional" into "actually pleasant."
  • Design the next-gen interface for open-source and local models. Architect how Griptape Nodes treats self-hosted and on-device models — and build the deep local-model support that lets customers run chat, agent loops, and more entirely locally, including the substrate Griptape Studio and other parts of the platform will lean on.
  • Stay responsive to two signal streams.New models drop nearly every week. Artist feedback never stops. Build the muscle and the systems to turn both into shipped improvements quickly.
  • Make AI part of how we build. Use Claude, Cursor, Griptape Nodes itself, and whatever else clears the path. We expect engineers here to ship faster and reason deeper because of AI, not in spite of it.
  • Hold the quality bar.Design, implement, test, and document features for the way studios actually work. Review code thoughtfully, estimate honestly, and partner with Customer Support when issues surface from the field.

Requirements

The essentials:
  • Strong Python with the engineering habits to back it up — type hints, tests, packaging, and dependency management aren't optional in your code. You can own a non-trivial feature end-to-end.
  • A degree in computer science.
  • Customer empathy and intuition. You can write the validation, error messages, and defaults that translate technical reality into language an artist can act on — without needing to ask an artist what to write.
  • Working knowledge of the modern model ecosystem — foundation models, diffusion, video and audio generators, model hubs (Hugging Face and friends), and what's involved in running models locally vs. through a hosted API.
  • Hands-on experience with local inference tooling — Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, MLX, transformers, or equivalent. You've actually gotten models running on someone's laptop.
  • Generative AI fundamentals — diffusion models, LLMs and agents, fine-tuning, MCP, evaluation metrics, prompt engineering. Enough to debug a workflow when it goes sideways.
  • A track record of using AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agent frameworks) to genuinely accelerate your work, not as a novelty.
  • Strong written communication — clear design docs, useful PR descriptions, code comments that future-you will thank past-you for.
  • Comfort working across Windows, Linux, and macOS.

Nice to have, keen to learn:
  • Experience shipping AI/ML integrations inside a product environment.
  • Familiarity with media and entertainment workflows and formats — OpenEXR, USD, ACES, OpenColorIO, common containers and codecs.
  • Open-source contributions to ML or AI tooling.
  • Working knowledge of model quantization, LoRA fine-tuning, or production model evaluation.
  • Background in node-based, dataflow, or visual programming environments.
  • Experience integrating with DCC tools (Nuke, Maya, Houdini, Blender).

Job Summary

We are seeking an Experienced Corporate Counsel, M&A to serve as a critical strategic advisor to our executive leadership team and lead executioner for our corporate development initiatives. Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO), you will quarterback complex buy-side and sell-side transactions from inception to integration, directly safeguarding and expanding our multi-million dollar federal revenue portfolio.

In this high-impact, in-house role, you will be responsible for translating complex legal risks into clear, actionable business intelligence for members of the C-Suite, enabling data-driven, strategic decision-making. Operating at the intersection of corporate law and federal procurement, you will navigate the unique regulatory complexities of a Large Business federal contractor, including FAR/DFARS compliance, SBA affiliation risks, and contract novations. If you are a seasoned transactional attorney with a sharp business acumen and a proven track record of successfully executing GovCon deals, this role offers the platform to directly shape our growth strategy and corporate footprint.

As with any position, additional expectations exist. Some of these include, but are not limited to, adhering to normal working hours, meeting deadlines, following company policies as outlined by the Employee Handbook, communicating regularly with assigned supervisor(s), staying focused on the assigned tasks, and completing other tasks as assigned.

Job Description

Reporting Structure & Collaboration

  • Direct Report: Reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO).
  • Executive Advisory: Prepares and delivers comprehensive M&A transaction summaries, legal risk assessments, and financial exposure details to members of the C-Suite (COSS, COSD and CSO) for strategic decision-making purposes.

Main Duties

  • Transaction Execution: Lead internal deal teams through all phases of buy-side and sell-side GovCon transactions.
  • Contract Risk Mitigation: Review target companies' existing federal contract portfolios, evaluating Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) compliance, subcontracting plans, and active industrial security requirements.
  • Novation Strategy: Author, coordinate, and submit complex novation agreement packages to Administrative Contracting Officers (ACOs) to legally transfer acquired federal contracts without breaching anti-assignment statutes.
  • Internal Business Advisory: Partner directly with the Executive Team, Corporate Development, and Business Unit leads to assess the strategic fit and regulatory risks of potential acquisitions.
  • Outside Counsel Management: Direct and manage external law firms and specialized GovCon consultants to control legal spending and ensure transaction deadlines are met.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Deal Velocity & Efficiency: Time-to-close metrics on targeted acquisitions, ensuring legal milestones are met without causing project friction or deal fatigue.
  • C-Suite Reporting Accuracy: Quality, clarity, and timeliness of executive briefs and executive-level transaction risk matrices provided to the CEO and C-Suite.
  • Regulatory Compliance Post-Closing: Zero post-transaction compliance penalties or contract losses stemming from undisclosed FAR, DFARS, or SBA affiliation risks.
  • Novation Success Rate: Average time required to obtain signed novation agreements from federal Administrative Contracting Officers (ACOs) following a transaction closing.
  • Legal Budget Efficiency: Management of outside counsel spend relative to the established legal budget for each individual M&A transaction.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Education: Juris Doctor (JD) degree from an accredited law school.
  • Licensure: Active member in good standing with a state bar; eligible for local In-House Counsel Licensure if relocating.
  • Experience: 8 to 12+ years of corporate transactional experience, blending initial training at a major law firm ("BigLaw") with meaningful corporate in-house experience at a large federal contractor.
  • Core Knowledge: Advanced fluency in the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Small Business Administration (SBA) size affiliation rules, Cost Accounting Standards (CAS), and organizational conflicts of interest (OCI).
  • Security Clearance: Ability to obtain or maintain an active U.S. Security Clearance (Secret or Top Secret) based on the company's classified contract pipeline.
  • If applicable: If you are or have been recently employed by the U.S. government, a post-employment ethics letter will be required if employment with VSolvit is offered

Company Summary

Join the VSolvit Team! Founded in 2006, VSolvit (pronounced 'We Solve It') is a technology services provider that specializes in cybersecurity, cloud computing, geographic information systems (GIS), business intelligence (BI) systems, data warehousing, engineering services, and custom database and application development. VSolvit is an award winning WOSB, CA CDB, MBE, WBE, and CMMI Level 3 certified company. We offer a customizable health benefits program that best meets the needs of its employees. Offering may include: medical, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, long and short-term disability and other insurance products, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account, 401K Retirement Plan options, Tuition Reimbursement, and assorted voluntary benefits. Our goal is to grow together and enjoy the work that we do as a team.
